/-! ## Redundant preconditions (A11) -/

/-- O1.4 follows from O1.1–O1.3 under I1 (MM-03.3 §3, O1; A11): it is not a precondition of
`derive`. -/
theorem derive_compat_redundant {s : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} (h1 : I1 s) (hs : s.Active src)
    (h2 : ∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, p ∈ s.afp src)
    (h3 : ∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s src p) m) : DeriveCompat s src q m := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa⟩ := hs
  have hI := addAuth_I1 (hd := .frame s.top) h1 hx xa
    (fun p hp => by simpa [S3.afp, hx] using h2 p hp) h3
  intro b hb p hpq
  have hn : effective (deriveEff s src q m) s.A.length p = some m := by
    rw [deriveEff, effective_eq (addAuth_self _ _) rfl hpq]
    have : descModes (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, footprint s.P q, .frame s.top, true⟩)
        s.A.length p = [] := by
      apply nil_of_forall_not_mem; intro e he
      obtain ⟨j, y, hy, -, -, hj, -⟩ := mem_descModes.1 he
      have h1 := chain_lt hj
      have h2 := lt_of_getElem? hy; simp [S3.addAuth] at h2; omega
    simp [this, effOf]
  cases he : effective (deriveEff s src q m) b p with
  | none => trivial
  | some e => exact effective_compat hI b _ p e m (by have := List.mem_range.1 hb; omega) he hn

/-- The removed clause of `canWrite3` follows from its first clause under I1 (MM-03.3 §5;
A11). -/
theorem canWrite3_excl_redundant {s : S3} (h1 : I1 s) {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat}
    (hw : canWrite3 s a ls) : ∀ p ∈ ls, ∀ b, b ≠ a → effective s b p = none :=
  fun p hp _ hb => effective_exclusive h1 (Ne.symm hb) (hw.2 p hp).1

/-! ## Arena (MM-03.3 §6, A10) -/

/-- Logical state of an arena (MM-03.3 §6; A10): `storage` is a place owned by the arena value;
`internal` is its root authority, held by the arena value; `issued` maps each issued region to
the issued block. The anchor of §6 is not a field: dependents anchor on the blocks (A10). -/
structure Arena where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  available : List Nat
  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)

/-- The place of the arena value: the owner of its storage (A10). -/
def arenaValue (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Option Nat :=
  match s.P[ar.storage]? with
  | some pl =>
    match pl.owner with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none

/-- Metadata leaves of the arena: the footprint of the arena value (A10). -/
def metaLeaves (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : List Nat :=
  match arenaValue s ar with
  | some v => footprint s.P v
  | none => []

/-- Arena invariant (MM-03.3 §6; A10). Clauses of §6: issued regions within the administered
storage (the footprint of `internal`); two simultaneously valid issued regions disjoint;
available regions disjoint from the still distributed ones; added: available regions within the
storage. Clauses of A10: each emission is a `Modify` authority derived from `internal` on its
region; the storage is an owned root; `internal` is a `Modify` root held by the owner of the
storage, that is, by the arena value. -/
def ArenaInv (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Prop :=
  (∀ l ∈ ar.available, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  ar.issued.Pairwise (fun e e' => s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ ar.available) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some ar.internal ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify) ∧
  OwnedRoot s ar.storage ∧
  (∃ (y : Authority) (pl : Place), s.A[ar.internal]? = some y ∧ s.P[ar.storage]? = some pl ∧
    y.origin = none ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder = pl.owner)

/-- Right to update the metadata of the arena (A10): an exercisable authority `via` with a
present effective mode on every metadata leaf, all `SharedMutable` (a `writeShared`, A9), with
valid dependencies. -/
def MetaRight (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Exercisable via ∧ arenaValue s ar ≠ none ∧
  ∀ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar, effective s via l ≠ none ∧ k.SharedMutable l ∧ DepsValid s l

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (MetaRight k s ar via) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Static preconditions of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right (A10); the
abstraction has, through `internal`, effective `Modify` on a region of its storage; the
destination `dst` of the block is usable, exercisable in `Modify` (A2) and holds no initialised
value. The disjointness from active emissions is removed (A11): it follows from the authority of
`internal` (`issue_disjoint_redundant`). -/
def IssuePre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧ s.Active ar.internal ∧
  (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal ∧ effective s ar.internal l = some .modify) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssuePre k s ar via region dst) := by
  unfold IssuePre; infer_instance

/-- The region is available (MM-03.3 §6): otherwise `issue` fails (A10). -/
def Avail (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ ar.available

instance (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail ar region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): a `Modify` block derived from `internal`
on the region, held by the destination value; the destination and the metadata become `Init`;
the region leaves `available` and joins `issued`. -/
def issueEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some ar.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ with
      I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∨ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar then .init else s.I l },
   { ar with
      available := ar.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
      issued := (region, s.A.length) :: ar.issued })

/-- Outcomes of `issue` (A10): `ok`, defined failure `fail` with the state unchanged, `reject`
(pass-1 arbitrage 6). -/
inductive IOutcome where
  | ok (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | fail (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | reject

/-- `arena.issue` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
inductive IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    IOutcome → Prop where
  | ok : IssuePre k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s
        (.ok (issueEff s ar region dst).1 (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
  | fail : IssuePre k s ar via region dst → ¬ Avail ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s ar)
  | reject : ¬ IssuePre k s ar via region dst → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right; no active authority
derived from `internal`; no usable place anchored on `internal` or on an authority derived from
it. -/
def ResetPre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ar.internal ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, x ≠ ar.internal ∧ ar.internal ∉ s.ancs x)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (ResetPre k s ar via) := by
  unfold ResetPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): the whole storage becomes available, the past
emissions are forgotten, the metadata become `Init`. -/
def resetEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s with I := fun l => if l ∈ metaLeaves s ar then .init else s.I l },
   { ar with available := s.afp ar.internal, issued := [] })

/-- `arena.reset` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
def ResetStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 (S3 × Arena) → Prop :=
  Guarded (ResetPre k s ar via) (resetEff s ar)

theorem afp_addAuth_lt {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).afp j = s.afp j := by simp only [S3.afp, addAuth_lt h]

theorem active_addAuth_iff {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {x : Nat} (hx : x < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).Active x ↔ s.Active x := by
  simp only [S3.Active, addAuth_lt hx]

/-- The disjointness of a new emission from the active ones follows from the authority of
`internal` (MM-03.3 §6; A11): an active block derived from `internal` covering a leaf takes the
effective `Modify` of `internal` away from it. -/
theorem issue_disjoint_redundant {s : S3} {ar : Arena} {region : List Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hai : ArenaInv s ar) (hm : ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify) :
    ∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ region, l ∉ e.1 := by
  intro e he ha l hl hle
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hf, hmd⟩ := hai.2.2.2.2.1 e he
  obtain ⟨y', hy', ya⟩ := ha; rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
  have hlt := hwf.origin e.2 y ar.internal hy ho
  have hanc : ar.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2 := by
    unfold S3.ancs; rw [chain_cons (by simp [S3.org, hy, ho]) hlt]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  have hd : Mode.modify ∈ descModes s ar.internal l :=
    mem_descModes.2 ⟨e.2, y, hy, ya, hf ▸ hle, hanc, hmd⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -, -, he'⟩ := effective_some (hm l hl)
  rcases effOf_cases he' with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, -⟩
  · simp [h0] at hd
  · exact hn hd

/-- `issue_fail_unchanged` (A10): a failed emission leaves state and arena unchanged, and happens
exactly when the static preconditions hold and the region is unavailable. -/
theorem issue_fail_unchanged {k : K} {s s' : S3} {ar ar' : Arena} {via dst : Nat}
    {region : List Nat} (h : IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s' ar')) :
    s' = s ∧ ar' = ar ∧ IssuePre k s ar via region dst ∧ ¬ Avail ar region := by
  cases h with
  | fail hp ha => exact ⟨rfl, rfl, hp, ha⟩

/-- `arena_issue_preserves_disjointness` (MM-03.3 §6, §10; A10): `issue` preserves `WF3`, `Inv3`
and the arena invariant. The disjointness of the new region is obtained from the access
discipline (`issue_disjoint_redundant`), not from a precondition. No hypothesis on `K`. -/
theorem arena_issue_preserves_disjointness {k : K} {s s' : S3} {ar ar' : Arena} {via dst : Nat}
    {region : List Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3 s) (hai : ArenaInv s ar)
    (h : IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ ArenaInv s' ar' := by
  cases h with
  | ok hp hav =>
  obtain ⟨-, ⟨x, hx, xa⟩, hreg, hdst, -, -⟩ := hp
  have hs := lt_of_getElem? hx
  obtain ⟨hwf₁, hinv₁⟩ := addAuth_preserves (hd := .place dst) hwf hinv hx xa
    (fun l hl => by simpa [S3.afp, hx] using (hreg l hl).1)
    (fun l hl => by rw [(hreg l hl).2]; simp [Allows, OptP, Mode.le]) hdst
  have hdis := issue_disjoint_redundant hwf hai fun l hl => (hreg l hl).2
  obtain ⟨c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, ⟨yi, pli, hyi, hpli, hoi, hmi, hhi⟩⟩ := hai
  have old : ∀ e ∈ ar.issued, e.2 < s.A.length := fun e he => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := c4 e he; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
  have hi := lt_of_getElem? hyi
  refine ⟨hwf₁.of_eq rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl, ⟨hinv₁.1, hinv₁.2.1, fun q hq y hy =>
    hinv₁.2.2.1 q ((S3.Usable.congr rfl rfl rfl).1 hq) y hy, i4_always _⟩, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨fun l hl => ?_, fun e he l hl => ?_, ?_, fun e he ha l hl => ?_, fun e he => ?_, c5,
    ⟨yi, pli, by show (s.addAuth _).A[_]? = _; rw [addAuth_lt hi]; exact hyi, hpli, hoi, hmi, hhi⟩⟩
  · show l ∈ (s.addAuth _).afp ar.internal
    rw [afp_addAuth_lt hi]; exact c0 l (List.mem_filter.1 hl).1
  · show l ∈ (s.addAuth _).afp ar.internal
    rw [afp_addAuth_lt hi]
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
    · exact (hreg l hl).1
    · exact c1 e he l hl
  · refine List.pairwise_cons.2 ⟨fun e he _ ha l hl hle => ?_, c2.imp_of_mem fun {e e'} he he' h ha ha' =>
      h ((active_addAuth_iff (old e he)).1 ha) ((active_addAuth_iff (old e' he')).1 ha')⟩
    exact hdis e he ((active_addAuth_iff (old e he)).1 ha) l hl hle
  · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
    · intro h'; have := (List.mem_filter.1 h').2; simp at this; exact this hl
    · have := c3 e he ((active_addAuth_iff (old e he)).1 ha) l hl
      exact fun h' => this (List.mem_filter.1 h').1
  · rcases List.mem_cons.1 he with rfl | he
    · exact ⟨_, addAuth_self _ _, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hh⟩ := c4 e he
      exact ⟨y, by show (s.addAuth _).A[e.2]? = _; rw [addAuth_lt (old e he)]; exact hy, hh⟩

/-- `arena_issue_keeps_earlier_blocks` (MM-03.3 §6, §10): earlier emissions stay issued with
their authority unchanged, and the new region is disjoint from those still active. No hypothesis
on `K`. -/
theorem arena_issue_keeps_earlier_blocks {k : K} {s s' : S3} {ar ar' : Arena} {via dst : Nat}
    {region : List Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hai : ArenaInv s ar)
    (h : IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar')) :
    ∀ e ∈ ar.issued, e ∈ ar'.issued ∧ s'.A[e.2]? = s.A[e.2]? ∧
      (s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ region, l ∉ e.1) := by
  cases h with
  | ok hp _ =>
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := hai.2.2.2.2.1 e he
  exact ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ he, addAuth_lt (lt_of_getElem? hy),
    issue_disjoint_redundant hwf hai (fun l hl => (hp.2.2.1 l hl).2) e he⟩

/-- `arena_reset_rejects_live_dependents` (MM-03.3 §6, I3, §10; A10): a usable place anchored on
`internal` or on an authority derived from it makes `reset` rejected. No hypothesis on `K`. -/
theorem arena_reset_rejects_live_dependents {k : K} {s : S3} {ar : Arena} {via q x : Nat}
    (hq : s.Usable q) (hx : x ∈ s.D q) (hxa : x = ar.internal ∨ ar.internal ∈ s.ancs x) :
    ResetStep k ar via s .reject :=
  .reject fun h => by
    have := h.2.2 q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x hx
    rcases hxa with rfl | hxa
    · exact this.1 rfl
    · exact this.2 hxa

/-- An active authority derived from `internal`, a block still in use or an access derived from
it, makes `reset` rejected (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem arena_reset_rejects_live_access {k : K} {s : S3} {ar : Arena} {via j : Nat}
    (hj : ar.internal ∈ s.ancs j) (ha : s.Active j) : ResetStep k ar via s .reject :=
  .reject fun h => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := ha
    exact h.2.1 j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy)) hj ⟨y, hy, ‹_›⟩

/-- `reset` preserves `WF3`, `Inv3` and the arena invariant, and modifies `available` and
`issued` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem arena_reset_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {ar ar' : Arena} {via : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hinv : Inv3 s) (hai : ArenaInv s ar) (h : ResetStep k ar via s (.ok (s', ar'))) :
    WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ ArenaInv s' ar' ∧ ar'.available = s.afp ar.internal ∧ ar'.issued = [] := by
  obtain ⟨-, e⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have e1 := congrArg Prod.fst e; have e2 := congrArg Prod.snd e
  simp only [resetEff] at e1 e2; subst e1 e2
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, -, c5, c6⟩ := hai
  exact ⟨hwf.of_eq rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl, ⟨hinv.1, hinv.2.1, fun q hq y hy =>
    hinv.2.2.1 q ((S3.Usable.congr (s := s) rfl rfl rfl).1 hq) y hy, i4_always _⟩,

/-! ## The arena invariant under kernel operations (A10) -/

/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation (MM-03.3 §3–5; A6–A9). -/
inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'

/-- Sufficient conditions for the arena invariant to carry over to a new state: existing
authorities keep mode and footprint, only lose activity, keep an origin equal to `internal` or
absent; the storage stays an owned root; `internal` stays held by the owner of the storage. -/
theorem arenaInv_transport {s s' : S3} {ar : Arena} (hai : ArenaInv s ar)
    (hA : ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧
      y'.mode = y.mode ∧ y'.footprint = y.footprint ∧ (y'.active = true → y.active = true) ∧
      (y.origin = some ar.internal → y'.origin = some ar.internal) ∧
      (y.origin = none → y'.origin = none))
    (hroot : OwnedRoot s' ar.storage)
    (hown : ∀ (y y' : Authority) (pl : Place), s.A[ar.internal]? = some y →
      s'.A[ar.internal]? = some y' → s.P[ar.storage]? = some pl → y.holder = pl.owner →
      ∃ pl', s'.P[ar.storage]? = some pl' ∧ y'.holder = pl'.owner) : ArenaInv s' ar := by
  obtain ⟨c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, -, ⟨yi, pli, hyi, hpli, hoi, hmi, hhi⟩⟩ := hai
  obtain ⟨yi', hyi', mi, fi, -, -, oi⟩ := hA _ yi hyi
  have hafp : s'.afp ar.internal = s.afp ar.internal := by simp [S3.afp, hyi, hyi', fi]
  have act : ∀ x, s'.Active x → x < s.A.length → s.Active x := fun x ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩ hx => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y := ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨hx, rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨y'', hy'', -, -, ha, -⟩ := hA x y hy
    rw [hy'] at hy''; cases hy''; exact ⟨y, hy, ha ya'⟩
  have old : ∀ e ∈ ar.issued, e.2 < s.A.length := fun e he => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := c4 e he; exact lt_of_getElem? hy
  obtain ⟨pl', hpl', hh'⟩ := hown yi yi' pli hyi hyi' hpli hhi
  refine ⟨fun l hl => hafp ▸ c0 l hl, fun e he l hl => hafp ▸ c1 e he l hl,
    c2.imp_of_mem fun {e e'} he he' h ha ha' => h (act _ ha (old e he)) (act _ ha' (old e' he')),
    fun e he ha => c3 e he (act _ ha (old e he)), fun e he => ?_, hroot,
    ⟨yi', pl', hyi', hpl', oi hoi, mi ▸ hmi, hh'⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hf, hm⟩ := c4 e he
  obtain ⟨y', hy', m', f', -, o', -⟩ := hA _ y hy
  exact ⟨y', hy', o' ho, f'.trans hf, m'.trans hm⟩

theorem OwnedRoot.of_P {s s' : S3} {q : Nat} (h : OwnedRoot s q) (hP : s'.P[q]? = s.P[q]?) :
    OwnedRoot s' q := by
  unfold OwnedRoot at h ⊢; rw [hP]; exact h

/-- `arena_inv_preserved` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): every `ok` transition of a kernel operation
preserves the arena invariant. -/
theorem arena_inv_preserved {k : K} {s s' : S3} {ar : Arena} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3 s)
    (hai : ArenaInv s ar) (h : KStep k s s') : ArenaInv s' ar := by
  have hroot := hai.2.2.2.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨yi, pli, hyi, hpli, hoi, -, hhi⟩ := hai.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have hi := lt_of_getElem? hyi
  have same : ∀ s₁ : S3, s₁.A = s.A → s₁.P = s.P → ArenaInv s₁ ar := fun s₁ hA hP =>
    arenaInv_transport hai (fun j y hy => ⟨y, by rw [hA]; exact hy, rfl, rfl, id, id, id⟩)
      (hroot.of_P (by rw [hP])) (fun y y' pl h1 h2 h3 h4 => ⟨pl, by rw [hP]; exact h3,
        by rw [hA, h1] at h2; cases h2; exact h4⟩)
  have append : ∀ (l : List Authority), ArenaInv { s with A := s.A ++ l } ar := fun l =>
    arenaInv_transport hai (fun j y hy => ⟨y, List.getElem?_append_left (lt_of_getElem? hy) ▸ hy,
      rfl, rfl, id, id, id⟩) hroot
      (fun y y' pl h1 h2 h3 h4 => ⟨pl, h3, by
        rw [show ({ s with A := s.A ++ l } : S3).A = s.A ++ l from rfl,
          List.getElem?_append_left hi, h1] at h2; cases h2; exact h4⟩)
  have releases : ∀ s₁, OnlyReleases s s₁ → s₁.P = s.P → ArenaInv s₁ ar := fun s₁ hr hP =>
    arenaInv_transport hai (fun j y hy => by
      obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ : ∃ y', s₁.A[j]? = some y' :=
        ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨by rw [hr.1]; exact lt_of_getElem? hy, rfl⟩⟩
      obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, m, o, f, -, a⟩ := hr.2 j y' hy'
      rw [hy] at hy₀; cases hy₀
      exact ⟨y', hy', m, f, a, fun h => o ▸ h, fun h => o ▸ h⟩)
      (hroot.of_P (by rw [hP]))
      (fun y y' pl h1 h2 h3 h4 => by
        obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, -, -, hh, -⟩ := hr.2 _ y' h2
        rw [h1] at hy₀; cases hy₀
        exact ⟨pl, by rw [hP]; exact h3, hh ▸ h4⟩)
  cases h with
  | derive hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact append _
  | split hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact append _
  | release hs =>
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, hx, -⟩, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    refine releases _ ⟨by rw [releaseEff_eq hx]; simp, fun j z hz => ?_⟩ (by rw [releaseEff_eq hx])
    rw [releaseEff_eq hx] at hz; rw [set_get (lt_of_getElem? hx)] at hz
    split at hz
    · subst_vars; cases hz; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨z, hz, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, id⟩
  | transfer hs =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    refine arenaInv_transport hai (fun j y hy => ⟨_, by rw [transfer_A_get, hy]; rfl, ?_⟩) ?_ ?_
    · split <;> simp
    · unfold OwnedRoot OptP at hroot ⊢; rw [transfer_P_get, hpli] at *
      rw [hpli] at hroot; simp only [Option.map_some]
      split <;> simp_all [Holder.isPlace]
    · intro y y' pl h1 h2 h3 h4
      rw [transfer_A_get, h1] at h2; cases h2
      refine ⟨_, by rw [transfer_P_get, h3]; rfl, ?_⟩
      by_cases hc : heldIn s.P _ pl.owner <;> simp [hc, h4]
  | depend hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact same _ rfl rfl
  | read hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact same _ rfl rfl
  | write hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact same _ rfl rfl
  | writeShared hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact same _ rfl rfl
  | pin hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact same _ rfl rfl
  | unpin hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact same _ rfl rfl
  | enter hs =>
    rename_i ps ls
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    have hst := lt_of_getElem? hpli
    have hnot : ar.internal ∉ ps := fun hm => by
      have := hpre.2.1 _ hm; unfold OptP at this; rw [hyi] at this
      unfold OwnedRoot OptP at hroot; rw [hpli] at hroot
      rw [hhi] at this; obtain ⟨-, hp, -⟩ := this
      rw [hp] at hroot; simp [Holder.isPlace] at hroot
    refine arenaInv_transport hai (fun j y hy => ⟨_, by rw [enter_lt (lt_of_getElem? hy), hy]; rfl,
      ?_⟩) (hroot.of_P (enterP_lt hst)) ?_
    · split <;> simp
    · intro y y' pl h1 h2 h3 h4
      rw [enter_lt hi, h1] at h2; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq, hnot,
        ↓reduceIte] at h2
      exact ⟨pl, by show (enterP s ls)[_]? = _; rw [enterP_lt hst]; exact h3, h2 ▸ h4⟩
  | exit hs =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold ExitPre at hpre
    split at hpre
    · rename_i f F₀ hF
      obtain ⟨-, -, hR2⟩ := hpre
      refine arenaInv_transport hai (fun j y hy => ⟨_, by rw [exit_A_get hF, hy]; rfl,
        (exitG_same s F₀ j y).1, (exitG_same s F₀ j y).2.1, exitG_active' hy, fun ho => ?_,
        fun ho => ?_⟩) (hroot.of_P (by rw [exitEff_eq hF])) ?_
      · rcases exitG_origin (s := s) (F₀ := F₀) (a := j) (y := y) with e | ⟨hsv, -, e⟩
        · rw [e, ho]
        · rw [e]
          have hob : s.org j = some ar.internal := by simp [S3.org, hy, ho]
          have hnone : s.org ar.internal = none := by simp [S3.org, hyi, hoi]
          have hanc : s.ancs j = [ar.internal] := by
            rw [ancs_cons hwf.origin hob]; simp [S3.ancs, chain_none hnone]
          have hne := hR2 j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy)) hsv (by rw [hob]; simp)
          rw [hanc] at hne ⊢
          cases hfs : firstSurv s F₀ [ar.internal] with
          | none => exact absurd hfs hne
          | some z => rw [(List.mem_singleton.1 (firstSurv_some hfs).1)]
      · rcases exitG_origin (s := s) (F₀ := F₀) (a := j) (y := y) with e | ⟨-, hn, -⟩
        · rw [e, ho]
        · exact absurd ho hn
      · intro y y' pl h1 h2 h3 h4
        rw [exit_A_get hF, h1] at h2; cases h2
        exact ⟨pl, by rw [exitEff_eq hF]; exact h3, (exitG_same s F₀ _ y).2.2 ▸ h4⟩
    · exact hpre.elim
  | endUse hs =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact releases _ ((endUseS_releases s _).trans cleanup_releases) rfl
  | free hs =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact releases _ ((freeS_releases s _).trans cleanup_releases) rfl

/-! ## Test cases (MM-03.3 §11 and the task of pass 2)

Each verdict is obtained by `decide` on the precondition of the operation concerned. States are
built from `S3.init` by the effects of operations. Classification of each case (kernel,
abstraction with `K` instantiated, out of kernel) is given in the report. -/

/-- Test contracts: `SharedMutable`, `Pinned`, `ExternalDone`, `Deallocable` given by lists of
leaves or places, `FreeCompat` by a list of pairs; no declared disjointness, no
invalidation. -/
def KT (sh pinned done dealloc : List Nat) (compat : List (Nat × Nat)) : K :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => False, (· ∈ sh), (· ∈ pinned), fun _ _ _ => False, (· ∈ done), (· ∈ dealloc),
    fun p a => (p, a) ∈ compat⟩

section TestContracts
variable (sh pinned done dealloc : List Nat) (compat : List (Nat × Nat))
instance : ∀ r r', Decidable ((KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun _ _ => instDecidableFalse
instance : DecidablePred (KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).SharedMutable :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ sh))
instance : DecidablePred (KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).Pinned :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ pinned))
instance : DecidablePred (KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).ExternalDone :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ done))
instance : DecidablePred (KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).Deallocable :=
  fun p => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (p ∈ dealloc))
instance : ∀ p a, Decidable ((KT sh pinned done dealloc compat).FreeCompat p a) :=
  fun p a => inferInstanceAs (Decidable ((p, a) ∈ compat))
end TestContracts

/-- Empty contracts. -/
abbrev K0 : K := KT [] [] [] [] []

theorem KT_dd (sh pinned done dealloc : List Nat) (compat : List (Nat × Nat)) :
    DDSound (KT sh pinned done dealloc compat) := fun _ _ h => h.elim

/-- Entering frame 1 from the initial frame with locals `ls`. -/
def enter1 (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 := enterEff S3.init [] ls

/-! ### Case 1: two observations of a leaf (expected: allowed) -/

def c1a : S3 := write3Eff (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) [0]
def c1b : S3 := deriveEff c1a 0 0 .observe
def c1c : S3 := deriveEff c1b 0 0 .observe
example : Write3Step 0 [0] (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) (.ok c1a) := .ok (by decide)
example : DeriveStep 0 0 .observe c1a (.ok c1b) := .ok (by decide)
example : DeriveStep 0 0 .observe c1b (.ok c1c) := .ok (by decide)
example : Read3Step 1 [0] c1c (.ok c1c) ∧ Read3Step 2 [0] c1c (.ok c1c) :=
  ⟨.ok (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-! ### Case 2: observation and incompatible modification (expected: reject) -/

example : DeriveStep 0 0 .modify c1b .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : Write3Step 0 [0] c1b .reject := .reject (by decide)

/-! ### Case 3: two really disjoint fields (expected: simultaneous modifications allowed) -/

def c3a : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0)]
def c3b : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff c3a 0 1 .modify) 0 2 .modify
example : DeriveStep 0 1 .modify c3a (.ok (deriveEff c3a 0 1 .modify)) := .ok (by decide)
example : DeriveStep 0 2 .modify (deriveEff c3a 0 1 .modify) (.ok c3b) := .ok (by decide)
example : Write3Step 1 [1] c3b (.ok (write3Eff c3b [1])) := .ok (by decide)
example : Write3Step 2 [2] (write3Eff c3b [1]) (.ok (write3Eff (write3Eff c3b [1]) [2])) :=
  .ok (by decide)

/-! ### Case 4: observation of an element and invalidating modification of the container
(expected: reject). The elements are parts of the container (pass-1 arbitrage 3). -/

def c4b : S3 := deriveEff c3a 0 1 .observe
example : DeriveStep 0 1 .observe c3a (.ok c4b) := .ok (by decide)
example : Write3Step 0 [1, 2] c4b .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : Write3Step 0 [1, 2] c3a (.ok (write3Eff c3a [1, 2])) := .ok (by decide)

/-! ### Case 5: split of a region into two parts (expected: independent authorities) -/

def c5b : S3 := splitEff c3a 0 [[1], [2]]
example : SplitStep K0 0 [[1], [2]] c3a (.ok c5b) := .ok (by decide)
example : Write3Step 1 [1] c5b (.ok (write3Eff c5b [1])) := .ok (by decide)
example : Write3Step 2 [2] c5b (.ok (write3Eff c5b [2])) := .ok (by decide)
example : effective c5b 0 1 = none ∧ effective c5b 0 2 = none := by decide

/-! ### Case 6: two successive emissions from an arena (expected: allowed)

Frame 1: 0 arena value (metadata leaf), 1 storage owned by 0 with leaves 2 and 3, 4 and 5 block
destinations. Root authorities: 0 (place 0), 1 (`internal`, held by place 0), 2, 3. -/

abbrev KA : K := KT [0] [] [] [] []
def c6a : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, some 0, 0), (some 1, some 0, 0),
  (some 1, some 0, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def ar6 : Arena := ⟨1, 1, [2, 3], []⟩
def c6b : S3 × Arena := issueEff c6a ar6 [2] 4
def c6c : S3 × Arena := issueEff c6b.1 c6b.2 [3] 5
example : IssueStep KA ar6 0 [2] 4 c6a (.ok c6b.1 c6b.2) := .ok (by decide) (by decide)
example : IssueStep KA c6b.2 0 [3] 5 c6b.1 (.ok c6c.1 c6c.2) := .ok (by decide) (by decide)
example : IssueStep KA c6b.2 0 [2] 5 c6b.1 .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : ArenaInv c6a ar6 :=
  ⟨(by decide), (by decide), (by decide), (by decide), fun _ h => (nomatch h), (by decide),
    ⟨_, _, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
example : WF3 c6a ∧ Inv3 c6a :=
  reachable_access_invariant_underDD (KT_dd [] [] [] [] []) (.enter .init (.ok (by decide)))

/-! ### Case 7: `arena.reset()` with a usable dependent (expected: reject) -/

def c7a : S3 := dependEff c6b.1 5 4
example : DependStep 5 4 c6b.1 (.ok c7a) := .ok (by decide)
example : ResetStep KA c6b.2 0 c7a .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : ResetStep KA c6b.2 0 c6b.1 .reject := .reject (by decide)

/-! ### Case 8: return of a buffer depending on a parameter of the caller (expected: allowed
under contract). Caller: 0 data, 1 result. Parameters derived by the caller (A3): 2 observes 0,
3 modifies 1. Callee: 2 value. -/

def c8a : S3 := write3Eff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]) [0]
def c8b : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff c8a 0 0 .observe) 1 1 .modify
def c8c : S3 := enterEff c8b [2, 3] [(none, none, 0)]
def c8d : S3 := dependEff (write3Eff c8c [2]) 2 2
def c8e : S3 := transferEff c8d 2 1
example : DeriveStep 0 0 .observe c8a (.ok (deriveEff c8a 0 0 .observe)) := .ok (by decide)
example : DeriveStep 1 1 .modify (deriveEff c8a 0 0 .observe) (.ok c8b) := .ok (by decide)
example : EnterStep [2, 3] [(none, none, 0)] c8b (.ok c8c) := .ok (by decide)
example : Write3Step 4 [2] c8c (.ok (write3Eff c8c [2])) := .ok (by decide)
example : DependStep 2 2 (write3Eff c8c [2]) (.ok c8d) := .ok (by decide)
example : TransferStep K0 2 1 c8d (.ok c8e) := .ok (by decide)
example : ExitStep c8e (.ok (exitEff c8e)) := .ok (by decide)
example : (exitEff c8e).D 1 = [0] := by decide

/-! ### Case 9: temporary capture of an access by a non-escaping value (expected: allowed) -/

def c9a : S3 := write3Eff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .observe) [1]
example : DependStep 1 2 c9a (.ok (dependEff c9a 1 2)) := .ok (by decide)
example : ReleaseStep 2 (dependEff c9a 1 2) .reject := .reject (by decide)

/-! ### Case 10: capture of a local access in an escaping value (expected: reject). Caller: 0
result, parameter 1. Callee: 1 local, 2 value capturing access 4 derived from the local. -/

def c10a : S3 := enterEff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .modify) [1]
  [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def c10b : S3 := write3Eff (deriveEff c10a 2 1 .observe) [2]
def c10c : S3 := transferEff (dependEff c10b 2 4) 2 0
example : DeriveStep 2 1 .observe c10a (.ok (deriveEff c10a 2 1 .observe)) := .ok (by decide)
example : DependStep 2 4 c10b (.ok (dependEff c10b 2 4)) := .ok (by decide)
example : TransferStep K0 2 0 (dependEff c10b 2 4) (.ok c10c) := .ok (by decide)
example : ExitStep c10c .reject := .reject (by decide)

/-! ### Case 11: transfer invalidating an active projection (expected: reject) -/

def c11a : S3 := write3Eff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0),
  (none, none, 0)]) [1, 2]
example : TransferStep K0 0 3 (deriveEff c11a 0 1 .observe) .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : TransferStep K0 0 3 c11a (.ok (transferEff c11a 0 3)) := .ok (by decide)

/-! ### Case 13: pinned storage for DMA (expected: no physical move while registered) -/

def c13a : S3 := write3Eff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]) [0]
example : PinStep 0 c13a (.ok (pinEff c13a 0 true)) := .ok (by decide)
example : TransferStep K0 0 1 (pinEff c13a 0 true) .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : UnpinStep K0 0 (pinEff c13a 0 true) .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : UnpinStep (KT [] [] [0] [] []) 0 (pinEff c13a 0 true)
    (.ok (pinEff (pinEff c13a 0 true) 0 false)) := .ok (by decide)
example : TransferStep K0 0 1 (pinEff (pinEff c13a 0 true) 0 false)
    (.ok (transferEff (pinEff (pinEff c13a 0 true) 0 false) 0 1)) := .ok (by decide)

/-! ### Case 15: two disjoint SoA columns (expected: independent modifications) -/

def c15a : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 1, none, 0),
  (some 1, none, 0), (some 2, none, 0), (some 2, none, 0)]
def c15b : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff c15a 0 1 .modify) 0 2 .modify
example : DeriveStep 0 2 .modify (deriveEff c15a 0 1 .modify) (.ok c15b) := .ok (by decide)
example : Write3Step 1 [3, 4] c15b (.ok (write3Eff c15b [3, 4])) := .ok (by decide)
example : Write3Step 2 [5, 6] (write3Eff c15b [3, 4])
    (.ok (write3Eff (write3Eff c15b [3, 4]) [5, 6])) := .ok (by decide)

/-! ### Case 16: return of a buffer depending on the caller's arena (expected: `ok`), then
`endUse(buffer)` and `reset` (expected: `ok`). Caller: 0 arena value, 1 storage owned by 0 with

destination. Callee: 5 receives the block. -/

def c16a : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, some 0, 0), (some 1, some 0, 0),
  (some 1, some 0, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def ar16 : Arena := ⟨1, 1, [2, 3], []⟩
def c16b : S3 := enterEff (deriveEff (deriveEff c16a 0 0 .observe) 2 4 .modify) [3, 4]

def c16d : S3 := exitEff (transferEff c16c.1 5 4)

    (.ok c16b) := .ok (by decide)
example : IssueStep KA ar16 3 [2] 5 c16b (.ok c16c.1 c16c.2) := .ok (by decide) (by decide)
example : TransferStep KA 5 4 c16c.1 (.ok (transferEff c16c.1 5 4)) := .ok (by decide)
example : ExitStep (transferEff c16c.1 5 4) (.ok c16d) := .ok (by decide)
example : c16d.Active 6 ∧ (c16d.A[6]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 4) := by decide
example : ResetStep KA c16c.2 0 c16d .reject := .reject (by decide)
example : EndUseStep KA 4 c16d (.ok (endUseEff c16d 4)) := .ok (by decide)

# Tâche : MM-03.3 — jalon 1, passe 2 (exercice, possession, fin d'usage, libération)

## Git
Même branche `formal/access_model_0.1`, à la suite. Pas de merge, pas de PR. Tout sous `formal/`. `Ern/MM02.lean` inchangé. Spec jointe : MM-03.3 v0.2, non copiée ; les arbitrages ci-dessous font foi sur elle.

## Langue
Tout ce qui est code ou attaché au code est en anglais : identifiants, docstrings, commentaires, messages de commit. Seul le rapport est en français.

## Arbitrages (font foi)
A1. I1 renforcé structurellement, sur **toutes** les feuilles, `SharedMutable` comprises : deux autorités actives non apparentées couvrant une même feuille ont toutes deux le mode propre `Observe` ; le mode effectif devient un théorème. Les conditions de bonne formation (origines, cadres, possession, empreintes sur emplacements existants) restent dans un invariant séparé `WF3` : distinguer invariants de sûreté et domaine des états admissibles. Ne pas présupposer que `WF3` devient superflu ; donner un contre-exemple pour toute préservation non démontrable.
A2. `Exercisable` défini inductivement et bien fondé : cas de base, autorité active détenue par le cadre courant ; cas inductif, autorité détenue par un emplacement `p` dont le cadre courant possède déjà une autorité exerçable de mode effectif ≥ sur toute l'empreinte de `p`. Aucun cycle ne justifie un droit. Exigé par `derive` (source), `split`, `read3`, `write3`, `writeShared`, `transfer` (`Modify` sur source et destination), `issue` (destination), `free`, `endUse`, `pin`.
A3. Appels : les paramètres sont dérivés par l'appelant puis remis à `enterFrame`, qui en fait le nouveau cadre détenteur. Le retour est un `transfer` vers un emplacement résultat de l'appelant passé comme paramètre `Modify`.
A4. `Authority.holder : Frame | Place`. `transfer` déplace avec la valeur toutes les autorités détenues par l'emplacement source et ses sous-emplacements ; plus d'argument `auths`. Une racine reste détenue par le propriétaire de son emplacement et n'est jamais transférée seule. Les transferts de valeurs composites préservent leurs droits.
A5. `Place.owner : Frame | Place` (stockage possédé). `Usable` : la chaîne des propriétaires aboutit à un cadre sur la pile. Le transfert d'une valeur transfère la possession de ses emplacements possédés sans les déplacer. Un emplacement possédé n'est pas nécessairement une allocation distincte de MM-02 ; la correspondance relève du jalon 2.
A6. Fin d'usage et libération, quatre notions distinctes, jamais confondues :
  - `release` : fin d'un accès temporaire (existant) ; peut précéder la fin de la valeur ;
  - `endUse p` : événement **final** de la valeur en `p`. Préconditions : `Modify` exerçable sur `p` ; aucune autorité active dérivée sur l'empreinte de `p` détenue ailleurs ; aucun emplacement utilisable ancré sur une autorité détenue par `p` ou sur sa racine ; aucune feuille épinglée sans `K.ExternalDone`. Effet : feuilles `Uninit`, autorités encore détenues par `p` libérées, dépendances de `p` supprimées, emplacements possédés logiquement morts. N'exécute rien, ne libère aucun stockage, n'émet aucun événement de désallocation ; une allocation possédée non libérée est une fuite, à signaler, pas une erreur du modèle. Modélisé comme opération explicite ; son placement est hors modèle, et dans les cas d'épreuve un `free` programmé compte comme utilisation : `endUse` ne le précède jamais ;
  - `free p auth` : libération explicite d'un emplacement possédé. Exige `K.Deallocable p` (unité libérable selon le contrat de l'allocateur ; un bloc d'arène ne l'est pas), une autorité de désallocation `auth` compatible (`K.FreeCompat p auth`, raccordée à `Compatible` de MM-02 au jalon 2), `Modify` exerçable, aucune autorité active dérivée sur son empreinte détenue ailleurs, aucun emplacement utilisable ancré dessus, aucune feuille épinglée. Effet : `p` mort ;
  - `reset` : restitution collective d'une arène (A10).
A7. Ré-ancrage itéré à `exitFrame` le long de la chaîne d'origines jusqu'à la première autorité active détenue par un cadre survivant ; `reject` si la chaîne atteint la racine d'un emplacement du cadre sortant. Prouver la terminaison.
A8. Épinglage dynamique : `pin p`/`unpin p` dans l'état. `transfer` rejeté si la source a une feuille en place épinglée ; les emplacements possédés épinglés n'empêchent pas le transfert (ils ne bougent pas). `free` et `endUse` rejetés sur une feuille épinglée sans `K.ExternalDone`. `unpin` exige `K.ExternalDone p`. `K.Pinned` reste pour l'épinglage statique.
A9. `writeShared` : seule opération de mutation permise depuis une autorité `Observe`, sur des feuilles `SharedMutable` uniquement, soumise au contrat `K.SharedMutable`. Elle n'affaiblit pas I1 : deux autorités ordinaires `Modify` incompatibles restent interdites sur une feuille `SharedMutable`. La seule garantie qui ne tient pas sur ces feuilles est la stabilité du contenu observé. `writeShared` ne constitue aucune preuve d'absence de data race.
A10. Arène : stockage = emplacement possédé par la valeur arène ; `internal` = sa racine, détenue par la valeur arène ; métadonnées mises à jour par `writeShared` ; droit sur les métadonnées distinct de l'autorité sur les blocs. `issue : ok | fail | reject`, `fail` (état inchangé) si la région est indisponible. Blocs détenus par la valeur destination, dérivés de `internal`, dépendants ancrés sur le bloc. `ResetPre` : aucune autorité active dérivée de `internal`, aucun emplacement utilisable ancré dans le sous-arbre de `internal`. `reset` modifie effectivement `available` et `issued`.
A11. Retirer des préconditions O1.4, la seconde clause de `canWrite3`, la disjonction dans `issue`, uniquement si un théorème démontre leur redondance ; les garder sinon.

1. A4, A5 : `holder`, `owner`, `Usable` réécrit, `transfer` sans `auths`, `exitFrame` sur la possession transitive.
2. A2, A3 : `Exercisable` inductif, ajouté aux opérations listées ; `enterFrame` prend les paramètres dérivés par l'appelant.
3. A1 : I1 renforcé, `WF3` séparé ; préservation de `Inv3 ∧ WF3` par toutes les opérations ; `effective_exclusive` gardé.
4. A6 à A9 : `endUse`, `free`, ré-ancrage itéré, `pin`/`unpin`, `writeShared`. Théorèmes : préservation ; `free_no_dangling` (après `free`, aucun accès utilisable ne couvre le stockage libéré) ; `endUse_no_dealloc_event` (`endUse` ne produit aucune transition de libération et ne tue physiquement aucun emplacement possédé) ; `endUse_preserves_dependents` (aucun dépendant utilisable ne perd d'ancre) ; `exitFrame_kills_locals` ; `exercise_requires_hold` ; `writeShared_only_shared` ; `shared_keeps_exclusivity` (I1 vaut sur les feuilles `SharedMutable`) ; terminaison du ré-ancrage.
5. A10, A11 : arène réécrite ; `arena_inv_preserved` par toutes les opérations du noyau ; `arena_reuse_safe` (après `reset`, réémettre une région déjà émise préserve `Inv3 ∧ WF3` et ne crée aucun accès périmé) ; `issue_fail_unchanged` ; préconditions retirées seulement avec leur théorème.
6. Cas d'épreuve : les 17 rejoués, plus :
   - l'appelé lit un local de l'appelant sans paramètre → `reject` ;
   - `create_arena()` rendue par une fonction → `ok`, utilisable par l'appelant ;
   - `Vec` à stockage possédé rendu par une fonction → `ok` ;
   - cas 16, puis `endUse(buffer)`, puis `reset` → `ok` ;
   - `endUse(p)` avec une autorité dérivée active détenue ailleurs → `reject` ; avec un dépendant utilisable ancré sur `p` → `reject` ;
   - `alloc`, `process`, `free` en fin de cadre (`defer` modélisé), `endUse` après le `free` → `ok` ; `free` pendant un accès actif → `reject` ; `free` sans autorité de désallocation compatible → `reject` ; `free` d'un bloc d'arène → `reject` ;
   - `endUse` d'une valeur dont le stockage possédé n'a pas été libéré → `ok`, signalé comme fuite ;
   - deux autorités `Modify` ordinaires incompatibles sur une feuille `SharedMutable` → `reject` ; deux observations et un `writeShared` conforme au contrat → `ok` ;
   - retour d'une valeur ancrée sur une dérivée de dérivée d'un paramètre → `ok` ; sur un local de l'appelé via deux dérivations → `reject` ;
   - `issue` sur arène pleine → `fail` ;
   - `transfer` d'une valeur à feuille en place épinglée → `reject` ; d'une valeur dont seul le stockage possédé est épinglé → `ok` ; `unpin` sans `ExternalDone` → `reject` ; `endUse` sur feuille épinglée sans `ExternalDone` → `reject`.

Jalon 2 (raffinement MM-02), concurrence, obligations de `DeclaredDisjoint` contre MM-02, handles persistants, syntaxe, placement de `endUse` et de `release` par le compilateur, obligation de libération attachée à certains types de ressources (non décidée ; le modèle ne l'impose pas, le rapport signale les fuites).

## Règles
Zéro `sorry` ; `#print axioms` au plus {propext, Quot.sound} ; aucun `noncomputable` ; `lake build` sans avertissement ; docstring citant la clause MM-03.3.x ou l'arbitrage A*n* ; rien d'inventé ; tout énoncé de la passe 1 réécrit est justifié, aucun n'est affaibli ; une revue adverse comme en passe 1, avec contre-exemples sur transferts, possession et dépendances.

227	   - `enter_not_inv3_preserving` (`enterFrame`) : une autorité couvre une feuille encore inexistante ; la racine du nouvel emplacement la couvre aussi en `Modify`.

229	   La cause : I1 ne contraint que les modes effectifs, que `release` et `exitFrame` augmentent ; et `Inv3` ne dit pas que les empreintes sont faites d'emplacements existants. 398	  | k + 1, q =>

417	/-- Modes of the active descendants of `a` whose footprint covers leaf `p` (MM-03.3.5). -/
418	def descModes (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Mode :=
419	  (List.range s.A.length).filterMap fun j =>
420	    match s.A[j]? with
421	    | some y => if y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ a ∈ s.ancs j then some y.mode else none
422	    | none => none

424	/-- Cases 1 to 3 of MM-03.3.5 for an active authority covering the leaf, of mode `m`, whose
425	active covering descendants have modes `ds`. -/
426	def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
427	  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe
428	
429	/-- `effective(a, p)` (MM-03.3.5), computed per leaf, with no stored status: absent if `a` is
430	inactive or does not cover `p`, `effOf` otherwise. -/
431	def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=
432	  match s.A[a]? with
433	  | some x => if x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint then effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) else none
434	  | none => none

436	/-- Compatibility of effective modes for ordinary accesses (MM-03.3 §2, I1): only
437	`Observe`/`Observe` is compatible. -/
438	def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe
439	
440	/-- Effective mode `e` permits the requested mode `m`: present and not exceeded
441	(MM-03.3 §3, O1.3). -/
442	def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False
443

498	/-- `s.Exercisable a` (A2): base case, an active authority held by the current frame; inductive
499	case, an active authority held by a usable place `p` for which the current frame already has an
500	exercisable authority whose effective mode permits the mode of `a` on the whole footprint of

554	/-! ## Outcomes and guarded relations (MM-03.3 §3) -/
555	
556	/-- `Outcome3` (MM-03.3 §3): `ok` with the new state, or `reject`, refusal by the static
557	discipline, distinct from a defined failure of an abstraction and from `ub` of MM-02. -/
558	inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
559	  | ok (s : σ)
560	  | reject

562	/-- Common form of the transition rules of MM-03.3 §3–5: `ok` with the effect when the
563	precondition holds, `reject` otherwise. -/
564	inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
565	  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
566	  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

569	    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
570	
571	theorem Guarded.ok_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff s' : σ} :
572	    Guarded Pre eff (.ok s') ↔ Pre ∧ s' = eff :=
573	
574	theorem Guarded.reject_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} :
575	    Guarded Pre eff .reject ↔ ¬ Pre :=

577	/-! ## O1 `derive` (MM-03.3 §3) -/
578	
579	/-- Effect of `derive(source, place, mode)` (MM-03.3 §3, O1): a new active authority with
580	origin `src`, footprint `footprint place`, mode `m`, held by the current frame. -/
581	def deriveEff (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
582	  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, footprint s.P q, .frame s.top, true⟩
583	
584	/-- O1.4 (MM-03.3 §3): every existing authority stays compatible with the derived one in the
585	resulting state. Not a precondition of `derive`: it follows from O1.1–O1.3 under I1
586	(`derive_compat_redundant`, A11). -/
587	def DeriveCompat (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
588	  ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q,
589	    OptP (effective (deriveEff s src q m) b p) (fun e => Compat e m) True
590	
591	/-- Preconditions of `derive` (MM-03.3 §3, O1), in order: 1 active origin, exercisable (A2);
592	place still usable (MM-03.3.1); 2 requested footprint within the origin's; 3 mode permitted by
593	the effective authority of the origin on each leaf. O1.4 is removed (A11): it follows from the
594	others under I1 (`derive_compat_redundant`). O1.5 is not restated: `derive` deactivates
595	nothing. -/
596	def DerivePre (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
597	  s.Active src ∧ s.Exercisable src ∧ s.Usable q ∧
598	  (∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, p ∈ s.afp src) ∧
599	  (∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s src p) m)

602	  unfold DerivePre; infer_instance

605	def DeriveStep (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
606	  Guarded (DerivePre s src q m) (deriveEff s src q m)

609	
610	/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (MM-03.3 §3, O2): one derived `Modify` authority per
611	region, held by the current frame; the origin remains a logical authority. -/
612	def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
613	  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }
614	
615	/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p`: an active descendant of `src` in
616	mode `Modify` covering `p` (MM-03.3 §3, O2.4). -/
617	def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
618	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
619	    False
620	
621	instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
622	  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance
623	
624	/-- Preconditions of `split` (MM-03.3 §3, O2), in order: 1 the origin is an active, exercisable
625	(A2) authority with effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions; 2 regions within the available footprint
626	(the origin's footprint where its effective authority is present); 3 regions pairwise disjoint,
627	structurally (no shared leaf) or by `DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8); 4 no region covers an
628	exclusive right already distributed. O2.5 is not restated: `split` changes neither `D` nor
629	activity. -/
630	def SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
631	  s.Active src ∧ s.Exercisable src ∧ (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
632	  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
633	  rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
634	  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p)
635	
636	instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
637	    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) := by
638	  unfold SplitPre; infer_instance

640	/-- `split` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O2). -/
641	def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
642	  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

644	/-! ## O3 `release` (MM-03.3 §3, A6) -/

646	/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (MM-03.3 §3, O3; A6: end of a temporary access): the
647	authority becomes inactive. -/
648	def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
649	  | some x => { s with A := s.A.set a { x with active := false } }
650	  | none => s

652	/-- Preconditions of `release` (MM-03.3 §3, O3), in order: 1 active authority; 2 no active
653	descendant; 3 no usable place has `a` as anchor. O3.4 (guarantees of associated abstractions)
654	is not represented in the kernel. -/
655	def ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
656	  s.Active a ∧
657	  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
658	  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∉ s.D q)
659	
660	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) := by unfold ReleasePre; infer_instance

663	def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
664	  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

666	/-! ## O4 `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, A4, A5) -/
667	
668	/-- Holder within the value at `q` (A4): a place that is `q` or one of its parts. -/
669	def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
670	  | .place r => partOf P r q
671	  | .frame _ => False
672	
673	instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
674	  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance
675	
676	/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; A4; A5): the destination becomes
677	`Init`, the source `Moved`; the anchors of the source, inherited ones included, join those of
678	the destination and leave the source and its parts; every authority held by the source or one
679	of its parts is now held by the destination (A4); every place owned by the source or one of its
680	parts is now owned by the destination, without moving (A5). -/
681	def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
682	  { s with
683	    P := s.P.map fun pl => if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := .place dst } else pl
684	    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
685	      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
686	    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ depsOf s src
687	      else if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q
688	    A := s.A.map fun y => if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := .place dst } else y }
689	
690	/-- Active derived access covering a leaf of the source and not moved with it
691	(MM-03.3 §3, O4.4; A4). -/
692	def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
693	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
694	    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False
695	
696	instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
697	  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance

699	/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, O4), in order: source usable (MM-03.3.1) and
700	1 initialised; 2 destination usable, without an `Init` leaf, sharing no leaf with the source,

700	1 initialised; 2 destination usable, without an `Init` leaf, sharing no leaf with the source,
701	and still usable once it owns the source's storage (no ownership cycle); exercisable `Modify`
702	on the source and on the destination (A2); 4 no active derived
703	access on the source other than those it holds; 5 anchors of the value valid; 6 non-escape
704	(MM-03.3.6) towards the destination's frame; 7 no leaf of the source pinned, statically
705	(`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8) or dynamically (A8). O4.3 holds by construction. -/
706	def TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
707	  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
708	  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
709	  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
710	  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
711	  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
712	  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
713	  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, NoEscape s x (s.pframe dst)) ∧
714	  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false)
715	
716	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
717	    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
718	  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance

721	def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
722	  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

724	/-! ## O5 `depend` (MM-03.3 §3) -/
725	
726	/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (MM-03.3 §3, O5): the anchor joins the dependencies of

728	by `depsOf`. -/
729	def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
730	  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }
731	
732	/-- Preconditions of `depend` (MM-03.3 §3, O5), in order: result place usable (MM-03.3.1);
733	1 valid anchor; 5 non-escape (MM-03.3.6). O5.2 (real origin of the rights or storage) is not
734	representable: the state does not relate a value to the origin of its content. O5.3 and O5.4
735	hold by construction. -/
736	def DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop :=
737	  s.Usable q ∧ s.Active x ∧ NoEscape s x (s.pframe q)

746	/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A5) -/
747	
748	/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:
749	the owning local if any, the new frame otherwise (A5). -/
750	def localOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (f i : Nat) : Holder :=
751	  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
752	  | some o => .place o
753	  | none => .frame f
754	
755	/-- Places after `enterFrame`: the locals `ls` appended, owned by the new frame `nF` or by an
756	earlier local (A5). -/
757	def enterP (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Place :=
758	  s.P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
759	    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), localOwner ls s.nF i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩
760	
761	/-- Indices, relative to `ls`, of the root locals (no parent). -/
762	def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
763	  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone
764	
765	/-- Effect of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6) with parameters `ps` and locals `ls`: new frame
766	`nF` pushed; the parameters, derived by the caller, are now held by the new frame (A3); locals
767	appended, uninitialised, without dependency, alive and unpinned; one active root `Modify`
768	authority per root local on its footprint, held by the owner of the local (pass-1
769	arbitrage 2; A4). -/
770	def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 :=
771	  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
772	    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
773	    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
774	      (rootIdx ls).map fun i =>
775	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i), localOwner ls s.nF i, true⟩
776	    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
777	    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
778	    freed := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.freed q
779	    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q }
780	
781	/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6): the calling frame is active (non-empty
782	stack); each parameter is an active authority derived by the caller and held by it (A3); the
783	parent and the owner of a local are earlier locals; a part has the owner of its
784	parent. -/
785	def EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
786	  s.F ≠ [] ∧
787	  (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
788	    y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
789	  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
790	    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => s.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s.P.length + i ∧
791	      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - s.P.length]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
792	    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => s.P.length ≤ o ∧ o < s.P.length + i) True
793	
794	instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
795	    Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) := by
796	  unfold EnterPre; infer_instance
797	
798	/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O6; A3). -/
799	def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (s : S3) :
800	    Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
801	  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

803	/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A4, A5, A7) -/
804	
805	/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀`: active, and held by a holder still live once
806	the frame is popped, through transitive ownership (A4, A5). A7 speaks of an authority held by
807	a surviving frame; an authority held by a place is read as held by the frame that ends its
808	owner chain. -/
809	def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
810	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False
811	
812	instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
813	  unfold Survives; infer_instance
814	
815	/-- First surviving authority of a list (A7). -/
816	def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
817	  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)
818	
819	/-- Authority `a` after the exit (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7): released unless it survives; a surviving
820	authority is re-attached to its first surviving strict ancestor along `origin`, which is its
821	origin when that origin survives. -/
822	def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
823	  if Survives s F₀ a then
824	    match y.origin with
825	    | none => y
826	    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
827	  else { y with active := false }
828	
829	/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7): the exiting frame has a caller; every
830	anchor of a place still usable after the exit has a surviving authority among itself and its
831	ancestors along `origin`; every surviving derived authority has a surviving strict ancestor.
832	Otherwise the chain reaches a root that does not survive, and the exit is rejected. -/
833	def ExitPre (s : S3) : Prop :=
834	  match s.F with
835	  | _ :: F₀ => F₀ ≠ [] ∧
836	      (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := F₀ } : S3).Usable q →
837	        ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s F₀ (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
838	      (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s F₀ a → s.org a ≠ none →
839	        firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) ≠ none)
840	  | [] => False
841	
842	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (ExitPre s) := by
843	  unfold ExitPre; split <;> infer_instance
844	
845	/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A4; A5; A7): return to the caller; each anchor
846	replaced by the first surviving authority among itself and its ancestors; authorities that do
847	not survive released; surviving derived authorities re-attached. -/
848	def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
849	  match s.F with
850	  | _ :: F₀ =>
851	    { s with
852	      F := F₀
853	      D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s F₀ (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
854	      A := mapI (exitG s F₀) 0 s.A }
855	  | [] => s
856	
857	/-- `exitFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O7). -/
858	def ExitStep (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (ExitPre s) (exitEff s)

861	
862	/-- Ordinary read condition of a leaf by authority `a` (MM-03.3 §5, `canRead3`): an effective
863	authority permits observation, the leaf is initialised, the needed dependencies are valid. The
864	type and storage contract is not represented. -/
865	def CanReadLeaf (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop :=
866	  effective s a p ≠ none ∧ s.I p = .init ∧ DepsValid s p

883	/-- `canWrite3` (MM-03.3 §5): `a` exercisable by the current frame (A2); on each leaf, effective
884	`Modify` of `a` and needed dependencies valid. The clause "no other ordinary authority with an
885	incompatible effective right" is removed (A11): it follows from the first under I1
886	(`canWrite3_excl_redundant`). The type and storage condition is not represented. -/

893	/-- Effect of a write (MM-03.3 §5): written leaves become `Init`. -/
894	def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 := { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }
895	
896	/-- `write3` as a relation (MM-03.3 §5). -/
897	def Write3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
898	  Guarded (canWrite3 s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)

934	/-! ## Invariants (MM-03.3 §2, A1) -/
935	
936	/-- I1, effective exclusivity strengthened structurally (MM-03.3 §2, A1): two distinct active
937	authorities, unrelated by `origin`, covering the same leaf, `SharedMutable` leaves included,
938	both have the proper mode `Observe`. The pass-1 statement on effective modes is the theorem
939	`effective_compat`. -/
940	def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
941	  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
942	    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
943	    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe
944	
945	/-- I2, conservation of authorities (MM-03.3 §2): the origin of a derived authority exists, and
946	on each leaf of the derived footprint, the leaf is in the footprint of the origin and the
947	derived mode does not exceed the origin's. -/
948	def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
949	  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
950	    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint ∧ y.mode.le x.mode
951	
952	/-- I3, validity of dependencies (MM-03.3 §2): every anchor of a usable place is valid, that is,
953	active (pass-1 arbitrage 2). -/
954	def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
955	
956	/-- I4, validity of consumed values (MM-03.3 §2), first sentence as a state predicate: no
957	`Moved` leaf is readable. The other sentences concern `transfer` and are theorems. -/
958	def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ a p, s.I p = .moved → ¬ CanReadLeaf s a p
959	
960	/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (MM-03.3 §2): the safety invariant. -/
961	def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

963	/-- I4 holds in every state: the read condition requires `Init` (MM-03.3 §2, I4; §5). -/
964	theorem i4_always (s : S3) : I4 s := fun _ _ hm h => by rw [h.2.1] at hm; cases hm
965	
966	/-- `WF3` (A1): well-formedness, the domain of admissible states, separate from the safety
967	invariant `Inv3`. Origins precede their derivations; footprints are made of existing places;
968	the stack is non-empty and without duplicates, below `nF`; owner frames are below `nF`; owner
969	places exist; a part comes after its parent and has its owner and its `dead` flag; every active
970	authority has a live holder (possession). -/
971	def WF3 (s : S3) : Prop :=
972	  (∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) ∧
973	  (∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, l < s.P.length) ∧
974	  s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ (∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF) ∧
975	  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f → f < s.nF) ∧
976	  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
977	    o < s.P.length) ∧
978	  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
979	    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q) ∧
980	  (∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → HolderLive s y.holder)

982	/-- The pass-1 exclusivity on effective modes (MM-03.3 §2, I1) is a theorem under the
983	strengthened I1 (A1). -/

985	    ∀ a b p m₁ m₂, a ≠ b → effective s a p = some m₁ → effective s b p = some m₂ →
986	      Compat m₁ m₂ := by

1704	/-- Storage at `p` released (A6), before releasing authorities whose holder died: `p` and its
1705	parts are dead, `p` is freed, every authority covering a leaf of `p` or held within `p` is
1706	released, the anchors of `p` and its parts are removed. -/
1707	def freeS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
1708	  { s with
1709	    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q
1710	    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (partOf s.P q p)
1711	    freed := fun q => s.freed q || decide (q = p)
1712	    A := s.A.map fun y => if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P p) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then

1722	  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (freeS s p).Usable l)

1766	  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ (freeS s p).D q,

1768	  (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l)

1771	    [DecidablePred k.Deallocable] [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) :
1772	    Decidable (FreePre k s p auth) := by

1862	/-! ## Arena (MM-03.3 §6, A10) -/
1863	
1864	/-- Logical state of an arena (MM-03.3 §6; A10): `storage` is a place owned by the arena value;
1865	`internal` is its root authority, held by the arena value; `issued` maps each issued region to
1866	the issued block. The anchor of §6 is not a field: dependents anchor on the blocks (A10). -/
1867	structure Arena where
1868	  storage : Nat
1869	  internal : Nat
1870	  available : List Nat
1871	  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
1872	
1873	/-- The place of the arena value: the owner of its storage (A10). -/
1874	def arenaValue (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Option Nat :=
1875	  match s.P[ar.storage]? with
1876	  | some pl =>
1877	    match pl.owner with
1878	    | .place v => some v
1879	    | .frame _ => none
1880	  | none => none
1881	
1882	/-- Metadata leaves of the arena: the footprint of the arena value (A10). -/
1883	def metaLeaves (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : List Nat :=
1884	  match arenaValue s ar with
1885	  | some v => footprint s.P v
1886	  | none => []
1887	
1888	/-- Arena invariant (MM-03.3 §6; A10). Clauses of §6: issued regions within the administered
1889	storage (the footprint of `internal`); two simultaneously valid issued regions disjoint;
1890	available regions disjoint from the still distributed ones; added: available regions within the
1891	storage. Clauses of A10: each emission is a `Modify` authority derived from `internal` on its
1892	region; the storage is an owned root; `internal` is a `Modify` root held by the owner of the
1893	storage, that is, by the arena value, and covering exactly the footprint of the storage
1894	(`internal` is its root). -/
1895	def ArenaInv (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Prop :=
1896	  (∀ l ∈ ar.available, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
1897	  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
1898	  ar.issued.Pairwise (fun e e' => s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
1899	  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ ar.available) ∧
1900	  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some ar.internal ∧
1901	    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify) ∧
1902	  OwnedRoot s ar.storage ∧
1903	  (∃ (y : Authority) (pl : Place), s.A[ar.internal]? = some y ∧ s.P[ar.storage]? = some pl ∧
1904	    y.origin = none ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder = pl.owner) ∧
1905	  (∀ l, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P ar.storage)
1906	
1907	/-- Right to update the metadata of the arena (A10): an exercisable authority `via` with a
1908	present effective mode on every metadata leaf, all `SharedMutable` (a `writeShared`, A9), with
1909	valid dependencies. -/
1910	def MetaRight (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
1911	  s.Exercisable via ∧ arenaValue s ar ≠ none ∧
1912	  ∀ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar, effective s via l ≠ none ∧ k.SharedMutable l ∧ DepsValid s l
1913	
1914	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
1915	    Decidable (MetaRight k s ar via) := by
1916	  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

1918	/-- Static preconditions of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right (A10); the
1919	region lies in the storage administered by `internal`; the destination `dst` of the block is
1920	usable, exercisable in `Modify` (A2) and holds no initialised value. -/
1921	def IssueStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
1922	    Prop :=
1923	  MetaRight k s ar via ∧ s.Active ar.internal ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
1924	  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init)
1925

1927	    (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssueStatic k s ar via region dst) := by
1928	  unfold IssueStatic; infer_instance

1930	/-- The region is available (MM-03.3 §6): otherwise `issue` fails (A10). -/
1931	def Avail (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ ar.available
1932	
1933	instance (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail ar region) := by
1934	  unfold Avail; infer_instance

1936	/-- The abstraction has, through `internal`, effective `Modify` on the region (MM-03.3 §6:
1937	the abstraction has the authority needed to distribute the region). The
1938	disjointness from active emissions is removed (A11): it follows from this right
1939	(`issue_disjoint_redundant`). -/

1941	  ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify

1946	/-- Effect of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): a `Modify` block derived from `internal`
1947	on the region, held by the destination value; the destination and the metadata become `Init`;
1948	the region leaves `available` and joins `issued`. -/
1949	def issueEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 × Arena :=
1950	  ({ s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some ar.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ with
1951	      I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∨ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar then .init else s.I l },
1952	   { ar with
1953	      available := ar.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
1954	      issued := (region, s.A.length) :: ar.issued })
1955	
1956	/-- Outcomes of `issue` (A10): `ok`, defined failure `fail` with the state unchanged, `reject`
1957	(pass-1 arbitrage 6). -/
1958	inductive IOutcome where
1959	  | ok (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
1960	  | fail (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
1961	  | reject
1962	
1963	/-- `arena.issue` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10): `reject` when a static precondition fails;
1964	`fail`, with the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable; `reject` when the region is
1965	available but `internal` lacks the right to distribute it; `ok` otherwise. -/
1966	inductive IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
1967	    IOutcome → Prop where
1968	  | ok : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
1969	      IssueStep k ar via region dst s
1970	        (.ok (issueEff s ar region dst).1 (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
1971	  | fail : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → ¬ Avail ar region →
1972	      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s ar)
1973	  | reject : ¬ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
1974	  | noRight : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → ¬ IssueRight s ar region →
1975	      IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject

1978	theorem issue_det {k : K} {ar : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s : S3}

1980	    (h₂ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by

1982	/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right; no active authority
1983	derived from `internal`; no usable place anchored on `internal` or on an authority derived from
1984	it. -/
1985	def ResetPre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=

1987	  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ar.internal ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
1988	  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, x ≠ ar.internal ∧ ar.internal ∉ s.ancs x)
1989	
1990	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
1991	    Decidable (ResetPre k s ar via) := by
1992	  unfold ResetPre; infer_instance

1994	/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): the whole storage becomes available, the past
1995	emissions are forgotten, the metadata become `Init`. -/
1996	def resetEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : S3 × Arena :=
1997	  ({ s with I := fun l => if l ∈ metaLeaves s ar then .init else s.I l },
1998	   { ar with available := s.afp ar.internal, issued := [] })

2000	/-- `arena.reset` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
2001	def ResetStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 (S3 × Arena) → Prop :=
2002	  Guarded (ResetPre k s ar via) (resetEff s ar)
