import Ern.MM03
namespace Ern.MM03

/-! ## Absence of orphan authorities (G3) -/

/-- G3, one link of a chain of holders: `a` is an active authority that covers the place holding
`b`, every leaf of that place being in the footprint of `a`. -/
def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
    | .frame _ => False) False

/-- Consecutive elements of a list related by `R`. -/
def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
  | _ => True

/-- `NoOrphan` (G3): every active authority held by a place is linked to a frame of the stack by a
finite chain of holders without repetition: the chain starts with an active authority held by a
frame of the stack, ends with the authority, and each link is an active authority that covers the
place holding the next link (`CoversHolder`). -/
def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

theorem linked_cons {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} {a : Nat} {l : List Nat} :
    Linked R (a :: l) ↔ (∀ b, l.head? = some b → R a b) ∧ Linked R l := by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp [Linked]
  | cons b l => simp [Linked]

theorem linked_dropWhile {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} {p : Nat → Bool} :
    ∀ {l : List Nat}, Linked R l → Linked R (l.dropWhile p)
  | [], h => h
  | b :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons]
    split
    · exact linked_dropWhile (linked_cons.1 h).2
    · exact h

theorem getLast?_cons_ne {a : Nat} : ∀ {l : List Nat}, l ≠ [] → (a :: l).getLast? = l.getLast?
  | [], h => absurd rfl h
  | _ :: _, _ => by simp [List.getLast?_cons_cons]

theorem getLast?_append_single {x : Nat} : ∀ (l : List Nat), (l ++ [x]).getLast? = some x
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by
    rw [List.cons_append, getLast?_cons_ne (by simp)]; exact getLast?_append_single l

theorem getLast?_dropWhile {p : Nat → Bool} : ∀ {l : List Nat}, l.dropWhile p ≠ [] →
    (l.dropWhile p).getLast? = l.getLast?
  | [], h => absurd rfl h
  | b :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons] at h ⊢
    split at h
    · rename_i hb; simp only [hb, ↓reduceIte]
      have hl : l ≠ [] := fun e => by subst e; exact h rfl
      rw [getLast?_dropWhile h, getLast?_cons_ne hl]
    · rename_i hb; simp only [hb]; rfl

theorem length_dropWhile_le {p : Nat → Bool} : ∀ (l : List Nat), (l.dropWhile p).length ≤ l.length
  | [] => Nat.le_refl _
  | b :: l => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons]
    split
    · exact Nat.le_trans (length_dropWhile_le l) (Nat.le_succ _)
    · exact Nat.le_refl _

theorem dropWhile_ne_of_mem {a : Nat} : ∀ {l : List Nat}, a ∈ l →
    ∃ t, l.dropWhile (· != a) = a :: t
  | b :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons]
    by_cases e : b = a
    · subst e; simp
    · have : (b != a) = true := by simp [e]
      simp only [this, ↓reduceIte]
      exact dropWhile_ne_of_mem (by rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with h | h
                                    · exact absurd h.symm e
                                    · exact h)

/-- Removes the loops of a walk (G3, chains without repetition): the first element is kept, and
an element that occurs again later cuts the walk to its later occurrence. `n` is a fuel, at least
the length. -/
def dropLoops : Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | 0, l => l
  | _ + 1, [] => []
  | n + 1, a :: c => if a ∈ c then dropLoops n (c.dropWhile (· != a)) else a :: dropLoops n c

theorem mem_dropLoops : ∀ (n : Nat) {l : List Nat} {x : Nat}, x ∈ dropLoops n l → x ∈ l
  | 0, _, _, h => h
  | _ + 1, [], _, h => h
  | n + 1, a :: c, x, h => by
    simp only [dropLoops] at h
    split at h
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (mem_of_mem_dropWhile (mem_dropLoops n h))
    · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
      · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (mem_dropLoops n h)

theorem dropLoops_head : ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Nat), (dropLoops n l).head? = l.head?
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, [] => rfl
  | n + 1, a :: c => by
    simp only [dropLoops]
    split
    · rename_i hac
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := dropWhile_ne_of_mem hac
      rw [ht, dropLoops_head n]; rfl
    · rfl

theorem dropLoops_ne_nil {n : Nat} {l : List Nat} (h : l ≠ []) : dropLoops n l ≠ [] := by
  intro e
  have := dropLoops_head n l
  rw [e] at this
  cases l with
  | nil => exact h rfl
  | cons _ _ => cases this

theorem dropLoops_getLast : ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Nat), (dropLoops n l).getLast? = l.getLast?
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, [] => rfl
  | n + 1, a :: c => by
    simp only [dropLoops]
    split
    · rename_i hac
      have hc : c ≠ [] := fun e => by subst e; simp at hac
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := dropWhile_ne_of_mem hac
      rw [dropLoops_getLast n, getLast?_dropWhile (by rw [ht]; simp), getLast?_cons_ne hc]
    · by_cases hc : c = []
      · subst hc; cases n <;> rfl
      · rw [getLast?_cons_ne (dropLoops_ne_nil hc), getLast?_cons_ne hc, dropLoops_getLast n]

theorem dropLoops_nodup : ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Nat), l.length ≤ n → (dropLoops n l).Nodup
  | 0, [], _ => List.nodup_nil
  | 0, _ :: _, h => absurd h (by simp)
  | _ + 1, [], _ => List.nodup_nil
  | n + 1, a :: c, h => by
    simp only [dropLoops]
    split
    · rename_i hac
      exact dropLoops_nodup n _ (Nat.le_trans (length_dropWhile_le c) (by simpa using h))
    · rename_i hac
      exact List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨fun hm => hac (mem_dropLoops n hm),
        dropLoops_nodup n c (by simpa using h)⟩

theorem dropLoops_linked {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} : ∀ (n : Nat) {l : List Nat}, Linked R l →
    Linked R (dropLoops n l)
  | 0, _, h => h
  | _ + 1, [], h => h
  | n + 1, a :: c, h => by
    simp only [dropLoops]
    split
    · exact dropLoops_linked n (linked_dropWhile (linked_cons.1 h).2)
    · refine linked_cons.2 ⟨fun b hb => ?_, dropLoops_linked n (linked_cons.1 h).2⟩
      rw [dropLoops_head] at hb
      exact (linked_cons.1 h).1 b hb

theorem linked_append {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} {i x : Nat} (hr : R i x) :
    ∀ {l : List Nat}, Linked R l → l.getLast? = some i → Linked R (l ++ [x])
  | [], _, h => by cases h
  | [b], _, h => by
    simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at h
    subst h; exact ⟨hr, trivial⟩
  | b :: c :: l, hl, h => by
    have := linked_append hr (l := c :: l) hl.2 (by rw [← getLast?_cons_ne (a := b) (by simp)]; exact h)
    exact ⟨hl.1, this⟩

/-! ### Root authorities of usable places -/

/-- Auxiliary invariant for G3: every usable root place has an active authority without origin,
held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the place (A4; B1). -/
def RootLive (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place), s.A[i]? = some z ∧
    z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧
    ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

theorem WF3.parent_lt {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {i o : Nat} (h : parentOf s.P i = some o) :
    o < i ∧ o < s.P.length := by
  simp only [parentOf] at h
  cases hp : s.P[i]? with
  | none => rw [hp] at h; cases h
  | some pl =>
    rw [hp] at h
    obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, -⟩ := hw.parts i pl o hp h
    exact ⟨hlt, lt_of_getElem? hpr⟩

/-- Every place of a well-formed state is a part of a root place (MM-03.3.2). -/
theorem exists_rootPlace {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) : ∀ n q, q < n → q < s.P.length →
    ∃ r, RootPlace s.P r ∧ partOf s.P q r
  | 0, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, q, hqn, hq => by
    cases hp : parentOf s.P q with
    | none => exact ⟨q, ⟨hq, hp⟩, hq, .inl rfl⟩
    | some o =>
      obtain ⟨hlt, hol⟩ := hw.parent_lt hp
      obtain ⟨r, hr, -, hor⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw n o (by omega) hol
      refine ⟨r, hr, hq, .inr ?_⟩
      rw [chain_cons hp hlt]
      rcases hor with rfl | hor
      · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hor

/-- The footprint of a part is within the footprint of the whole (MM-03.3.2). -/
theorem footprint_sub {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {q r : Nat} (h : partOf s.P q r) {l : Nat}
    (hl : l ∈ footprint s.P q) : l ∈ footprint s.P r := by
  obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
  refine mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlP, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨-, hqr⟩ := h
  rcases hlq with rfl | hlq
  · exact hqr
  · rcases hqr with rfl | hqr
    · exact .inr hlq
    · exact .inr (chain_trans (fun i o h => (hw.parent_lt h).1) (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) q
        hlq r hqr)

/-- The root authority of the root place of a usable place `q` covers `q` and is held by the owner
of `q` (G3, under `RootLive`). -/
theorem rootLive_cover {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hr : RootLive s) {q : Nat} {pl : Place}
    (hpl : s.P[q]? = some pl) (hq : s.Usable q) :
    ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority), s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.holder = pl.owner ∧
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ z.footprint := by
  obtain ⟨r, hrp, hqr⟩ := exists_rootPlace hw (q + 1) q (Nat.lt_succ_self q) (lt_of_getElem? hpl)
  obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, -, hpr, hzh, hzf⟩ := hr r hrp (usable_of_part hw hqr hq)
  obtain ⟨pl', pr', hpl', hpr', he⟩ := hw.ownerOf hqr
  rw [hpl] at hpl'; cases hpl'; rw [hpr] at hpr'; cases hpr'
  exact ⟨i, z, hz, za, by rw [hzh, he], fun l hl => (hzf l).2 (footprint_sub hw hqr hl)⟩

theorem coversHolder_of {s : S3} {i x : Nat} {z y : Authority} {q : Nat} (hz : s.A[i]? = some z)
    (za : z.active = true) (hx : s.A[x]? = some y) (hh : y.holder = .place q)
    (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ z.footprint) : CoversHolder s i x := by
  simp only [CoversHolder, OptP, hx, hh]
  exact ⟨⟨z, hz, za⟩, fun l hl => by simp only [S3.afp, hz]; exact hc l hl⟩

/-- Under `RootLive`, an active authority held by a usable place is linked to a frame of the stack
by a chain of holders, possibly with repetitions: the roots along the owner chain (G3). -/
theorem chain_to_frame {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hr : RootLive s) {q : Nat} (hq : s.Usable q) :
    ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
      ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧
        z.active = true ∧ z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
        Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c) := by

  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    intro x y hx ya hh
    obtain ⟨i, z, hz, za, hzh, hzf⟩ := rootLive_cover hw hr hpl (.frame hpl hd ho hf)
    exact ⟨i, z, f, [x], hz, za, by rw [hzh, ho], hf, rfl,
      ⟨coversHolder_of hz za hx hh hzf, trivial⟩⟩
  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho hu ih =>
    intro x y hx ya hh
    obtain ⟨i, z, hz, za, hzh, hzf⟩ := rootLive_cover hw hr hpl (.place hpl hd ho hu)
    obtain ⟨a₀, z₀, f, c, h0, h0a, h0h, hf, hlast, hlink⟩ := ih i z hz za (by rw [hzh, ho])
    refine ⟨a₀, z₀, f, c ++ [x], h0, h0a, h0h, hf, ?_, ?_⟩

    · rw [← List.cons_append]; exact linked_append (coversHolder_of hz za hx hh hzf) hlink hlast

/-- `NoOrphan` (G3) follows from `WF3` and `RootLive`: an active authority held by a place has a
usable holder (possession, `WF3`), the roots along the owner chain of that holder form a chain of
holders to a frame of the stack, and the loops of that chain can be removed (`dropLoops`). -/
theorem noOrphan_of_rootLive {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hr : RootLive s) : NoOrphan s := by
  intro x y q hx ya hh
  have hq : s.Usable q := by have := hw.poss x y hx ya; rw [hh] at this; exact this

  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, dropLoops (c.length + 1) (a₀ :: c) = a₀ :: t := by
    cases e : dropLoops (c.length + 1) (a₀ :: c) with

    | cons b t => rw [e] at hhd; cases hhd; exact ⟨t, rfl⟩

  · rw [← ht]; exact dropLoops_nodup _ _ (Nat.le_refl _)
  · rw [← ht, dropLoops_getLast]; exact hlast

theorem RootLive.transport {s s' : S3} (h : RootLive s) (hP : s'.P = s.P)

      z.active = true → z.origin = none → s.P[r]? = some pr → z.holder = pr.owner →

/-! ### Preservation of `RootLive` -/

theorem exists_getElem?_of_mem {α : Type} {a : α} : ∀ {l : List α}, a ∈ l → ∃ k, l[k]? = some a
  | b :: l, h => by
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
    · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_getElem?_of_mem h; exact ⟨k + 1, by simpa using hk⟩

theorem append_map_get {α β : Type} (A₀ : List β) (g : α → β) {l : List α} {a : α} (h : a ∈ l) :
    ∃ j, (A₀ ++ l.map g)[A₀.length + j]? = some (g a) := by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_getElem?_of_mem h
  exact ⟨j, by rw [List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
    List.getElem?_map, hj]; rfl⟩

theorem mem_rootIdx {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {k : Nat} (hk : k < ls.length)
    (hn : (ls[k]?).bind (·.1) = none) : k ∈ rootIdx ls := by

    and_self]

/-- The owner of a usable place is live (A5). -/
theorem S3.Usable.owner_live {s : S3} {q : Nat} {pl : Place} (h : s.Usable q)
    (hpl : s.P[q]? = some pl) : HolderLive s pl.owner := by
  cases h with
  | frame hp _ ho hf => rw [hpl] at hp; cases hp; rw [ho]; exact hf
  | place hp _ ho hu => rw [hpl] at hp; cases hp; rw [ho]; exact hu

/-- `RootLive` carries over to a state with the same places, whose usable places were usable
before, and where the root authority of a root place still usable keeps its index, activity,
origin, holder and footprint. -/
theorem RootLive.transport {s s' : S3} (h : RootLive s) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hu : ∀ r, s'.Usable r → s.Usable r)
    (hA : ∀ (r i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place), RootPlace s.P r → s'.Usable r →
      s.A[i]? = some z → z.active = true → z.origin = none → s.P[r]? = some pr →
      z.holder = pr.owner → (∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r) →
      ∃ z', s'.A[i]? = some z' ∧ z'.active = true ∧ z'.origin = none ∧ z'.holder = z.holder ∧
        z'.footprint = z.footprint) : RootLive s' := by
  intro r hrp hur
  rw [hP] at hrp
  obtain ⟨i, z, pr, hz, za, zo, hpr, hzh, hzf⟩ := h r hrp (hu r hur)
  obtain ⟨z', hz', za', zo', hh', hf'⟩ := hA r i z pr hrp hur hz za zo hpr hzh hzf
  exact ⟨i, z', pr, hz', za', zo', by rw [hP]; exact hpr, hh'.trans hzh,
    fun l => by rw [hf', hP]; exact hzf l⟩

/-- `RootLive` carries over when only authorities are appended and places, stack and `dead` flags
are unchanged. -/
theorem RootLive.of_append {s s' : S3} (h : RootLive s) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) (l : List Authority) (hA : s'.A = s.A ++ l) : RootLive s' :=
  h.transport hP (fun _ hr => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hr) fun _ _ z _ _ _ hz za zo _ _ _ =>
    ⟨z, by rw [hA, List.getElem?_append_left (lt_of_getElem? hz)]; exact hz, za, zo, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem RootLive.of_sameA {s s' : S3} (h : RootLive s) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) (hA : s'.A = s.A) : RootLive s' :=
  h.of_append hP hF hd [] (by rw [hA, List.append_nil])

theorem release_rootLive {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} (h : RootLive s) (hs : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')) :
    RootLive s' := by

  obtain ⟨⟨x, hx, -⟩, -, -, h4⟩ := hpre
  have e := releaseEff_eq hx
  have hP : (releaseEff s a).P = s.P := by rw [e]
  have hF : (releaseEff s a).F = s.F := by rw [e]
  have hd : (releaseEff s a).dead = s.dead := by rw [e]
  have hxo : x.origin ≠ none := by simp only [OptP, hx] at h4; exact h4.1
  refine h.transport hP (fun _ hr => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hr)
    fun _ i z _ _ _ hz za zo _ _ _ => ?_
  have hne : a ≠ i := fun e' => by subst e'; rw [hx] at hz; cases hz; exact hxo zo
  refine ⟨z, ?_, za, zo, rfl, rfl⟩
  rw [e]; show (s.A.set a _)[i]? = _; rw [set_get (lt_of_getElem? hx)]; simp [hne, hz]

theorem store_rootLive {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} (h : RootLive s) (hs : StoreStep a p s (.ok s')) :
    RootLive s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, ho, -⟩ := store_pre_auth hpre
  have e := storeEff_eq (p := p) hy
  have hP : (storeEff s a p).P = s.P := by rw [e]
  have hF : (storeEff s a p).F = s.F := by rw [e]
  have hd : (storeEff s a p).dead = s.dead := by rw [e]
  refine h.transport hP (fun _ hr => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hr)
    fun _ i z _ _ _ hz za zo _ _ _ => ?_

  exact ⟨z, by rw [store_get hy]; simp [hne, hz], za, zo, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem endUse_rootLive {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (h : RootLive s)

  have hu1 : ∀ r, (endUseEff s p).Usable r → (endUseS s p).Usable r :=
    fun _ hr => S3.Usable.of_eqs hr rfl rfl rfl

    simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at hq; exact hq.1) (hu1 r hr))
    fun r i z pr _ hur hz za zo hpr hzh _ => ⟨z, ?_, za, zo, rfl, rfl⟩

    rw [hzh]; exact hu.owner_live (show (endUseS s p).P[r]? = _ from hpr)
  show (cleanup (endUseS s p)).A[i]? = _
  rw [cleanup_get, endUseS_get, hz]; simp [hnh, hlive]

    (hs : FreeStep k p a s (.ok s')) : RootLive s' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
  have hu1 : ∀ r, (freeEff s p).Usable r → (freeS s p).Usable r :=
    fun _ hr => S3.Usable.of_eqs hr rfl rfl rfl
  refine h.transport rfl (fun r hr => S3.Usable.mono rfl (fun _ h => h) (fun q hq => by
    simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at hq; exact hq.1) (hu1 r hr))

    have h4 := hpre.2.2.2.1
    unfold OwnedRoot OptP at h4
    split at h4
    · rename_i pl hpl'; exact ⟨lt_of_getElem? hpl', by simp [parentOf, hpl', h4.1]⟩
    · exact h4.elim
  have hrd : ¬ partOf s.P r p := fun hrp' => by
    have := hu.dead_false
    simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, decide_eq_false_iff_not] at this
    exact this.2 hrp'

    refine h.transport hP (fun r hr => S3.Usable.mono hP (fun g hg => by

  have hrp0 : RootPlace s.P r := by

    rw [show (enterEff s ps ls).P = enterP s ls from rfl, enterP_len] at hrl

    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := append_map_get
      (mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A)
      (fun i => (⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i), localOwner ls s.nF i,

    refine ⟨i, z, pr, by rw [alloc_lt (lt_of_getElem? hz)]; exact hz, za, zo,
      by show (allocP s ow ls)[r]? = _; rw [allocP_lt hr]; exact hpr, hzh, fun l => ?_⟩
    show _ ↔ l ∈ footprint (shapeP s.P (.place ow) ls) r
    rw [shape_footprint_old hsa.2.2.2.2.2.1 hr]; exact hzf l
  · have hrl := hrp.1
    rw [show (allocEff s pv ow ls).P = shapeP s.P (.place ow) ls from rfl, shapeP_len] at hrl
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, r = s.P.length + k := ⟨r - s.P.length, by omega⟩
    have hk : k < ls.length := by omega
    have hn : (ls[k]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
      have := hrp.2
      rw [show (allocEff s pv ow ls).P = shapeP s.P (.place ow) ls from rfl,

        shapeOwner ls (.place ow) i, true⟩ : Authority)) (mem_rootIdx hk hn)

theorem init_rootLive (statics : Statics) : RootLive (S3.init statics) := by

  have hlen : (statics.map (·.1)).length = statics.length := by simp
  have hrl : r < statics.length := by have := hrp.1; rwa [init_len] at this
  have hn : ((statics.map (·.1))[r]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
    rw [← init_parentOf hrl]; exact hrp.2
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_getElem?_of_mem (mem_rootIdx (by rw [hlen]; exact hrl) hn)
  refine ⟨j, ⟨.modify, none, footprint (S3.init statics).P r,
    shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) r, true⟩, _, ?_, rfl, rfl, init_P_new hrl, rfl,
    fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
  simp only [S3.init, List.getElem?_map, hj]; rfl

theorem effAnchor_mem (s : S3) (x : Nat) : s.effAnchor x = x ∨ s.effAnchor x ∈ s.ancs x :=
  List.mem_cons.1 (List.getLastD_mem_cons (l := s.ancs x) (a := x))

theorem effAnchor_le (s : S3) (x : Nat) : s.effAnchor x ≤ x := by
  rcases effAnchor_mem s x with h | h
  · exact Nat.le_of_eq h
  · exact Nat.le_of_lt (chain_lt h)

/-- The effective anchor of `x` is the element without origin of its chain (C1). -/
theorem effAnchor_eq {s : S3} : ∀ n x, x < n → ∀ r, (r = x ∨ r ∈ s.ancs x) → s.org r = none →
    s.effAnchor x = r
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, x, hx, r, hr, hro => by
    rcases hr with rfl | hr
    · simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none hro]
    · cases ho : s.org x with
      | none => rw [S3.ancs, chain_none ho] at hr; simp at hr
      | some o =>
        rcases ancs_step ho with ⟨hlt, he⟩ | he
        · have e : s.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor o := by
            simp only [S3.effAnchor, he, List.getLastD_cons]
          rw [e]; rw [he] at hr
          exact effAnchor_eq n o (by omega) r (List.mem_cons.1 hr) hro
        · rw [he] at hr; simp at hr

/-- Under the order of origins of `WF3`, the effective anchor has no origin (C1, B1). -/
theorem effAnchor_root {s : S3} (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y →
    y.origin = some a → a < b) (x : Nat) : s.org (s.effAnchor x) = none := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hro⟩ := reanchor_reaches_root hw (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x)
  rw [effAnchor_eq (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x) r hr hro]; exact hro

theorem effAnchor_congr {s s' : S3} {x : Nat} (h : s'.ancs x = s.ancs x) :
    s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := by simp only [S3.effAnchor, h]

theorem EffAnchorOK.get {s : S3} {x : Nat} {fd : Option Nat} (h : EffAnchorOK s x fd) :
    ∃ z, s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK at h
  cases hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? with
  | none => rw [hz] at h; exact h.elim
  | some z => exact ⟨z, rfl⟩

/-- The effective anchor of an `EffAnchorOK` anchor has a frame. -/
theorem EffAnchorOK.frame {s : S3} {x : Nat} {fd : Option Nat} {z : Authority}
    (h : EffAnchorOK s x fd) (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) :
    ∃ g, s.hframe z.holder = some g := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK at h; rw [hz] at h; simp only [OptP] at h
  cases hg : s.hframe z.holder with
  | none => rw [hg] at h; exact h.elim
  | some g => exact ⟨g, rfl⟩

/-- An `EffAnchorOK` anchor is an authority of `A`. -/
theorem EffAnchorOK.lt {s : S3} {x : Nat} {fd : Option Nat} (h : EffAnchorOK s x fd) :
    x < s.A.length := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h.get
  rcases effAnchor_mem s x with e | e
  · rw [e] at hz; exact lt_of_getElem? hz
  · have : s.org x ≠ none := fun ho => by rw [S3.ancs, chain_none ho] at e; simp at e
    simp only [S3.org] at this
    cases hx : s.A[x]? with
    | none => rw [hx] at this; exact absurd rfl this
    | some _ => exact lt_of_getElem? hx

theorem effAnchorOK_of_same {s s' : S3} {x x' : Nat} {z z' : Authority}
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) (hz' : s'.A[s'.effAnchor x']? = some z')
    (hh : s'.hframe z'.holder = s.hframe z.holder) {fd fd' : Option Nat}
    (hanc : ∀ g f, fd = some f → (ancestor s'.F g f ↔ ancestor s.F g f)) (hfd : fd' = fd) :
    EffAnchorOK s' x' fd' ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  rw [hfd]; unfold EffAnchorOK; rw [hz, hz']; simp only [OptP]; rw [hh]
  cases hg : s.hframe z.holder with
  | none => simp
  | some g =>
    cases hf : fd with
    | none => simp
    | some f => simp only; rw [hanc g f hf]

theorem effAnchorOK_congr {s s' : S3} (hA : s'.A = s.A) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : EffAnchorOK s' x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  have ho : s'.org = s.org := funext fun i => by simp only [S3.org, hA]
  have he : s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := by unfold S3.effAnchor S3.ancs; rw [ho]
  simp only [EffAnchorOK, he, hA, hF, S3.hframe_congr hP]

/-- `AnchorOrder` carries over to a state with the same places and stack, fewer usable places,
fewer anchors, the same chains of origins, and the same holders for the existing authorities
(B8, C1). -/
theorem AnchorOrder.of {s s' : S3} (ho : AnchorOrder s) (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (hu : ∀ q, s'.Usable q → s.Usable q) (hD : ∀ q, s'.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s'.D q, x ∈ s.D q)
    (hanc : ∀ a, a < s.A.length → s'.ancs a = s.ancs a)
    (hA : ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y →
      ∃ y', s'.A[x]? = some y' ∧ y'.origin = y.origin ∧ y'.holder = y.holder) :
    AnchorOrder s' := by
  intro q hq x hx
  have hok := ho q (hu q hq) x (hD q hq x hx)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hok.get
  have he : s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := effAnchor_congr (hanc x hok.lt)
  obtain ⟨z', hz', -, e2⟩ := hA _ z hz
  exact (effAnchorOK_of_same hz (by rw [he]; exact hz') (by rw [e2, S3.hframe_congr hP])
    (fun g f _ => by rw [hF]) (S3.pframe_congr hP q)).2 hok

/-- A local anchor, without origin, of a usable place has a frame, the place has a frame on the
stack, and the first is the second or one of its ancestors (B8, C1). -/
theorem AnchorOrder.frames {s : S3} (_hwf : WF3 s) (_h3 : I3 s) (ho : AnchorOrder s) {q x : Nat}
    (hq : s.Usable q) (hx : x ∈ s.D q) {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[x]? = some y)
    (hyo : y.origin = none) :
    ∃ g f, s.hframe y.holder = some g ∧ s.pframe q = some f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ ancestor s.F g f := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
  have hpf : s.pframe q = some f := pframe_iff.2 hf
  have he : s.effAnchor x = x :=
    effAnchor_eq (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x) x (.inl rfl) (by simp [S3.org, hy, hyo])
  have hok := ho q hq x hx
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hok.frame (by rw [he]; exact hy)
  unfold EffAnchorOK at hok
  rw [he, hy, hpf] at hok; simp only [OptP] at hok; rw [hg] at hok; simp only at hok
  exact ⟨g, f, hg, hpf, hfF, hok⟩

theorem OnlyReleases.fwd {s s₁ : S3} (h : OnlyReleases s s₁) {x : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[x]? = some y) :
    ∃ y', s₁.A[x]? = some y' ∧ y'.origin = y.origin ∧ y'.holder = y.holder := by
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ : ∃ y', s₁.A[x]? = some y' :=
    ⟨_, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨by rw [h.1]; exact lt_of_getElem? hy, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, -, e1, -, e2, -⟩ := h.2 x y' hy'
  rw [hy] at hy₀; cases hy₀
  exact ⟨y', hy', e1, e2⟩

theorem release_releases (s : S3) (a : Nat) : OnlyReleases s (releaseEff s a) := by
  unfold releaseEff
  split
  · rename_i x hx
    refine ⟨by simp, fun j z hz => ?_⟩
    rw [set_get (lt_of_getElem? hx)] at hz
    split at hz
    · subst_vars; cases hz; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨z, hz, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, id⟩
  · exact ⟨rfl, fun j z hz => ⟨z, hz, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, id⟩⟩

/-- `derive` preserves `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; MM-03.3 §3, O1), under `AnchorOrder` alone. -/
theorem derive_preserves_anchorOrder {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact hao.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) (fun _ _ _ hx => hx)
    (fun _ ha => ancs_addAuth_lt ha)
    (fun x y hy => ⟨y, by rw [deriveEff, addAuth_lt (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy, rfl, rfl⟩)

/-- `split` preserves `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; MM-03.3 §3, O2), under `AnchorOrder` alone. -/
theorem split_preserves_anchorOrder {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)}
    (hao : AnchorOrder s) (h : SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact hao.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) (fun _ _ _ hx => hx)
    (fun a ha => chain_congr fun j hj => by
      simp only [S3.org]; show ((s.A ++ _)[j]?).bind _ = _
      rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by omega)])
    (fun x y hy => ⟨y, by
      show (s.A ++ _)[x]? = _; rw [List.getElem?_append_left (lt_of_getElem? hy)]; exact hy,
      rfl, rfl⟩)

/-- `release` preserves `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; MM-03.3 §3, O3), under `AnchorOrder` alone. -/
theorem release_preserves_anchorOrder {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hr := release_releases s a
  have hP : (releaseEff s a).P = s.P := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hF : (releaseEff s a).F = s.F := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hd : (releaseEff s a).dead = s.dead := by unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  have hD : ∀ q, ∀ x ∈ (releaseEff s a).D q, x ∈ s.D q := fun q x hx => by
    cases hy : s.A[a]? with
    | none => unfold releaseEff at hx; rw [hy] at hx; exact hx
    | some y => exact (release_D_mem hy hx).1
  exact hao.of hP hF (fun q hq => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq)
    (fun q _ x hx => hD q x hx) (fun _ _ => by unfold S3.ancs; rw [hr.org])
    (fun x y hy => hr.fwd hy)

/-- `depend` preserves `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; MM-03.3 §3, O5), under `AnchorOrder` alone: the new anchor
satisfies the precondition on its effective anchor. -/
theorem depend_preserves_anchorOrder {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : DependStep q x s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, -, -, hok⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro r hr y hy
  have hr' : s.Usable r := hr.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl
  rw [effAnchorOK_congr (s' := dependEff s q x) (s := s) rfl rfl rfl,
    S3.pframe_congr (s' := dependEff s q x) (s := s) rfl]
  simp only [dependEff] at hy
  split at hy
  · rename_i hrq; subst hrq
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hy with hy | hy
    · exact hao _ hr' y hy
    · simp at hy; subst hy; exact hok
  · exact hao r hr' y hy

/-- `write3`, `writeShared`, `pin` and `unpin` preserve `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1): they change neither
places, stack, anchors nor authorities. -/
theorem write3_preserves_anchorOrder {s : S3} (ls : List Nat) (hao : AnchorOrder s) :
    AnchorOrder (write3Eff s ls) :=
  hao.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) (fun _ _ _ hx => hx) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun _ y hy => ⟨y, hy, rfl, rfl⟩)

/-- `pin` and `unpin` preserve `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; A8): they only set the pin state. -/
theorem pinEff_preserves_anchorOrder {s : S3} (p : Nat) (b : Bool) (hao : AnchorOrder s) :
    AnchorOrder (pinEff s p b) :=
  hao.of rfl rfl (fun _ hq => hq.of_eqs rfl rfl rfl) (fun _ _ _ hx => hx) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun _ y hy => ⟨y, hy, rfl, rfl⟩)

/-- `endUse` preserves `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; A6), under `AnchorOrder` alone. -/
theorem endUse_preserves_anchorOrder {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hr := (endUseS_releases s p).trans cleanup_releases
  refine hao.of rfl rfl (fun q hq => ?_) (fun q _ x hx => ?_)
    (fun a _ => congrArg (chain · a) hr.org) (fun x y hy => hr.fwd hy)
  · exact S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := endUseEff s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
      (fun q h => by simp only [endUseEff, cleanup, endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1) hq
  · simp only [endUseEff, cleanup, endUseS] at hx; split at hx
    · simp at hx
    · exact hx

/-- `free` preserves `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; A6), under `AnchorOrder` alone. -/
theorem free_preserves_anchorOrder {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} (hao : AnchorOrder s)
    (h : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have hr := (freeS_releases s p).trans cleanup_releases
  refine hao.of rfl rfl (fun q hq => ?_) (fun q _ x hx => ?_)
    (fun a _ => congrArg (chain · a) hr.org) (fun x y hy => hr.fwd hy)
  · exact S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := freeEff s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
      (fun q h => by simp only [freeEff, cleanup, freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1) hq
  · simp only [freeEff, cleanup, freeS] at hx; split at hx
    · simp at hx
    · exact hx

def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →

theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,

    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy

import Ern.MM03
namespace Ern.MM03

/-! ## New cases of pass 7 -/

/-! ### Parameters (G1) -/

/-- Twin of `call_protects_params_safe_fails_param` and `_fails_owned` (G1): parameters on two
distinct locals. Frame 1: locals 0 and 1, of roots 0 and 1; the caller derives 2, `Modify` on 0,
and 3, `Modify` on 1, and calls with `[2, 3]` (expected and obtained: `ok`); `CallProtects` holds
in the callee. -/
def dl0 : S3 :=
  deriveEff (deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]) 0 0 .modify) 1 1 .modify
def dl1 : S3 := enterEff dl0 [2, 3] []
theorem call_params_distinct_locals :
    Reachable K0 [] dl1 ∧ EnterStep [2, 3] [] dl0 (.ok dl1) ∧ CallProtects dl1 := by
  have he : EnterStep [2, 3] [] dl0 (.ok dl1) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨.enter (.derive (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide)))
    (.ok (by decide))) he, he, callProtects_of_check (by decide)⟩

/-- An arena passed in `Observe` and a `Modify` parameter derived from a block held by a value of
the caller (G1). From `fa3` (frame 1: arena value 0, storage 4 of root 4 held by 0, block 5 on
the node 5 held by the node value 2), the caller derives 6, `Modify` on the node 5 from the block
5, and 7, `Observe` on the arena value 0, and calls with `[6, 7]` (expected and obtained: `ok`):
the block 5, origin of 6, is held by the place 2, on which no authority of the callee has an
effective mode; 7 is in `Observe`, which G1 does not constrain. `CallProtects` holds in the
callee. -/
def ob0 : S3 := deriveEff (deriveEff fa3 5 5 .modify) 0 0 .observe
def ob1 : S3 := enterEff ob0 [6, 7] []
theorem call_arena_observe_block_param :
    Reachable K0 [] ob1 ∧ EnterStep [6, 7] [] ob0 (.ok ob1) ∧ CallProtects ob1 ∧
      (ob0.A[6]?).map (fun y => (y.mode, y.origin)) = some (.modify, some 5) ∧
      (ob0.A[5]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place 2) ∧
      (ob0.A[7]?).map (·.mode) = some .observe := by
  have r3 : Reachable K0 [] fa3 := by
    have r0 : Reachable K0 [] fa0 := .enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))
    have r1 : Reachable K0 [] fa1 := .alloc (.write r0 (show Write3Step 1 [1] fa0 (.ok _) from
      .ok (by decide))) (show AllocStep K0 1 0 [(none, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)]
        _ (.ok fa1) from .ok (by decide) trivial)
    have r2 : Reachable K0 [] fa2 := .newArena r1 (show NewArenaStep 4 4 fa1 (.ok fa2) from
      .ok (by decide))
    exact .issue r2 (show IssueAt K0 0 0 [5] 2 fa2 (.ok fa3) from
      .ok (ar := arFa) (by decide) (.ok (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)))
  have he : EnterStep [6, 7] [] ob0 (.ok ob1) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨.enter (.derive (.derive r3 (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) he, he,
    callProtects_of_check (by decide), by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

/-! ### `store` on a leaf (G2) -/

/-- `store` into the reference field of a structure (G2): frame 1 has the structure 0 with the
fields 1 (`ptr`) and 2 (`length`), and the buffer 3. The frame derives 2, `Modify` on 3, and
stores it into the field 1 (expected and obtained: `ok`): the field 1 alone becomes `Init`. A read
of `length` is then rejected, the field 2 being `Uninit` (expected and obtained: reject); after a
write of `length`, the read is accepted (twin, `ok`). A `store` into the whole structure 0 is
rejected, 0 not being a leaf (expected and obtained: reject); into the field 1, accepted (twin). -/
def sf0 : S3 := deriveEff (enter1 [(none, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0),
  (none, none, 0)]) 1 3 .modify
def sf1 : S3 := storeEff sf0 2 1
theorem store_field_length_uninit :
    Reachable K0 [] sf1 ∧ StoreStep 2 1 sf0 (.ok sf1) ∧ sf1.I 1 = .init ∧ sf1.I 2 = .uninit ∧
      Read3Step 0 [2] sf1 .reject ∧
      Read3Step 0 [2] (write3Eff sf1 [2]) (.ok (write3Eff sf1 [2])) ∧
      Write3Step 0 [2] sf1 (.ok (write3Eff sf1 [2])) ∧
      StoreStep 2 0 sf0 .reject := by
  have hs : StoreStep 2 1 sf0 (.ok sf1) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨.store (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) hs, hs,
    by decide, by decide, .reject (by decide), .ok (by decide), .ok (by decide),
    store_nonleaf_rejected (r := 1) (by decide) (by decide)⟩

/-- `store` into a leaf that already holds an authority (G2): frame 1 has the leaves 0, 1 and 2.
The frame derives 3, `Modify` on 1, and stores it into 0 (`ok`); it derives 4, `Modify` on 2: the
`store` of 4 into 0 is rejected, 0 holding 3 (expected and obtained: reject). After the `release`
of 3, which leaves the anchors of 0 (F4), the same `store` is accepted (twin, `ok`). -/
def so0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)]
def so1 : S3 := deriveEff (storeEff (deriveEff so0 1 1 .modify) 3 0) 2 2 .modify
def so2 : S3 := releaseEff so1 3
theorem store_occupied_leaf :
    Reachable K0 [] so1 ∧ StoreStep 4 0 so1 .reject ∧ ReleaseStep 3 so1 (.ok so2) ∧
      StoreStep 4 0 so2 (.ok (storeEff so2 4 0)) ∧ Reachable K0 [] (storeEff so2 4 0) := by
  have r1 : Reachable K0 [] so1 := .derive (.store (.derive (.enter (.init (by decide))
    (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))) (.ok (by decide))
  have hr : ReleaseStep 3 so1 (.ok so2) := .ok (by decide)
  have hs : StoreStep 4 0 so2 (.ok (storeEff so2 4 0)) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨r1, store_occupied_rejected (j := 3) (z := ⟨.modify, some 1, [1], .place 0, true⟩)
    (by decide) rfl rfl, hr, hs, .store (.release r1 hr) hs⟩

/-! ### Progress (F7; G2) -/

/-- A cycle of three authorities on three nodes (F7; G2). Frame 1: 0 arena value, 1 allocator
value, 2, 3 and 4 node values; storage 5 with the nodes 6 (A), 7 (B) and 8 (C), owned by 0, of
root 5; `newArena 5 5`; the blocks 6, 7 and 8 on the nodes are issued to 2, 3 and 4. The frame
derives 9, `Modify` on B from the block 7, stores it into A; 10, `Modify` on C from the block 8,
stores it into B; 11, `Modify` on A from the block 6, and stores it into C: the last `store` is
rejected (expected and obtained), by the clause of arrival of G2: C would be covered by 10 only,
held by B, itself covered by 9 only, held by A, itself covered by 11 only, held by C. -/
def tc0 : S3 := enter1 [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0),
  (none, none, 0)]

def stmt_of(text):
    """text starts right after the theorem name; return the statement up to the top-level ':='."""
    depth=0; lets=0; i=0; n=len(text)
    while i<n:
        c=text[i]
        if c in OPEN: depth+=1
        elif c in CLOSE: depth-=1
        elif depth==0 and text.startswith('let ',i) and (i==0 or not text[i-1].isalnum()): lets+=1
        elif depth==0 and text.startswith(':=',i):
            if lets>0: lets-=1
            else: return text[:i]
        elif depth==0 and text.startswith('\n  |',i): return text[:i]
        i+=1
    return text

### 1. Sûreté démontrée du noyau abstrait séquentiel sur les états atteints

`Reachable k statics` est la clôture de `S3.init statics`, pour un stockage statique valide, par dix-neuf opérations :

Seule hypothèse sur `K` : `DDSound k`.

**Invariants des états atteints** (`reachable_access_invariant_underDD`) : `WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ArenaInv s ar`, avec :
- `WF3` (A1, A4, B1, C3) : la bonne formation de la passe 5, `RootHeld` inchangé ;

La liste de la passe 5, (n) 3, vaut. S'y ajoutent :

2. **Arène sur un stockage quelconque (F2).** Un stockage local ou statique d'arène correspond à une sous-région d'une allocation de MM-02 (pile ou statique). L'écriture des métadonnées correspond à une écriture réelle dans la valeur arène, détentrice de `internal`.

**Pas en cause et clause : `store 8 6` dans `fa7`.** Aucune clause de `StorePre` n'échoue. La seule qui pourrait rejeter est « `Modify` exerçable sur `p` » (`HasRight s .modify 6`), et elle est vraie :

  - **Location:** `issueEff` (l.6794) and `IssueStatic` (l.6805).
  - **Cause:** spec defect. §6 does not name the value that receives the block, and G2 covers only `store`. The current behaviour is the pass-1 reading, (17): « Elle devient `Init` ».

  - **Cause:** formalization (the statement is missing one clause).
  - **What happens:** the docstring says the store is rejected by the G2 arrival clause alone, "every other clause of `StorePre` holding". The statement lists 7 clauses but leaves out the G4 arrival clause `AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff fa7 8 6)`, added to `StorePre` in step 4. That clause does hold, so the fix is to add the conjunct.
  
  ```lean

  #eval decide (HasRight (storeEff fa7 8 6) .modify 6)         -- false
  ```

  - **Location:** `NewArenaPre` / `newArenaEff` (l.7657 / 7671), with `issueEff` and `resetEff` (l.6883).
  - **Cause:** spec defect (silent).
  - **What happens:** `newArena` neither requires nor sets `Init` on the arena value. `issue` or `reset` then marks its metadata `Init`, so the arena value reads `ok` without ever having been written (`i_reach` above, and `reset_meta` in t5.lean).

  - **`StorePre` / `storeEff` against G2:**
    - The target must be a leaf (`isLeaf`).
    - Only `p` changes initialisation and becomes `Init` (`store_writes_one_leaf`).
    - The store is rejected if `p` holds any active authority.
    - Overwriting an `Init` leaf is allowed: `overwrite_init_ok` in t4.lean (write 0, then store into 0) gives `ok`.
  - **The arrival clause:** reading « Modify exerçable par le cadre courant » as `HasRight` is consistent with B2 and pass 6, (c) 6.     - `endUse`: sets leaves to `Uninit`.

content.text:
La passe 7 est commitée, de `68280ce` à `d01fc23`, avec le rapport [MM03_v0.1_p7.md](formal/reports/MM03_v0.1_p7.md), sections (a) à (q). Deux résultats contredisent les attentes de la tâche : F6 reste faux malgré G1, et G2 n'empêche pas les cycles de F7 (a), il en change seulement le chemin. Rien n'est poussé.

**Vérifications**
- `lake build` passe sans avertissement.
- Aucun `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide` ni `noncomputable`.
- Les 580 théorèmes n'utilisent que `propext` et `Quot.sound`, ou moins ; `Classical.choice` n'apparaît nulle part.
- 364 `example` : 5 de la passe 6 sont retirés, chacun justifié en (p).
- `MM02.lean` est inchangé.

**Fait comme demandé**
- **G1** : la clause est dans `EnterPre`, et `enter_params_protected` est prouvé. Les contre-exemples `cp` et `co` de la passe 6 sont rejetés à `enterFrame` ; leur jumeau sur deux locaux distincts passe.
- **G2** : `store` n'écrit plus que dans une feuille libre, la seule à passer à `Init`. La clause d'arrivée est une précondition, réénoncée par `store_keeps_target_reachable`. `store 8 6` dans `fa7` est rejeté, le dernier `store` du cycle à trois nœuds aussi, et F7 (b) reste `ok`.
- **G3** : `NoOrphan` est prouvé sur tous les états atteints, via un invariant auxiliaire (chaque emplacement racine utilisable garde une racine active).
- **G4** : `AnchorOrderHeld` est contrôlé dans l'état d'arrivée des cinq opérations nommées, et préservé par les autres. `lb5` est rejeté au `transfer`, l'émission de l'appelé vers une valeur de l'appelant à l'`issue`. `store_escape_rejected_at_transfer` est réénoncé sur le détenteur ; l'ancien énoncé est gardé sous le nom `anchor_escape_rejected_at_transfer`.

**Résultats qui contredisent la tâche**
1. **`call_protects_params_safe` reste faux** sur des états atteints. Trois mécanismes y échappent à G1 :
   - un ancêtre plus lointain que l'origine directe, passé en paramètre (échec de l'énoncé seulement, sans accès) ;
   - pendant l'appel, l'appelé libère deux autorités qui bloquaient un autre paramètre : l'origine directe devient exerçable, et l'appelé écrit la feuille du paramètre ;
   - à la sortie, le ré-ancrage rattache une autorité dérivée du paramètre à la racine de l'appelant, qui n'en est plus descendante.
2. **Recherche ciblée : la séquence « attendue : aucune » existe** ; c'est le deuxième mécanisme ci-dessus. Le module prouve en revanche que la libération du paramètre, à elle seule, ne découvre jamais son origine (`release_keeps_origin_hidden`).
3. **G2 ne garde que `store`.** Avec une autorité auxiliaire, on atteint quand même :
   - le cycle de F7 (a) et le cycle à trois nœuds, puis on les referme par un `release` ;
   - des cycles du même schéma sur deux feuilles, refermés par `release`, `endUse`, `free` ou la sortie.

   `transfer` et `issue` laissent aussi des autorités détenues que personne ne peut exercer. `NoOrphan` tient dans tous ces états : une racine couvre toujours son emplacement. Lu avec le mode effectif, G3 serait faux.
4. **Lecture d'une feuille jamais écrite.** `transfer` et `issue` rendent `Init` toute la destination. Un champ `length` jamais écrit devient lisible, et une structure entière peut détenir une référence, ce que G2 refuse à `store`. Ce comportement date de la passe 1.

Les contre-exemples sont tous gardés dans le module.

**Choix pris sans texte pour les trancher** (en (c))
- Le contrôle G4 de `issue` ne porte que sur une émission qui aboutit. Sans cela, une émission vers une région indisponible passait de `fail` à `reject` ; elle échoue donc comme en passe 6.
- `alloc` crée des relations de détention mais n'a pas de contrôle G4 : G4 ne le nomme pas, et le module prouve que ce contrôle serait toujours satisfait.

**Questions pour l'arbitrage** (quatre, en (e))
- Quelle règle ou quel énoncé pour F6 ?
- Faut-il étendre la clause de G2 aux autres opérations, ou lire G3 avec l'exerçabilité ?
- Faut-il relier la forme de la destination à celle de la valeur dans `transfer` et `issue` ?
- Faut-il lire A3 strictement, en exigeant que l'appelant soit le cadre qui a dérivé le paramètre ?

**Revues** : une revue adverse à quatre lectures, puis une seconde vérification des corrections et du rapport, avec un juge contradicteur par constat. Tous les constats sont corrigés, ou portés en question quand ils relèvent de l'arbitrage.

Pas vérifié : je n'ai pas relancé de troisième vérification après les dernières retouches, qui sont des conjonctions ajoutées et des reformulations. Je n'ai pas cherché d'autres contournements de G2 que ceux déjà trouvés.

/-! ## Preservation by `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; A4; A5) -/

theorem transfer_P_get (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).P[q]? = (s.P[q]?).map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := .place dst } else pl := by
  simp [transferEff]

theorem transfer_A_get (s : S3) (src dst j : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := .place dst } else y := by
  simp [transferEff]

theorem transfer_len (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).P.length = s.P.length := by simp [transferEff]

theorem transfer_parentOf (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    parentOf (transferEff s src dst).P = parentOf s.P := by
  funext i; simp only [parentOf, transfer_P_get]
  cases s.P[i]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some pl => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl

theorem transfer_footprint (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    footprint (transferEff s src dst).P q = footprint s.P q :=
  footprint_congr (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst) q

theorem transfer_partOf (s : S3) (src dst r q : Nat) :
    partOf (transferEff s src dst).P r q ↔ partOf s.P r q := by
  simp only [partOf, transfer_parentOf, transfer_len]

/-- `transfer` changes no skeleton: it creates and duplicates no authority (O4.3). -/
theorem transfer_skel (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : SameSkel s (transferEff s src dst) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [transferEff], fun j => ?_⟩
  rw [transfer_A_get]
  cases s.A[j]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some y => simp only [Option.map_some]; split <;> rfl

/-- A place usable after the transfer was usable before (A5). -/
theorem transfer_usable_back {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hsrc : s.Usable src) {q : Nat}
    (h : (transferEff s src dst).Usable q) : s.Usable q := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · cases ho
      · exact .frame h' hd ho hf
  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        cases hpo : pl.owner with
        | frame f => rw [hpo] at hh; exact hh.elim
        | place r =>
          rw [hpo] at hh
          exact .place h' hd hpo (usable_of_partOf hwf (r + 1) r src (Nat.lt_succ_self r) hh hsrc)
      · exact .place h' hd ho ih

/-- A place usable before the transfer stays usable when the destination is usable after it
(A5). -/
theorem transfer_usable_fwd {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hd' : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst)
    {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) : (transferEff s src dst).Usable q := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl hd ho hf =>
    exact .frame (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl) hd (by simp [ho, heldIn]) hf
  | @place q o pl hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    by_cases hh : heldIn s.P src (.place o)
    · exact .place (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl) hd (by simp [ho, hh]) hd'
    · exact .place (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; rfl) hd (by simp [ho, hh]) ih

/-- `transfer` preserves `RootHeld` (A4): the holder of a root and the owner of its root place
change together, under the same condition. -/
theorem transfer_rootHeld {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hr : RootHeld s) :
    RootHeld (transferEff s src dst) := by
  intro x z' l r hx ho hl hrp hlr
  rw [transfer_A_get] at hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hx
  have ho' : z.origin = none := by split at ho <;> exact ho
  have hl' : l ∈ z.footprint := by split at hl <;> exact hl
  have hrp' : RootPlace s.P r := by simpa only [RootPlace, transfer_len, transfer_parentOf] using hrp
  have hlr' : partOf s.P l r := (transfer_partOf s src dst l r).1 hlr
  obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hh⟩ := hr x z l r hz ho' hl' hrp' hlr'
  refine ⟨_, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; rfl, ?_⟩
  by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src pr.owner <;> simp [hc, hh]

/-- `transfer` preserves `WF3` and `Inv3base` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; §10; A4; A5). -/
theorem transfer_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨hsrc, -, hdst, -, -, -, -, hd', -, h5, -, -, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  have sk := transfer_skel s src dst
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩ := hinv
  refine ⟨⟨sk.origin hwf.origin, ?_, hwf.ne, hwf.nodup, hwf.frames, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    sk.rootChain hwf.rootChain (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst),
    transfer_rootHeld hwf.rootHeld⟩,
    sk.i1 i1, sk.i2 i2, fun q hq x hx => ?_, i4_always _⟩
  · rw [transfer_len]; exact sk.fp hwf.fp
  · intro q pl f hq ho
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq
      split at ho
      · cases ho
      · exact hwf.ownerFrame q pl₀ f h' ho
  · intro q pl o hq ho
    rw [transfer_len]; rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq
      split at ho
      · cases ho; exact hdst.lt
      · exact hwf.ownerPlace q pl₀ o h' ho
  · intro q pl r hq hp
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hq; cases hq
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hq; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hq; subst hq
      have hp₀ : pl₀.parent = some r := by split at hp <;> exact hp
      obtain ⟨pr, hpr, hlt, ho, hdd⟩ := hwf.parts q pl₀ r h' hp₀
      refine ⟨_, by rw [transfer_P_get, hpr]; rfl, hlt, ?_, hdd⟩
      by_cases hc : heldIn s.P src pl₀.owner <;> simp [hc, ho]
  · intro a y hy ya
    rw [transfer_A_get] at hy
    cases h' : s.A[a]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hy; cases hy
    | some y₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hy; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hy; subst hy
      have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by split at ya <;> exact ya
      have hl := hwf.poss a y₀ h' ya₀
      split
      · exact hd'
      · cases hh : y₀.holder with
        | frame f => rw [hh] at hl; exact hl
        | place p => rw [hh] at hl; exact transfer_usable_fwd hd' hl
  · have hq' := transfer_usable_back hwf hsrc hq
    refine sk.active.2 ?_
    simp only [transferEff] at hx
    split at hx
    · rename_i hqd; subst hqd; rcases List.mem_append.1 hx with hx | hx
      · exact i3 _ hq' x hx
      · exact h5 x hx
    · split at hx
      · simp at hx
      · exact i3 q hq' x hx

/-- `transfer_no_duplicate_authority` (MM-03.3 §3, O4.3; §2, I4; §10; A4): no authority is
created or duplicated, each keeps mode, origin, footprint and activity; the authorities held by
the source or one of its parts are now held by the destination; the others keep their holder,
so a root held by a frame never moves. -/
theorem transfer_no_duplicate_authority {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    SameSkel s s' ∧ ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[b]? = some y →
      s'.A[b]? = some (if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := .place dst } else y) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact ⟨transfer_skel s src dst, fun b y hy => by rw [transfer_A_get, hy]; rfl⟩

/-- Ownership moves with the value (A5): every place owned by the source or one of its parts is
now owned by the destination, and keeps its parent (it does not move). -/
theorem transfer_moves_ownership {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place), s.P[q]? = some pl →
      s'.P[q]? = some (if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := .place dst } else pl) := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact fun q pl hq => by rw [transfer_P_get, hq]; rfl

/-- `transfer_invalidates_source` (MM-03.3 §3, O4; §2, I4): after a transfer, every leaf of the
source is `Moved` and readable by no authority. -/
theorem transfer_invalidates_source {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s'.I l = .moved ∧ ∀ a, ¬ CanReadLeaf s' a l := by
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, -, -, hov, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro l hl
  have hm : (transferEff s src dst).I l = .moved := by
    simp only [transferEff, show l ∉ footprint s.P dst from fun h' => hov ⟨l, hl, h'⟩, hl,
      ↓reduceIte]
  exact ⟨hm, fun a => i4_always _ a l hm⟩

/-- Moved dependencies (MM-03.3.6; MM-03.3 §3, O4): those of the source go with the destination
and leave the source and its parts. -/
theorem transfer_moves_deps {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, x ∈ s'.D dst) ∧ ∀ r, r ≠ dst → partOf s.P r src → s'.D r = [] := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact ⟨fun x hx => by simp [transferEff, hx], fun r hr hp => by simp [transferEff, hr, hp]⟩

/-- F5: an accepted `transfer` has disjoint footprints of source and destination. The clause is
the explicit precondition `¬ overlap s.P src dst` of `TransferPre`. -/
theorem transfer_footprints_disjoint {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, l ∉ footprint s.P dst :=
  fun l hl hl' => (Guarded.ok_iff.1 h).1.2.2.2.2.1 ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩

/-- F5: the clause `¬ overlap s.P src dst` of `TransferPre` is redundant: it follows from clause 1
(source initialised) and clause 2 (destination without an `Init` leaf). It stays explicit (F5:
nothing removed). -/
theorem transfer_overlap_redundant {s : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (h1 : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init)
    (h2 : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) : ¬ overlap s.P src dst :=

    if q = dst then s.D dst ++ depsOf s src else if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q := rfl

theorem depsOf_sub_movedDeps {s : S3} {src x : Nat} (h : x ∈ depsOf s src) :
    x ∈ movedDeps s src := by
  simp only [depsOf, movedDeps, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨r, ⟨hr, hp⟩, hx⟩ := h
  exact ⟨r, ⟨hr, .inl hp⟩, hx⟩

theorem mem_movedDeps_owned {s : S3} {src q x : Nat} (hq : s.Usable q) (ho : OwnedIn s.P src q)
    (hx : x ∈ s.D q) : x ∈ movedDeps s src := by
  simp only [movedDeps, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨q, ⟨hq.lt, .inr ⟨ownedWithin_iff.2 ho, hq⟩⟩, hx⟩

theorem transfer_frameOf_fwd {s : S3} {src dst q f : Nat} (h : FrameOf s q f)
    (hn : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) : FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) q f := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
    exact .frame (pl := pl) (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [ho, heldIn]) ho
  | @place q o f pl hpl ho hf ih =>
    have h1 : ¬ partOf s.P o src := fun hp => hn (.direct hpl ho hp)
    have h2 : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src o := fun ho' => hn (.step hpl ho ho')
    exact .place (pl := pl) (by rw [transfer_P_get, hpl]; simp [ho, heldIn, h1]) ho (ih h2)

theorem transfer_frameOf_back {s : S3} {src dst q f : Nat} (h : FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) q f) :
    (FrameOf s q f ∧ ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) ∨
      (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) dst f) := by
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · cases ho
      · left; refine ⟨.frame h' ho, fun hn => ?_⟩
        cases hn with
        | direct h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
        | step h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
  | @place q o f pl hpl ho hf ih =>
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · rename_i hh
        cases ho
        cases hpo : pl₀.owner with
        | frame g => rw [hpo] at hh; exact hh.elim
        | place r => rw [hpo] at hh; exact .inr ⟨.direct h' hpo hh, hf⟩
      · rename_i hh
        rcases ih with ⟨hf0, hn⟩ | ⟨ho', hd⟩
        · left; refine ⟨.place h' ho hf0, fun hq => ?_⟩
          cases hq with
          | direct h1 h2 h3 =>
            rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact hh (by rw [ho]; exact h3)

/-- The destination of an accepted transfer is not owned by the source: its owner chain would
come back to it (A5). -/
theorem transfer_dst_not_owned {s : S3} {src dst f : Nat} :
    ∀ {q}, FrameOf (transferEff s src dst) q f → OwnedIn s.P src q → ¬ OwnedIn s.P src dst := by
  intro q h
  induction h with
  | @frame q f pl hpl ho =>
    intro hq _
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · cases ho
      · cases hq with
        | direct h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
        | step h1 h2 _ => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2
  | @place q o f pl hpl ho hf ih =>
    intro hq hd
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hpl
    cases h' : s.P[q]? with
    | none => rw [h'] at hpl; cases hpl
    | some pl₀ =>
      rw [h'] at hpl; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hpl; subst hpl
      split at ho
      · cases ho; exact ih hd hd
      · rename_i hh
        cases hq with
        | direct h1 h2 h3 =>
          rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact hh (by rw [ho]; exact h3)
        | step h1 h2 h3 => rw [h'] at h1; cases h1; rw [ho] at h2; cases h2; exact ih h3 hd

theorem transfer_pframe_unmoved {s : S3} {src dst q : Nat} (hn : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q) :
    (transferEff s src dst).pframe q = s.pframe q :=
  Option.ext fun f => by
    rw [pframe_iff, pframe_iff]
    exact ⟨fun h => (transfer_frameOf_back h).elim (fun h => h.1) (fun h => absurd h.1 hn),
      fun h => transfer_frameOf_fwd h hn⟩

/-- An anchor whose effective anchor does not move with the value keeps its order (B8, C1; A4,
A5). -/
theorem transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved {s : S3} {src dst x : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? = some z) (hm : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x))
    (fd : Option Nat) :
    EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  have hm' : ¬ HolderMoves s src z.holder := by unfold AnchorMoves at hm; rw [hz] at hm; exact hm
  have hnh : ¬ heldIn s.P src z.holder := by
    cases hh : z.holder with
    | frame g => simp [heldIn]
    | place p => rw [hh] at hm'; exact fun h => hm' (.inl h)
  have he : (transferEff s src dst).effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x :=
    effAnchor_congr (by rw [(transfer_skel s src dst).ancs])
  refine effAnchorOK_of_same (z' := z) hz (by rw [he, transfer_A_get, hz]; simp [hnh]) ?_
    (fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl) rfl
  cases hh : z.holder with
  | frame g => rfl
  | place p =>
    rw [hh] at hm'
    exact transfer_pframe_unmoved (fun ho => hm' (.inr (ownedWithin_iff.2 ho)))

/-- `transfer` preserves `AnchorOrder` (B8, C1; MM-03.3 §3, O4; MM-03.3.6), under `WF3`: when the
effective anchor or the dependent moves, by the clause B8; otherwise both frames are unchanged. -/
theorem transfer_preserves_anchorOrder {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hao : AnchorOrder s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨hsrc, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, h8, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  intro q hq x hx
  by_cases hm : AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q
  · exact h8 q (List.mem_range.2 (by have := hq.lt; rwa [transfer_len] at this)) hq x hx hm
  have hm1 : ¬ AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) := fun e => hm (.inl e)
  have hm2 : q ≠ dst := fun e => hm (.inr (.inl e))
  have hown : ¬ OwnedIn s.P src q := fun e => hm (.inr (.inr (ownedWithin_iff.2 e)))
  have hq0 := transfer_usable_back hwf hsrc hq
  rw [transfer_D] at hx; simp only [hm2, ↓reduceIte] at hx
  split at hx
  · simp at hx
  · have hok := hao q hq0 x hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hok.get
    rw [transfer_pframe_unmoved hown]
    exact (transfer_effAnchorOK_unmoved hz hm1 _).2 hok

replaces an anchor by an authority of its chain, which has the same effective anchor, and the
frame of a usable place stays below the popped frame. -/

import Ern.MM03
namespace Ern.MM03

/-! ## Shape of a value (J1) -/

/-- Children of the place `x` (MM-03.3.2), in index order. -/
def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)

/-- Position of `r` in a list (its length if absent). -/
def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1

/-- The part of `dst` that corresponds to the part `r` of `src` (J1), searched within `n` steps:
`dst` for `src`; for another part, the child, at the same position among the children ordered by
index, of the place that corresponds to its parent. -/
def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
      match parentOf P r with
      | some p => if p < r then
          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
      | none => none

/-- The part of `dst` that corresponds to the part `r` of `src` (J1). -/
def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r

/-- J1, « `dst` a la même forme que `src` (sous-arbres isomorphes) »: every part of `src` has a
corresponding part of `dst` with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part
of `src`. Children are matched in index order (ordered isomorphism). -/
def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z

instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
  unfold SameShape; infer_instance

theorem mem_kids {P : List Place} {x r : Nat} :
    r ∈ kids P x ↔ r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = some x := by
  simp [kids, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

theorem kids_nil_iff {P : List Place} {l : Nat} : kids P l = [] ↔ isLeaf P l := by
  constructor
  · intro h r hr hp
    have : r ∈ kids P l := mem_kids.2 ⟨hr, hp⟩
    rw [h] at this; simp at this
  · intro h
    exact nil_of_forall_not_mem fun r hr => by
      obtain ⟨hr, hp⟩ := mem_kids.1 hr; exact h r hr hp

theorem corrF_fuel (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) :
    ∀ n m r, r ≤ n → r ≤ m → corrF P src dst n r = corrF P src dst m r
  | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | 0, m + 1, r, h, _ => by
    obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
    simp only [corrF]; split
    · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · omega
        · rfl
      · rfl
  | n + 1, 0, r, _, h => by
    obtain rfl : r = 0 := by omega
    simp only [corrF]; split
    · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · omega
        · rfl
      · rfl
  | n + 1, m + 1, r, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [corrF]; split
    · rfl
    · split
      · split
        · rw [corrF_fuel P src dst n m _ (by omega) (by omega)]
        · rfl
      · rfl

theorem corr_src (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : corr P src dst src = some dst := by
  unfold corr; cases src <;> simp [corrF]

theorem corr_step {P : List Place} {src dst r p : Nat} (hr : r ≠ src)
    (hp : parentOf P r = some p) (hlt : p < r) :
    corr P src dst r = (corr P src dst p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, r = n + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
  unfold corr
  simp only [corrF, hr, ↓reduceIte, hp, hlt]
  rw [corrF_fuel P src dst n p _ (by omega) (Nat.le_refl p)]

theorem getElem?_mem {l : List Nat} {i x : Nat} (h : l[i]? = some x) : x ∈ l :=
  List.mem_of_getElem? h

/-- The place corresponding to a part of `src` is a part of `dst` (J1). -/
theorem corr_partOf {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst : Nat} (hd : dst < s.P.length) :
    ∀ n r r', r < n → corr s.P src dst r = some r' → partOf s.P r' dst
  | 0, _, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, r, r', hr, h => by
    by_cases e : r = src
    · subst e; rw [corr_src] at h; cases h; exact ⟨hd, .inl rfl⟩
    cases hp : parentOf s.P r with
    | none =>
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, r = m + 1 ∨ r = 0 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
      unfold corr at h
      cases r with
      | zero => simp [corrF, e] at h
      | succ m => simp [corrF, e, hp] at h
    | some p =>
      have hlt := (hw.parent_lt hp).1
      rw [corr_step e hp hlt] at h
      cases hc : corr s.P src dst p with
      | none => rw [hc] at h; cases h
      | some p' =>
        rw [hc] at h; simp only [Option.bind_some] at h
        have ih := corr_partOf hw hd n p p' (by omega) hc
        obtain ⟨hr'l, hr'p⟩ := mem_kids.1 (getElem?_mem h)
        have hlt' := (hw.parent_lt hr'p).1
        refine ⟨hr'l, .inr ?_⟩
        rw [chain_cons hr'p hlt']
        rcases ih.2 with rfl | hc'
        · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
        · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc'

#print axioms corr_partOf
#print axioms corrF_fuel
end Ern.MM03
