result.output:
1	/-!
2	# ERN — Memory Model v0.3, MM-02 (machine abstraite minimale)
3	
4	Modèle exploratoire de MM-02. Chaque définition et chaque théorème cite la
5	règle MM-02.x qu'il modélise ; le texte des règles reste dans la spécification.
6	`State.write`, `State.dealloc`, `State.alloc` : effet d'une opération valide.
7	`ReadStep`, `WriteStep`, `DeallocStep`, `AllocStep` : sémantique des opérations
8	brutes, relation entre un état et son issue `ok` ou `ub` (MM-02.H), définie pour
9	tout état, sans décision des obligations ni des préconditions ; la lecture rend
10	la valeur lue (`ReadOutcome`) et n'a pas d'effet sur l'état.
11	`read`, `write`, `dealloc`, `alloc` : interpréteurs de ces relations. Chacun
12	reçoit en argument de preuve les conditions établies statiquement (part `stat`
13	pour `read`, `write` ; `WF` pour `alloc` ; aucune pour `dealloc`) et n'est
14	appelable que sur ce domaine. Tout résultat rendu par `write`, `dealloc`,
15	`alloc` est une issue de la relation ; pour `read`, qui rend une `Outcome`,
16	l'accord porte sur l'état, la valeur lue par `readBytes` et l'issue
17	(`read_sound_ok`, `read_sound_ub`).
18	`checkedRead`, `checkedWrite`, `checkedDealloc` : variantes vérifiées,
19	vérifications instrumentées du modèle exploratoire et non primitives d'ERN. Ces
20	fonctions sont calculables, sans décision classique.
21	Obligations non décidées par le noyau (MM-02.B.4, B.6, B.7 ; MM-02.C.4, C.5,
22	C.6) : `ReadOblSpec`, `WriteOblSpec`, formées d'une part décidable `dec` et d'une
23	part statique `stat`, paramètres des relations, qui exigent les deux pour
24	l'issue `ok` ; `ReadObl`, `WriteObl` y ajoutent une décision de `dec` et
25	paramètrent les fonctions. `Compatible`, `ObR`, `ObW` sont fixés pour toute une
26	exécution (`Reachable`, `ReachableStep`).
27	Non couverts : MM-02.1, MM-02.F, MM-02.G, MM-03.
28	-/
29	
30	namespace Ern.MM02
31	
32	/-- MM-02.5 : autorité d'accès. -/
33	inductive Auth where
34	  | read
35	  | write
36	  deriving DecidableEq
37	
38	/-- MM-02.5 : ordre des autorités, `read ≤ write` (réflexif). -/
39	instance : LE Auth := ⟨fun a b => a = .read ∨ b = .write⟩
40	
41	/-- MM-02.5 : l'ordre des autorités est décidable. -/
42	instance (a b : Auth) : Decidable (a ≤ b) :=
43	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (a = .read ∨ b = .write))
44	
45	/-- MM-02.3 : octet abstrait, non initialisé ou initialisé avec une valeur
46	d'octet sur 8 bits (`val`) et une provenance optionnelle (`prov`, identité
47	d'allocation). -/
48	inductive AByte where
49	  | uninit
50	  | init (val : UInt8) (prov : Option Nat)
51	  deriving DecidableEq, Repr
52	
53	/-- MM-02.2 : allocation abstraite. Son identité est sa clé dans `State.allocs`.
54	`space` espace d'adressage, `base` adresse de base, `size` étendue, `align` alignement, `live` état
55	d'existence, `bytes` stockage indexé par décalage depuis `base`,
56	`freeAuth` jeton de désallocation : si `freeAuth = some d`, les autorités
57	capables de la désallouer (MM-02.2) sont les `auth` telles que
58	`Compatible auth d` (MM-02.D) ; `none` si la désallocation n'est pas applicable. -/
59	structure Alloc where
60	  space : Nat
61	  base : Nat
62	  size : Nat
63	  align : Nat
64	  live : Bool
65	  bytes : Nat → AByte
66	  freeAuth : Option Nat
67	
68	/-- MM-02.4 : emplacement, allocation (`alloc`, identité) et portion de son
69	stockage (`off` décalage, `len` longueur). Interprétation typée et conditions
70	d'accès non modélisées. -/
71	structure Place where
72	  alloc : Nat
73	  off : Nat
74	  len : Nat
75	
76	/-- MM-02.5 : moyen d'accès. `addr` adresse, `prov` provenance (identité
77	d'allocation, sans étiquette : lecture fixée par la tâche), `len` plage,
78	`auth` autorité. -/
79	structure Access where
80	  addr : Nat
81	  prov : Nat
82	  len : Nat
83	  auth : Auth
84	
85	/-- État de la machine abstraite : allocations par identité (MM-02.2) et
86	prochaine identité fraîche `next` (MM-02.A). -/
87	structure State where
88	  allocs : Nat → Option Alloc
89	  next : Nat
90	
91	/-- MM-02.A : invariant de fraîcheur, toute identité utilisée est `< next`. -/
92	def WF (s : State) : Prop := ∀ i, s.next ≤ i → s.allocs i = none
93	
94	/-- MM-02.B.2 et MM-02.C.2 : validité spatiale, la plage de l'accès est incluse
95	dans l'étendue de l'allocation. -/
96	def Spatial (a : Alloc) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
97	  a.base ≤ ac.addr ∧ ac.addr + ac.len ≤ a.base + a.size
98	
99	/-- MM-02.B.3 : les `len` octets à partir du décalage `off` sont initialisés. -/
100	def Alloc.InitRange (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : Prop :=
101	  ∀ i, i < len → a.bytes (off + i) ≠ .uninit
102	
103	/-- MM-02.B.3 : l'initialisation d'une plage est décidable (quantification bornée). -/
104	instance (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : Decidable (a.InitRange off len) :=
105	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ i, i < len → a.bytes (off + i) ≠ .uninit))
106	
107	/-- MM-02.B : lecture typée permise. Conditions 1 (stockage vivant),
108	2 (spatial), 3 (initialisation), 5 (autorité de lecture). -/
109	def Read (s : State) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
110	  ∃ a, s.allocs ac.prov = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧
111	    a.InitRange (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len ∧ Auth.read ≤ ac.auth
112	
113	/-- MM-02.C : écriture typée permise. Conditions 1 (stockage vivant),
114	2 (spatial), 3 (autorité d'écriture). -/
115	def CanWrite (s : State) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
116	  ∃ a, s.allocs ac.prov = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧ Auth.write ≤ ac.auth
117	
118	/-- MM-02.B : la validité spatiale est décidable. -/
119	instance (a : Alloc) (ac : Access) : Decidable (Spatial a ac) :=
120	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (a.base ≤ ac.addr ∧ ac.addr + ac.len ≤ a.base + a.size))
121	
122	/-- MM-02.B : les conditions du noyau d'une lecture (`Read`) sont décidables. -/
123	instance (s : State) (ac : Access) : Decidable (Read s ac) :=
124	  match h : s.allocs ac.prov with
125	  | some a =>
126	    if hc : a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧ a.InitRange (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len ∧
127	        Auth.read ≤ ac.auth then isTrue ⟨a, h, hc⟩
128	    else isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ => hc (by rw [h] at hb; cases hb; exact hb')
129	  | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _⟩ => by rw [h] at hb; cases hb
130	
131	/-- MM-02.C : les conditions du noyau d'une écriture (`CanWrite`) sont décidables. -/
132	instance (s : State) (ac : Access) : Decidable (CanWrite s ac) :=
133	  match h : s.allocs ac.prov with
134	  | some a =>
135	    if hc : a.live = true ∧ Spatial a ac ∧ Auth.write ≤ ac.auth then isTrue ⟨a, h, hc⟩
136	    else isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ => hc (by rw [h] at hb; cases hb; exact hb')
137	  | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _⟩ => by rw [h] at hb; cases hb
138	
139	/-- MM-02.4 : résolution partielle d'un moyen d'accès vers un emplacement :
140	`some` exactement quand la provenance désigne une allocation existante et que la
141	plage de l'accès y est spatialement contenue (MM-02.B). -/
142	def Access.toPlace (s : State) (ac : Access) : Option Place :=
143	  match s.allocs ac.prov with
144	  | some a => if Spatial a ac then some ⟨ac.prov, ac.addr - a.base, ac.len⟩ else none
145	  | none => none
146	
147	/-- MM-02.B et MM-02.4 : lecture permise formulée sur l'emplacement résolu.
148	Condition 2 portée par la résolution ; conditions 1, 3, 5 vérifiées séparément. -/
149	def ReadPlace (s : State) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
150	  ∃ p, ac.toPlace s = some p ∧ ∃ a, s.allocs p.alloc = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧
151	    a.InitRange p.off p.len ∧ Auth.read ≤ ac.auth
152	
153	/-- MM-02.C et MM-02.4 : écriture permise formulée sur l'emplacement résolu.
154	Condition 2 portée par la résolution ; conditions 1, 3 vérifiées séparément. -/
155	def CanWritePlace (s : State) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
156	  ∃ p, ac.toPlace s = some p ∧ ∃ a, s.allocs p.alloc = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧
157	    Auth.write ≤ ac.auth
158	
159	/-- MM-02.B et MM-02.3 : les `len` octets de `a` à partir du décalage `off`. -/
160	def Alloc.bytesAt (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : List AByte :=
161	  (List.range len).map fun i => a.bytes (off + i)
162	
163	/-- MM-02.B et MM-02.H : lecture d'octets par `ac` satisfaisant les conditions du
164	noyau (`Read`) ; rend les octets de la plage désignée. Ne valide pas les
165	obligations de lecture typée (conditions 4, 6, 7). -/
166	def readBytes (s : State) (ac : Access) : Option (List AByte) :=
167	  match s.allocs ac.prov with
168	  | some a => if Read s ac then some (a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len) else none
169	  | none => none
170	
171	/-- MM-02.C : effet d'une écriture sur le stockage. Les `len` octets à partir
172	du décalage `off` deviennent `init`, avec `w i = (valeur, provenance)` du
173	i-ème octet écrit ; les autres octets sont inchangés. -/
174	def Alloc.write (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : Alloc :=
175	  { a with bytes := fun j =>
176	      if off ≤ j ∧ j < off + len then .init (w (j - off)).1 (w (j - off)).2 else a.bytes j }
177	
178	/-- MM-02.C : effet d'une écriture par le moyen d'accès `ac` sur l'état. -/
179	def State.write (s : State) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) : State :=
180	  { s with allocs := fun i =>
181	      if i = ac.prov then (s.allocs i).map (fun a => a.write (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len w)
182	      else s.allocs i }
183	
184	/-- MM-02.D : désallocation permise de l'allocation `id` avec l'autorité `auth` :
185	allocation vivante et désallouable (`freeAuth = some d`), autorité compatible
186	selon la relation paramétrique `Compatible`. -/
187	def CanDealloc (Compatible : Nat → Nat → Prop) (s : State) (id auth : Nat) : Prop :=
188	  ∃ a, s.allocs id = some a ∧ a.live = true ∧ ∃ d, a.freeAuth = some d ∧ Compatible auth d
189	
190	/-- MM-02.D : `CanDealloc` est décidable quand la compatibilité l'est. -/
191	instance {Compatible : Nat → Nat → Prop} [DecidableRel Compatible] (s : State) (id auth : Nat) :
192	    Decidable (CanDealloc Compatible s id auth) :=
193	  match h : s.allocs id with
194	  | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _⟩ => by rw [h] at hb; cases hb
195	  | some a =>
196	    match hf : a.freeAuth with
197	    | none => isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, _, d, hd, _⟩ => by
198	        rw [h] at hb
199	        cases hb
200	        rw [hf] at hd
201	        cases hd
202	    | some d =>
203	      if hc : a.live = true ∧ Compatible auth d then isTrue ⟨a, h, hc.1, d, hf, hc.2⟩
204	      else isFalse fun ⟨b, hb, hl, d', hd', hc'⟩ => hc (by
205	        rw [h] at hb
206	        cases hb
207	        rw [hf] at hd'
208	        cases hd'
209	        exact ⟨hl, hc'⟩)
210	
211	/-- MM-02.D : effet d'une désallocation, l'allocation `id` cesse d'exister
212	(état mort) ; son identité reste consommée (MM-02.A). -/
213	def State.dealloc (s : State) (id : Nat) : State :=
214	  { s with allocs := fun i =>
215	      if i = id then (s.allocs i).map (fun a => { a with live := false }) else s.allocs i }
216	
217	/-- MM-02.2 et MM-02.A : nouvelle allocation sous l'identité fraîche `s.next`,
218	vivante ; MM-02.3 : allocation brute nouvellement créée, octets tous `uninit`. -/
219	def State.alloc (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) : State :=
220	  { allocs := fun i =>
221	      if i = s.next then
222	        some { space, base, size, align, live := true, bytes := fun _ => .uninit, freeAuth }
223	      else s.allocs i
224	    next := s.next + 1 }
225	
226	/-- MM-02.2 (LiveDisjoint) : les plages semi-ouvertes `[b1, b1 + n1)` et
227	`[b2, b2 + n2)` ont une intersection vide. -/
228	def RangeDisjoint (b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat) : Prop :=
229	  ∀ x, b1 ≤ x → x < b1 + n1 → b2 ≤ x → x < b2 + n2 → False
230	
231	/-- MM-02.2 (LiveDisjoint) : forme arithmétique de la disjonction de deux plages
232	semi-ouvertes. -/
233	theorem rangeDisjoint_iff {b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat} :
234	    RangeDisjoint b1 n1 b2 n2 ↔ b1 + n1 ≤ b2 ∨ b2 + n2 ≤ b1 ∨ n1 = 0 ∨ n2 = 0 := by
235	  constructor
236	  · intro h
237	    rcases Nat.le_total b1 b2 with h12 | h12
238	    · by_cases hlt : b2 < b1 + n1
239	      · by_cases hn : 0 < n2
240	        · exact (h b2 h12 hlt (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega)).elim
241	        · omega
242	      · omega
243	    · by_cases hlt : b1 < b2 + n2
244	      · by_cases hn : 0 < n1
245	        · exact (h b1 (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega) h12 hlt).elim
246	        · omega
247	      · omega
248	  · intro h x h1 h2 h3 h4
249	    omega
250	
251	/-- MM-02.2 (LiveDisjoint) : la disjonction de deux plages est décidable. -/
252	instance (b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat) : Decidable (RangeDisjoint b1 n1 b2 n2) :=
253	  decidable_of_iff _ rangeDisjoint_iff.symm
254	
255	/-- MM-02.2 (LiveDisjoint) : deux allocations vivantes distinctes du même espace
256	d'adressage occupent des plages disjointes. -/
257	def LiveDisjoint (s : State) : Prop :=
258	  ∀ i j a b, i ≠ j → s.allocs i = some a → s.allocs j = some b →
259	    a.live = true → b.live = true → a.space = b.space →
260	    RangeDisjoint a.base a.size b.base b.size
261	
262	/-- MM-02.2 : `n` est une puissance de deux. -/
263	def Pow2 (n : Nat) : Prop := ∃ k, n = 2 ^ k
264	
265	/-- MM-02.2 : forme bornée de `Pow2`, l'exposant est au plus `n`. -/
266	theorem pow2_iff (n : Nat) : Pow2 n ↔ ∃ k, k < n + 1 ∧ n = 2 ^ k :=
267	  ⟨fun ⟨k, hk⟩ => ⟨k, by have := @Nat.lt_two_pow_self k; omega, hk⟩, fun ⟨k, _, hk⟩ => ⟨k, hk⟩⟩
268	
269	/-- MM-02.2 : `Pow2` est décidable. -/
270	instance (n : Nat) : Decidable (Pow2 n) :=
271	  decidable_of_iff _ (pow2_iff n).symm
272	
273	/-- MM-02.2 (création brute) : précondition de création d'une allocation vivante
274	dans l'espace `space` : identité `s.next` fraîche, alignement strictement positif
275	et puissance de deux, base alignée, plage disjointe de celle de toute allocation
276	vivante du même espace (`LiveDisjoint`). -/
277	def AllocPre (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) : Prop :=
278	  s.allocs s.next = none ∧ 0 < align ∧ Pow2 align ∧ base % align = 0 ∧
279	    ∀ i a, s.allocs i = some a → a.live = true → a.space = space →
280	      RangeDisjoint a.base a.size base size
281	
282	/-- MM-02.2 (LiveDisjoint) : l'entrée `o` d'une identité ne chevauche pas la plage
283	`[base, base + size)` de l'espace `space` : absente, morte, d'un autre espace, ou
284	disjointe. -/
285	def NoOverlap (space base size : Nat) : Option Alloc → Prop
286	  | some a => a.live = true → a.space = space → RangeDisjoint a.base a.size base size
287	  | none => True
288	
289	/-- MM-02.2 (LiveDisjoint) : `NoOverlap` est décidable. -/
290	instance (space base size : Nat) : (o : Option Alloc) → Decidable (NoOverlap space base size o)
291	  | some a => inferInstanceAs
292	      (Decidable (a.live = true → a.space = space → RangeDisjoint a.base a.size base size))
293	  | none => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
294	
295	/-- MM-02.2 (création brute) : forme décidable de `AllocPre`, le non-chevauchement
296	n'étant vérifié que sur les identités `< next`. -/
297	def AllocPreDec (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) : Prop :=
298	  s.allocs s.next = none ∧ 0 < align ∧ Pow2 align ∧ base % align = 0 ∧
299	    ∀ i, i < s.next → NoOverlap space base size (s.allocs i)
300	
301	/-- MM-02.2 (création brute) : `AllocPreDec` est décidable. -/
302	instance (s : State) (space base size align : Nat) :
303	    Decidable (AllocPreDec s space base size align) := by
304	  unfold AllocPreDec
305	  infer_instance
306	
307	/-- MM-02.2 (création brute) et MM-02.A : sous l'invariant de fraîcheur,
308	`AllocPreDec` équivaut à `AllocPre`. -/
309	theorem allocPreDec_iff {s : State} (hwf : WF s) {space base size align : Nat} :
310	    AllocPreDec s space base size align ↔ AllocPre s space base size align := by
311	  constructor
312	  · rintro ⟨hf, h0, h2, hm, hd⟩
313	    refine ⟨hf, h0, h2, hm, fun i a ha hl hsp => ?_⟩
314	    have hi : i < s.next := Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hle => by rw [hwf i hle] at ha; cases ha
315	    have := hd i hi
316	    rw [ha] at this
317	    exact this hl hsp
318	  · rintro ⟨hf, h0, h2, hm, hd⟩
319	    refine ⟨hf, h0, h2, hm, fun i _ => ?_⟩
320	    cases ha : s.allocs i with
321	    | none => trivial
322	    | some a => exact fun hl hsp => hd i a ha hl hsp
323	
324	/-- MM-02.2 : toute allocation enregistrée, vivante ou morte, a un alignement
325	strictement positif, puissance de deux, auquel sa base satisfait. -/
326	def Aligned (s : State) : Prop :=
327	  ∀ i a, s.allocs i = some a → 0 < a.align ∧ Pow2 a.align ∧ a.base % a.align = 0
328	
329	/-- MM-02.A et MM-02.2 : invariant global de l'état : fraîcheur des identités,
330	`LiveDisjoint` et alignement valide. -/
331	def Inv (s : State) : Prop := WF s ∧ LiveDisjoint s ∧ Aligned s
332	
333	/-- MM-02.2 : état initial, sans allocation, prochaine identité `0`. -/
334	def State.empty : State := ⟨fun _ => none, 0⟩
335	
336	/-- MM-02.E : `ac'` est dérivé de `ac` : sous-plage, même provenance,
337	autorité au plus celle de l'origine. -/
338	def Derive (ac ac' : Access) : Prop :=
339	  ac.addr ≤ ac'.addr ∧ ac'.addr + ac'.len ≤ ac.addr + ac.len ∧
340	    ac'.prov = ac.prov ∧ ac'.auth ≤ ac.auth
341	
342	/-- MM-02.B.4, B.6, B.7 : obligations de lecture typée non décidées par le noyau,
343	sans procédure de décision. `dec` : part décidable ; `stat` : part statique.
344	`ReadStep` exige les deux pour l'issue `ok`. -/
345	structure ReadOblSpec where
346	  dec : State → Access → Prop
347	  stat : State → Access → Prop
348	
349	/-- MM-02.B.4, B.6, B.7 et MM-01.3 : obligations de lecture munies d'une décision
350	de `dec` (`decInst`), testée par les fonctions ; `stat` est reçue en hypothèse
351	par les fonctions. -/
352	structure ReadObl extends toSpec : ReadOblSpec where
353	  decInst : ∀ s, DecidablePred (dec s)
354	
355	attribute [instance] ReadObl.decInst
356	
357	/-- MM-02.C.4, C.5, C.6 : obligations d'écriture typée non décidées par le noyau,
358	sans procédure de décision. `dec` : part décidable ; `stat` : part statique.
359	`WriteStep` exige les deux pour l'issue `ok`. -/
360	structure WriteOblSpec where
361	  dec : State → Access → (Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → Prop
362	  stat : State → Access → (Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → Prop
363	
364	/-- MM-02.C.4, C.5, C.6 et MM-01.3 : obligations d'écriture munies d'une décision
365	de `dec` (`decInst`), testée par les fonctions ; `stat` est reçue en hypothèse
366	par les fonctions. -/
367	structure WriteObl extends toSpec : WriteOblSpec where
368	  decInst : ∀ s ac, DecidablePred (dec s ac)
369	
370	attribute [instance] WriteObl.decInst
371	
372	/-- MM-02.H : issue d'une opération brute : effet défini `ok` (nouvel état) ou
373	comportement indéfini `ub` (MM-01.5). Issue des interpréteurs et des relations
374	`WriteStep`, `DeallocStep`, `AllocStep` ; `ReadStep` rend une `ReadOutcome`. -/
375	inductive Outcome where
376	  | ok (s : State)
377	  | ub
378	
379	/-- MM-02.H et MM-02.B : issue d'une lecture brute : valeur lue `ok v` (la
380	lecture n'a pas d'effet sur l'état) ou comportement indéfini `ub` (MM-01.5). -/
381	inductive ReadOutcome where
382	  | ok (v : List AByte)
383	  | ub
384	
385	/-- MM-02.H : issue d'une variante vérifiée rendant une valeur de type `α` :
386	`ok` (nouvel état et valeur), échec défini `fail` rendu sans entrer dans
387	l'opération, avec l'état d'entrée (MM-01.3), ou `ub`. -/
388	inductive Outcome' (α : Type) where
389	  | ok (s : State) (v : α)
390	  | fail (s : State)
391	  | ub
392	
393	/-- MM-02.H : projection booléenne d'une issue brute : `true` ssi `ok`. -/
394	def Outcome.isOk : Outcome → Bool
395	  | .ok _ => true
396	  | .ub => false
397	
398	/-- MM-02.H : projection booléenne d'une issue vérifiée : `true` ssi `ok`. -/
399	def Outcome'.isOk {α : Type} : Outcome' α → Bool
400	  | .ok _ _ => true
401	  | _ => false
402	
403	/-- MM-02.H : projection booléenne d'une issue vérifiée : `true` ssi `fail`. -/
404	def Outcome'.isFail {α : Type} : Outcome' α → Bool
405	  | .fail _ => true
406	  | _ => false
407	
408	/-- MM-02.H : valeur rendue par une issue vérifiée `ok`, s'il y en a une. -/
409	def Outcome'.value? {α : Type} : Outcome' α → Option α
410	  | .ok _ v => some v
411	  | _ => none
412	
413	/-- MM-02.H : une issue d'opération brute vue comme issue de variante vérifiée,
414	avec la valeur `v` en cas de succès. -/
415	def Outcome.lift {α : Type} (o : Outcome) (v : α) : Outcome' α :=
416	  match o with
417	  | .ok s => .ok s v
418	  | .ub => .ub
419	
420	/-- MM-02.B, MM-02.H et MM-01.5 : sémantique d'une lecture brute par `ac` dans
421	l'état `s`. Issue `ok v`, où `v` est la suite des octets de la plage désignée
422	dans l'allocation `a` de la provenance, si les conditions 1, 2, 3, 5 (`Read`),
423	la part décidable `ObR.dec` et la part statique `ObR.stat` (conditions 4, 6, 7)
424	sont satisfaites ; issue `ub` sinon, violation de la part statique comprise. La
425	lecture n'a pas d'effet sur l'état. La part statique est la frontière avec la
426	sémantique concurrente (Spec 2, MM-02.F) et n'est pas modélisée ici ; la
427	répartition des conditions entre `dec` et `stat` n'est pas fixée. -/
428	inductive ReadStep (ObR : ReadOblSpec) (ac : Access) (s : State) : ReadOutcome → Prop where
429	  | ok {a : Alloc} : s.allocs ac.prov = some a → Read s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac ∧ ObR.stat s ac →
430	      ReadStep ObR ac s (.ok (a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len))
431	  | ub : ¬ (Read s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac ∧ ObR.stat s ac) → ReadStep ObR ac s .ub
432	
433	/-- MM-02.C, MM-02.H et MM-01.5 : sémantique d'une écriture brute de `w` par `ac`
434	dans l'état `s`. Issue `ok` avec l'effet `State.write` si les conditions 1, 2, 3
435	(`CanWrite`), la part décidable `ObW.dec` et la part statique `ObW.stat`
436	(conditions 4, 5, 6) sont satisfaites ; issue `ub` sinon, violation de la part
437	statique comprise. La part statique est la frontière avec la sémantique
438	concurrente (Spec 2, MM-02.F) et n'est pas modélisée ici ; la répartition des
439	conditions entre `dec` et `stat` n'est pas fixée. -/
440	inductive WriteStep (ObW : WriteOblSpec) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : State) :
441	    Outcome → Prop where
442	  | ok : CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac w ∧ ObW.stat s ac w →
443	      WriteStep ObW ac w s (.ok (s.write ac w))
444	  | ub : ¬ (CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac w ∧ ObW.stat s ac w) → WriteStep ObW ac w s .ub
445	
446	/-- MM-02.D, MM-02.H et MM-01.5 : sémantique d'une désallocation brute de `id`
447	avec l'autorité `auth` dans l'état `s`. Issue `ok` avec l'effet `State.dealloc`
448	si `CanDealloc` ; issue `ub` sinon. `Compatible` n'est pas supposée décidable. -/
449	inductive DeallocStep (Compatible : Nat → Nat → Prop) (id auth : Nat) (s : State) :
450	    Outcome → Prop where
451	  | ok : CanDealloc Compatible s id auth → DeallocStep Compatible id auth s (.ok (s.dealloc id))
452	  | ub : ¬ CanDealloc Compatible s id auth → DeallocStep Compatible id auth s .ub
453	
454	/-- MM-02.2 (création brute), MM-02.H et MM-01.5 : sémantique d'une allocation
455	brute dans l'état `s`. Issue `ok` avec l'effet `State.alloc` si `AllocPre`
456	(non-chevauchement vérifié sur toute identité) ; issue `ub` sinon. -/
457	inductive AllocStep (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) (s : State) :
458	    Outcome → Prop where
459	  | ok : AllocPre s space base size align →
460	      AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s (.ok (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth))
461	  | ub : ¬ AllocPre s space base size align → AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s .ub
462	
463	/-- MM-02.B et MM-02.H : lecture brute par `ac`, sous la part statique `ObR.stat`
464	reçue en hypothèse. `ok` (état inchangé) si les conditions 1, 2, 3, 5 (`Read`)
465	et la part décidable `ObR.dec` (conditions 4, 6, 7) sont satisfaites ; `ub`
466	sinon. -/
467	def read (ObR : ReadObl) (ac : Access) (s : State) (_hs : ObR.stat s ac) : Outcome :=
468	  if Read s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac then .ok s else .ub
469	
470	/-- MM-02.C et MM-02.H : écriture brute de `w` par `ac`, sous la part statique
471	`ObW.stat` reçue en hypothèse. `ok` avec l'effet `State.write` si les conditions
472	1, 2, 3 (`CanWrite`) et la part décidable `ObW.dec` (conditions 4, 5, 6) sont
473	satisfaites ; `ub` sinon. -/
474	def write (ObW : WriteObl) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : State)
475	    (_hs : ObW.stat s ac w) : Outcome :=
476	  if CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac w then .ok (s.write ac w) else .ub
477	
478	/-- MM-02.D et MM-02.H : désallocation brute de `id` avec l'autorité `auth`.
479	`ok` avec l'effet `State.dealloc` si `CanDealloc` ; `ub` sinon. -/
480	def dealloc (Compatible : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel Compatible] (id auth : Nat)
481	    (s : State) : Outcome :=
482	  if CanDealloc Compatible s id auth then .ok (s.dealloc id) else .ub
483	
484	/-- MM-02.2 (création brute) et MM-02.H : allocation brute, sous l'invariant de
485	fraîcheur `WF s` (MM-02.A) reçu en argument de preuve. `ok` avec l'effet
486	`State.alloc` si `AllocPreDec`, équivalent à `AllocPre` sous `WF` ; `ub` sinon. -/
487	def alloc (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) (s : State) (_hwf : WF s) :
488	    Outcome :=
489	  if AllocPreDec s space base size align then .ok (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth)
490	  else .ub
491	
492	/-- MM-01.3 et MM-02.H : écriture vérifiée : contrôle `CanWrite` et `ObW.dec`
493	avant d'appeler l'opération brute ; `fail` avec l'état d'entrée, sans y entrer,
494	si le contrôle échoue. La part statique `ObW.stat` est reçue en hypothèse.
495	Vérification instrumentée du modèle exploratoire, non primitive d'ERN : elle
496	modélise une machine instrumentée qui lit l'état abstrait, alors que la machine
497	abstraite n'institue aucune métadonnée à l'exécution (rapport de passe 2,
498	`formal/reports/MM02_v0.3_p2.md`, section (h)). -/
499	def checkedWrite (ObW : WriteObl) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : State)
500	    (hs : ObW.stat s ac w) : Outcome' Unit :=
501	  if CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac w then (write ObW ac w s hs).lift () else .fail s
502	
503	/-- MM-01.3 et MM-02.H : désallocation vérifiée : contrôle `CanDealloc` avant
504	d'appeler l'opération brute ; `fail` avec l'état d'entrée, sans y entrer, si le
505	contrôle échoue. Vérification instrumentée du modèle exploratoire, non
506	primitive d'ERN : elle modélise une machine instrumentée qui lit l'état
507	abstrait, alors que la machine abstraite n'institue aucune métadonnée à
508	l'exécution (rapport de passe 2, `formal/reports/MM02_v0.3_p2.md`, section (h)). -/
509	def checkedDealloc (Compatible : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel Compatible] (id auth : Nat)
510	    (s : State) : Outcome' Unit :=
511	  if CanDealloc Compatible s id auth then (dealloc Compatible id auth s).lift () else .fail s
512	
513	/-- MM-02.B, MM-01.3 et MM-02.H : lecture vérifiée : contrôle les conditions du
514	noyau (par `readBytes`) et `ObR.dec` avant d'appeler la lecture brute ; rend les
515	octets lus, ou `fail` avec l'état d'entrée sans y entrer. La part statique
516	`ObR.stat` est reçue en hypothèse. Vérification instrumentée du modèle
517	exploratoire, non primitive d'ERN : elle modélise une machine instrumentée qui
518	lit l'état abstrait, alors que la machine abstraite n'institue aucune
519	métadonnée à l'exécution (rapport de passe 2, `formal/reports/MM02_v0.3_p2.md`,
520	section (h)). -/
521	def checkedRead (ObR : ReadObl) (ac : Access) (s : State) (hs : ObR.stat s ac) :
522	    Outcome' (List AByte) :=
523	  match readBytes s ac with
524	  | some v => if ObR.dec s ac then (read ObR ac s hs).lift v else .fail s
525	  | none => .fail s
526	
527	/-- MM-02.A et MM-02.H : états atteignables depuis `State.empty` par des
528	opérations brutes d'issue `ok`, avec la compatibilité `Compatible` et les
529	obligations `ObR`, `ObW` fixées pour toute l'exécution. -/
530	inductive Reachable (Compatible : Nat → Nat → Prop) [DecidableRel Compatible] (ObR : ReadObl)
531	    (ObW : WriteObl) : State → Prop where
532	  | empty : Reachable Compatible ObR ObW State.empty
533	  | read {s s' : State} (ac : Access) (hs : ObR.stat s ac) :
534	      Reachable Compatible ObR ObW s → read ObR ac s hs = .ok s' →
535	      Reachable Compatible ObR ObW s'
536	  | write {s s' : State} (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (hs : ObW.stat s ac w) :
537	      Reachable Compatible ObR ObW s → write ObW ac w s hs = .ok s' →
538	      Reachable Compatible ObR ObW s'
539	  | dealloc {s s' : State} (id auth : Nat) :
540	      Reachable Compatible ObR ObW s → dealloc Compatible id auth s = .ok s' →
541	      Reachable Compatible ObR ObW s'
542	  | alloc {s s' : State} (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) (hwf : WF s) :
543	      Reachable Compatible ObR ObW s → alloc space base size align freeAuth s hwf = .ok s' →

19	/-! ## Frames (MM-03.3.1) -/
20	
21	/-- Frame stack `F` (MM-03.3.1): frame identities, current frame first. The parent of a frame
22	is the next element; the last element is the initial frame. -/
23	abbrev Frames := List Nat
24	
25	/-- `ancestor F f₁ f₂` (MM-03.3.1): `f₁` is `f₂` itself or one of its ancestors in `F`, that is,
26	`f₁` occurs in `F` from the first occurrence of `f₂` on. -/
27	def ancestor (F : Frames) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Prop := f₁ ∈ F.dropWhile (· != f₂)
28	
29	instance (F : Frames) (f₁ f₂ : Nat) : Decidable (ancestor F f₁ f₂) :=
30	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∈ _))

32	/-! ## Parent chains
33	
34	Places (by `parent`) and authorities (by `origin`) form forests whose identities are indices.
35	A chain only follows a link to a strictly smaller index; the fuel `k` only ensures
36	termination. -/
37	
38	/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along the link `org`, nearest first. -/
39	def chainF (org : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → List Nat
40	  | 0, _ => []
41	  | k + 1, i =>
42	    match org i with
43	    | some o => if o < i then o :: chainF org k o else []
44	    | none => []
45	
46	/-- Strict ancestors of `i` along `org` (fuel `i`, enough since the chain decreases). -/
47	def chain (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chainF org i i
48	
49	theorem chainF_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) :
50	    ∀ k, chainF org k i = []
51	  | 0 => rfl
52	  | _ + 1 => by simp [chainF, h]
53	
54	theorem chainF_fuel (org : Nat → Option Nat) :
55	    ∀ k₁ k₂ i, i ≤ k₁ → i ≤ k₂ → chainF org k₁ i = chainF org k₂ i
56	  | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
57	  | 0, _ + 1, i, h, _ => by
58	    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
59	    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
60	  | _ + 1, 0, i, _, h => by
61	    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
62	    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
63	  | k₁ + 1, k₂ + 1, i, h₁, h₂ => by
64	    simp only [chainF]; split
65	    · split
66	      · rw [chainF_fuel org k₁ k₂ _ (by omega) (by omega)]
67	      · rfl
68	    · rfl
69	
70	theorem chain_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) : chain org i = [] :=
71	  chainF_none h i
72	
73	theorem chain_cons {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i o : Nat} (h : org i = some o) (hlt : o < i) :
74	    chain org i = o :: chain org o := by
75	  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, i = k + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
76	  simp only [chain, chainF, h, hlt, ↓reduceIte]
77	  rw [chainF_fuel org k o o (by omega) (Nat.le_refl o)]
78	
79	theorem chainF_lt {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i j, j ∈ chainF org k i → j < i
80	  | 0, _, _, h => by simp [chainF] at h
81	  | k + 1, i, j, h => by
82	    simp only [chainF] at h; split at h
83	    · split at h
84	      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
85	        · assumption
86	        · exact Nat.lt_trans (chainF_lt k _ j h) ‹_›
87	      · simp at h
88	    · simp at h
89	
90	/-- Every element of a chain is strictly smaller than its start: the walk along a chain
91	terminates (A7). -/
92	theorem chain_lt {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i j : Nat} (h : j ∈ chain org i) : j < i :=
93	  chainF_lt i i j h
94	
95	theorem chainF_length {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i, (chainF org k i).length ≤ k
96	  | 0, _ => by simp [chainF]
97	  | k + 1, i => by
98	    simp only [chainF]; split
99	    · split
100	      · simp only [List.length_cons]; have := chainF_length (org := org) k ‹_›; omega
101	      · simp
102	    · simp
103	
104	/-- A chain from `i` has at most `i` elements (A7: termination of the walk). -/
105	theorem chain_length (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : (chain org i).length ≤ i :=
106	  chainF_length i i
107	
108	theorem chainF_congr {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} :
109	    ∀ k i, (∀ j ≤ i, org j = org' j) → chainF org k i = chainF org' k i
110	  | 0, _, _ => rfl
111	  | k + 1, i, h => by
112	    simp only [chainF]; rw [h i (Nat.le_refl i)]; split
113	    · split
114	      · rw [chainF_congr k _ fun j hj => h j (by omega)]
115	      · rfl
116	    · rfl
117	
118	theorem chain_congr {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : ∀ j ≤ i, org j = org' j) :
119	    chain org i = chain org' i := chainF_congr i i h
120	
121	/-- Two roots (elements without link) of one chain are equal. -/
122	theorem chainF_root {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i r r', r ∈ chainF org k i → org r = none →
123	    r' ∈ chainF org k i → org r' = none → r = r'
124	  | 0, _, _, _, h, _, _, _ => by simp [chainF] at h
125	  | k + 1, i, r, r', h, hr, h', hr' => by
126	    simp only [chainF] at h h'; split at h
127	    · rename_i o ho; simp only [ho] at h'
128	      split at h
129	      · rename_i hlt; simp only [hlt, ↓reduceIte] at h'
130	        rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 h' with rfl | h'
131	        · rfl
132	        · rw [chainF_none hr] at h'; simp at h'
133	        · rw [chainF_none hr'] at h; simp at h
134	        · exact chainF_root k _ r r' h hr h' hr'
135	      · simp at h
136	    · simp at h

138	/-! ## Places (MM-03.3.2, A5) -/
139	
140	/-- Holder of an authority (A4) or owner of a place (A5): a frame or a place. -/
141	inductive Holder where
142	  | frame (f : Nat)
143	  | place (p : Nat)
144	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
145	
146	/-- Logical place (MM-03.3.2: `Place { id, parent?, frame, kind }`). Its identity is its index
147	in `P`. The field `frame` of MM-03.3.2 is generalised by `owner` (A5): a place is owned by a
148	frame or by another place (owned storage). A part has the owner of its parent (`WF3`). `kind`
149	is not interpreted: MM-03.3.2 gives no values for it. -/
150	structure Place where
151	  parent : Option Nat
152	  owner : Holder
153	  kind : Nat
154	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
155	
156	/-- `parent` link of the place with index `i` (MM-03.3.2). -/
157	def parentOf (P : List Place) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (P[i]?).bind (·.parent)
158	
159	/-- `partOf P p q` (MM-03.3.2, logical composition): `p` is a place of `P` and `q` is `p` itself
160	or one of its ancestors along `parent`. -/
161	def partOf (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
162	  p < P.length ∧ (p = q ∨ q ∈ chain (parentOf P) p)
163	
164	instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (partOf P p q) :=
165	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
166	
167	/-- Storage leaf (MM-03.3.2): a place without a strict part. -/
168	def isLeaf (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Prop := ∀ r < P.length, parentOf P r ≠ some l
169	
170	instance (P : List Place) (l : Nat) : Decidable (isLeaf P l) :=
171	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∀ _, _))
172	
173	/-- `footprint P q` (MM-03.3.2): the leaves of `P` that are parts of `q`. -/
174	def footprint (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
175	  (List.range P.length).filter fun l => decide (isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q)
176	
177	/-- Two places overlap when their footprints share a leaf (MM-03.3.2). -/
178	def overlap (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ∃ l ∈ footprint P p, l ∈ footprint P q
179	
180	instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (overlap P p q) :=
181	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ _ ∈ _, _))
182	
183	/-- Structural disjointness (MM-03.3.2): neither path is a part of the other. -/
184	def structurallyDisjoint (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := ¬ partOf P p q ∧ ¬ partOf P q p
185	
186	instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (structurallyDisjoint P p q) :=
187	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
188	
189	theorem mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} :
190	    l ∈ footprint P q ↔ l < P.length ∧ isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q := by
191	  simp [footprint, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]
192	
193	theorem footprint_congr {P P' : List Place} (hlen : P'.length = P.length)
194	    (hpar : parentOf P' = parentOf P) (q : Nat) : footprint P' q = footprint P q := by
195	  unfold footprint; rw [hlen]; congr 1; funext l
196	  exact decide_eq_decide.2 (by simp only [isLeaf, partOf, hpar, hlen])

198	/-! ## State `S3` (MM-03.3 §1) -/
199	
200	/-- Initialisation state of a leaf (MM-03.3.3). -/
201	inductive InitSt where
202	  | uninit
203	  | init
204	  | moved
205	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
206	
207	/-- Mode of an authority (MM-03.3.4). -/
208	inductive Mode where
209	  | observe
210	  | modify
211	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
212	
213	/-- Order of modes: `Observe` does not exceed `Modify` (MM-03.3.4: `Modify` allows
214	modifications and observations). -/
215	def Mode.le (m m' : Mode) : Prop := m = .observe ∨ m' = .modify
216	
217	instance (m m' : Mode) : Decidable (m.le m') := inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∨ _))
218	
219	/-- Authority (MM-03.3.4: `Authority { id, mode, origin?, footprint, frame, active }`). Its
220	identity is its index in `A`; its footprint is a list of leaves; no `Suspended` status is
221	stored. The field `frame` of MM-03.3.4 is generalised by `holder` (A4): a frame or the place
222	whose value contains the authority. -/
223	structure Authority where
224	  mode : Mode
225	  origin : Option Nat
226	  footprint : List Nat
227	  holder : Holder
228	  active : Bool
229	deriving DecidableEq, Repr
230	
231	/-- An arena entry (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3; F1): `storage` is the place of the administered storage;
232	`internal` is the authority that administers it, named by `newArena` (F1); `available` and
233	`issued` are the logical state of §6, `issued` mapping each issued region to the issued block.
234	The arena value is not a field: it is the place that holds `internal` (F1), which follows
235	transfers (A4). The anchor of §6 is not a field either: dependents anchor on the blocks (A10). -/
236	structure Arena where
237	  storage : Nat
238	  internal : Nat
239	  available : List Nat
240	  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
241	deriving DecidableEq
242	
243	/-- State `S3 = (F, P, I, A, D)` (MM-03.3 §1), without component `M` (pass-1 arbitrage 1).
244	`nF` is the next frame identity, so that an exited frame is never reused. `D q` lists the
245	anchors of place `q`, each an authority identity (pass-1 arbitrage 2). `dead q`: the place is
246	logically dead (A6, `endUse` and `free`); `freed q`: its storage was released by `free` (A6);
247	`pin l`: leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (A8). `arenas`: the arena entries registered by
248	`newArena` (D3). `callParams f`: the parameters given to frame `f` by `enterFrame`, a ghost record
249	(F6): set by `enterFrame`, never modified, read by no operation. -/
250	structure S3 where
251	  F : Frames
252	  nF : Nat
253	  P : List Place
254	  I : Nat → InitSt
255	  A : List Authority
256	  D : Nat → List Nat
257	  dead : Nat → Bool
258	  freed : Nat → Bool
259	  pin : Nat → Bool
260	  arenas : List Arena
261	  callParams : Nat → List Nat
262	
263	/-- Contracts `K` (MM-03.3.8) for an execution. Types are a representation choice: regions as
264	lists of leaves; `SharedMutable`, `Pinned` and `ExternalDone` on leaves; `Deallocable p` and
265	`FreeCompat p auth` for `free` (A6); `Satisfiable provider shape s` for `alloc` (B5; C9: it
266	depends on the current state `s`, with the shape encoded as the locals of `enterFrame`, C6).
267	`Invalidates` is removed (B9). The obligations of each contract are named hypotheses of theorems, never
268	fields. -/
269	structure K where
270	  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
271	  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
272	  Pinned : Nat → Prop
273	  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
274	  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
275	  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
276	  Satisfiable : Nat → List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) → S3 → Prop
277	
278	/-- Obligation of `DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8): a declaration never covers two regions that
279	really overlap. -/
280	def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'
281	
282	/-- `origin` link of the authority with index `i` (MM-03.3.4). -/
283	def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)
284	
285	/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along `origin`: `i` descends from each (MM-03.3.5). -/
286	def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i
287	
288	/-- Effective anchor of an anchor `x` (C1): the root of its chain of origins (`RootChain`), the
289	last element of `x :: s.ancs x`. -/
290	def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x
291	
292	/-- Active authority, that is, valid anchor (pass-1 arbitrage 2). -/
293	def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true
294	
295	instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
296	  match h : s.A[x]? with
297	  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
298	    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
299	  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'
300	
301	/-- Current frame: the head of the stack (MM-03.3.1). -/
302	def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0
303	
304	/-! ## Decidable helpers -/
305	
306	/-- Predicate on an optional value: `P y` for `some y`, `d` for `none`. -/
307	def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=
308	  match o with
309	  | some y => P y
310	  | none => d

440	/-! ## Usable places (MM-03.3.1, A5) -/
441	
442	/-- `s.Usable q` (A5): place `q` exists, is not logically dead, and the chain of its owners ends
443	at a frame on the stack. Inductive, so a cycle of owners never makes a place usable. -/
444	inductive S3.Usable (s : S3) : Nat → Prop where
445	  | frame {q f : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → s.dead q = false →
446	      pl.owner = .frame f → f ∈ s.F → S3.Usable s q
447	  | place {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} : s.P[q]? = some pl → s.dead q = false →
448	      pl.owner = .place o → S3.Usable s o → S3.Usable s q
449	
450	theorem S3.Usable.lt {s : S3} {q : Nat} (h : s.Usable q) : q < s.P.length := by
451	  cases h <;> exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
452	
453	/-- One step of `Usable`, read on a Boolean premise. -/
454	def usableR (s : S3) (U : Nat → Bool) (q : Nat) : Bool :=
455	  match s.P[q]? with
456	  | some pl => !s.dead q && match pl.owner with
457	    | .frame f => decide (f ∈ s.F)
458	    | .place o => decide (o < s.P.length) && U o
459	  | none => false
460	
461	theorem usableR_place {s : S3} {U : Nat → Bool} {q o : Nat} {pl : Place} (hpl : s.P[q]? = some pl)
462	    (hd : s.dead q = false) (ho : pl.owner = .place o) (hlt : o < s.P.length) (hU : U o = true) :
463	    usableR s U q = true := by
464	  simp [usableR, hpl, hd, ho, hlt, hU]
465	
466	theorem usableR_rule (s : S3) : KRule s.P.length (usableR s) where
467	  mono p q hpq a h := by
468	    unfold usableR at h ⊢; split at h
469	    · split at h <;> simp_all
470	    · exact h
471	  bound p a h := by
472	    unfold usableR at h; split at h
473	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
474	    · cases h
475	  loc p q hpq a := by
476	    unfold usableR; split
477	    · split
478	      · rfl
479	      · rename_i o _; by_cases ho : o < s.P.length <;> simp [ho, hpq o]
480	    · rfl
481	
482	theorem usable_of_kiter (s : S3) : ∀ k q, kiter (usableR s) k q = true → s.Usable q
483	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
484	  | k + 1, q, h => by
485	    simp only [kiter, usableR] at h
486	    split at h
487	    · rename_i pl hpl
488	      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.not_eq_true'] at h
489	      obtain ⟨hd, h⟩ := h
490	      split at h
491	      · exact .frame hpl hd ‹_› (by simpa using h)
492	      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h
493	        exact .place hpl hd ‹_› (usable_of_kiter s k _ h.2)
494	    · cases h
495	
496	theorem usable_iff {s : S3} {q : Nat} :
497	    s.Usable q ↔ kiter (usableR s) (s.P.length + 1) q = true := by
498	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, usable_of_kiter s _ q⟩
499	  induction h with
500	  | frame hpl hd ho hf =>
501	    show usableR s _ _ = true
502	    simp [usableR, hpl, hd, ho, hf]
503	  | place hpl hd ho hu ih =>
504	    rw [← kiter_fix (usableR_rule s)]
505	    show usableR s _ _ = true
506	    exact usableR_place hpl hd ho hu.lt ih
507	
508	instance (s : S3) (q : Nat) : Decidable (s.Usable q) := decidable_of_iff _ usable_iff.symm
509	
510	/-- A holder is live (A4, A5): a frame on the stack, or a usable place. -/
511	def HolderLive (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
512	  | .frame f => f ∈ s.F
513	  | .place p => s.Usable p
514	
515	instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderLive s h) := by
516	  cases h <;> unfold HolderLive <;> infer_instance
517	
518	/-- Frame ending the owner chain of place `q`, searched within `k` steps (MM-03.3.1, A5). -/
519	def pframeF (s : S3) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
520	  | 0, _ => none
521	  | k + 1, q =>
522	    match s.P[q]? with
523	    | some pl =>
524	      match pl.owner with
525	      | .frame f => some f
526	      | .place o => pframeF s k o
527	    | none => none
528	
529	/-- Frame of place `q`: the frame at the end of its owner chain (A5), within `|P| + 1` steps,

660	  Option.ext fun f => by rw [pframe_iff, pframe_iff, FrameOf.congr hP]
661	
662	theorem S3.hframe_congr {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (h : Holder) : s'.hframe h = s.hframe h := by
663	  cases h with
664	  | frame f => rfl
665	  | place p => exact S3.pframe_congr hP p

667	/-! ## Effective authority (MM-03.3.5) -/
668	
669	/-- Modes of the active descendants of `a` whose footprint covers leaf `p` (MM-03.3.5). -/
670	def descModes (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Mode :=
671	  (List.range s.A.length).filterMap fun j =>
672	    match s.A[j]? with
673	    | some y => if y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ a ∈ s.ancs j then some y.mode else none
674	    | none => none
675	
676	/-- Cases 1 to 3 of MM-03.3.5 for an active authority covering the leaf, of mode `m`, whose
677	active covering descendants have modes `ds`. -/
678	def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
679	  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe
680	
681	/-- `effective(a, p)` (MM-03.3.5), computed per leaf, with no stored status: absent if `a` is
682	inactive or does not cover `p`, `effOf` otherwise. -/

723	def NoEscape (s : S3) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : Prop :=

740	/-- `AnchorOrder` extended to held authorities (G4): for every usable place `q` and every active
741	authority held by `q`, the frame of the effective anchor of that authority is the frame of `q` or
742	one of its ancestors (`EffAnchorOK`, C1). -/
743	def AnchorOrderHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
744	  ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
745	    y.holder = .place q → EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
746	
747	/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` read on the places of `P` and the authorities of `A`: decidable form. -/
748	theorem anchorOrderHeld_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrderHeld s ↔
749	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length,
750	      OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
751	        EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) True := by
752	  constructor
753	  · intro h q _ hq x _
754	    unfold OptP; split
755	    · rename_i y hy; exact h q hq x y hy
756	    · trivial
757	  · intro h q hq x y hy ya hh
758	    have := h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
759	    simp only [OptP, hy] at this; exact this ya hh

761	instance (s : S3) : Decidable (AnchorOrderHeld s) := decidable_of_iff _ anchorOrderHeld_iff.symm

763	/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index, counted from `i`. -/
764	def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
765	  | _, [] => []
766	  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l
767	
768	theorem length_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :
769	    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List α), (mapI f i l).length = l.length
770	  | _, [] => rfl
771	  | i, _ :: l => by simp [mapI, length_mapI f (i + 1) l]
772	
773	theorem getElem?_mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) :
774	    ∀ (i : Nat) (l : List α) (j : Nat), (mapI f i l)[j]? = (l[j]?).map (f (i + j))
775	  | _, [], _ => rfl
776	  | i, a :: l, 0 => by simp [mapI]
777	  | i, a :: l, j + 1 => by
778	    simp only [mapI, List.getElem?_cons_succ, getElem?_mapI f (i + 1) l j]
779	    congr 2; omega

781	/-! ## Exercisable authorities (A2, B2) -/
782	
783	/-- `s.ExercisableAt a m` (B2): authority `a` is exercisable at mode `m` when `m` does not exceed its
784	mode and it is held by the current frame, or held by a place `p` such that an authority
785	exercisable at mode `m` has an effective mode permitting `m` on the whole footprint of `p`. The
786	authority is active: the rights of a released authority cannot be exercised (MM-03.3 §3, O3).
787	Inductive, so no cycle justifies a right. -/
788	inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
789	  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
790	      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
791	  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
792	      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
793	      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
794	
795	/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m`, read on a Boolean premise. -/
796	def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
797	  match s.A[a]? with
798	  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
799	    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
800	    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
801	        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
802	  | none => false
803	
804	theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
805	    l.any f = l.any g
806	  | [], _ => rfl
807	  | a :: l, h => by
808	    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
809	      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]
810	
811	theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
812	  mono p q hpq a h := by
813	    unfold exR at h ⊢; split at h
814	    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
815	      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
816	      · simpa using h.2
817	      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
818	        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
819	        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
820	    · exact h
821	  bound p a h := by
822	    unfold exR at h; split at h
823	    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
824	    · cases h
825	  loc p q hpq a := by
826	    unfold exR; split
827	    · congr 1; split
828	      · rfl
829	      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
830	    · rfl
831	
832	theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
833	    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
834	  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
835	  | k + 1, a, h => by
836	    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
837	    split at h
838	    · rename_i y hy
839	      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
840	      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
841	      split at h
842	      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
843	      · rename_i p hp
844	        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
845	        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
846	        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
847	    · cases h
848	
849	theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
850	    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
851	    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
852	  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]
853	
854	theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
855	    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
856	    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
857	    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
858	  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
859	    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
860	  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩
861	
862	theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
863	    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
864	  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
865	  induction h with
866	  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
867	  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
868	    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
869	    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
870	    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih
871	
872	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
873	  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm
874	
875	/-- The current frame has an authority exercisable at mode `m` whose effective mode permits `m` on
876	every leaf of `q` (B2: an operation requires the mode it requests). -/
877	def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
878	  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
879	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m
880	
881	instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
882	  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

884	/-! ## Outcomes and guarded relations (MM-03.3 §3) -/
885	
886	/-- `Outcome3` (MM-03.3 §3): `ok` with the new state, or `reject`, refusal by the static
887	discipline, distinct from a defined failure of an abstraction and from `ub` of MM-02. -/
888	inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
889	  | ok (s : σ)
890	  | reject
891	
892	/-- Common form of the transition rules of MM-03.3 §3–5: `ok` with the effect when the
893	precondition holds, `reject` otherwise. -/
894	inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
895	  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
896	  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject
897	
898	theorem Guarded.det {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 σ}
899	    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
900	  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction
901	
902	theorem Guarded.ok_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff s' : σ} :
903	    Guarded Pre eff (.ok s') ↔ Pre ∧ s' = eff :=
904	  ⟨fun h => by cases h; exact ⟨‹_›, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => e ▸ .ok h⟩
905	
906	theorem Guarded.reject_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} :
907	    Guarded Pre eff .reject ↔ ¬ Pre :=
908	  ⟨fun h => by cases h; assumption, fun h => .reject h⟩

910	/-! ## O1 `derive` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

912	/-- Effect of `derive(source, place, mode)` (MM-03.3 §3, O1): a new active authority with
913	origin `src`, footprint `footprint place`, mode `m`, held by the current frame. -/
914	def deriveEff (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
915	  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, footprint s.P q, .frame s.top, true⟩
916	
917	/-- O1.4 (MM-03.3 §3): every existing authority stays compatible with the derived one in the
918	resulting state. Not a precondition of `derive`: it follows from O1.1 and O1.3 under I1
919	(`derive_compat_redundant`, A11). -/

1355	
1356	/-- Owner of the local of index `i` of `ls` (parent, owning local, kind) in the new frame `f`:
1357	the owning local if any, the new frame otherwise (A5). -/
1358	def localOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (f i : Nat) : Holder :=
1359	  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
1360	  | some o => .place o
1361	  | none => .frame f
1362	
1363	/-- Places after `enterFrame`: the locals `ls` appended, owned by the new frame `nF` or by an
1364	earlier local (A5). -/
1365	def enterP (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Place :=
1366	  s.P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
1367	    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), localOwner ls s.nF i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩
1368	
1369	/-- Indices, relative to `ls`, of the root locals (no parent). -/
1370	def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
1371	  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone
1372	
1373	/-- Effect of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6) with parameters `ps` and locals `ls`: new frame
1374	`nF` pushed; the parameters, held by the caller, are now held by the new frame (A3); locals
1375	appended, uninitialised, without dependency, alive and unpinned; one active root `Modify`
1376	authority per root local on its footprint, held by the owner of the local (pass-1
1377	arbitrage 2; A4); the ghost record `callParams` of the new frame is `ps` (F6). -/
1378	def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 :=
1379	  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
1380	    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
1381	    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
1382	      (rootIdx ls).map fun i =>
1383	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i), localOwner ls s.nF i, true⟩
1384	    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
1385	    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
1386	    freed := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.freed q
1387	    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q
1388	    arenas := s.arenas
1389	    callParams := fun f => if f = s.nF then ps else s.callParams f }

1391	/-- G1, for one parameter `p` and the state `s'` where the new frame has received its parameters:
1392	if `p` is a `Modify` authority with an origin, that origin, its direct origin only, is
1393	exercisable (A2, B2) at no mode in `s'`. -/
1394	def ParamOriginHidden (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
1395	  OptP (s'.A[p]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify →
1396	    OptP y.origin (fun o => ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .modify) True) True
1397	
1398	instance (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamOriginHidden s' p) := by
1399	  unfold ParamOriginHidden; infer_instance

1401	/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` before G1 and G4 (MM-03.3 §4, O6): the calling frame is active
1402	(non-empty stack); each parameter is an active derived authority (`origin ≠ none`) held by the
1403	caller (A3, read since pass 2 without requiring the caller to be the deriving frame); the parent
1404	and the owner of a local are earlier locals; a part has the owner of its parent. -/
1405	def EnterPreBase (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
1406	  s.F ≠ [] ∧
1407	  (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
1408	    y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧
1409	  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
1410	    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => s.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s.P.length + i ∧
1411	      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - s.P.length]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
1412	    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => s.P.length ≤ o ∧ o < s.P.length + i) True
1413	
1414	instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
1415	    Decidable (EnterPreBase s ps ls) := by
1416	  unfold EnterPreBase; infer_instance
1417	
1418	/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6): those of `EnterPreBase`; G1: in
1419	`enterEff s ps ls`, the state where the new frame has received its parameters, the direct origin of
1420	every `Modify` parameter is exercisable at no mode (`ParamOriginHidden`); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in
1421	the arrival state. -/
1422	def EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
1423	  EnterPreBase s ps ls ∧ (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧
1424	    AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)
1425	
1426	instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
1427	    Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) := by
1428	  unfold EnterPre; infer_instance

1430	/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (MM-03.3 §4, O6; A3). -/
1431	def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (s : S3) :
1432	    Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1433	  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)

1435	/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, A4, A5, A7) -/
1436	
1437	/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀`: active, and held by a holder still live once
1438	the frame is popped, through transitive ownership (A4, A5). A7 speaks of an authority held by
1439	a surviving frame; an authority held by a place is read as held by the frame that ends its
1440	owner chain. -/
1441	def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
1442	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False
1443

1447	/-- First surviving authority of a list (A7). -/
1448	def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
1449	  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)
1450	
1451	/-- Authority `a` after the exit (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7): released unless it survives; a surviving
1452	authority is re-attached to its first surviving strict ancestor along `origin`, which is its
1453	origin when that origin survives. -/
1454	def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
1455	  if Survives s F₀ a then
1456	    match y.origin with
1457	    | none => y
1458	    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
1459	  else { y with active := false }

1461	/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A4; A5; A7): return to the caller; each anchor
1462	replaced by the first surviving authority among itself and its ancestors; authorities that do
1463	not survive released; surviving derived authorities re-attached. -/
1464	def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
1465	  match s.F with
1466	  | _ :: F₀ =>
1467	    { s with
1468	      F := F₀
1469	      D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s F₀ (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
1470	      A := mapI (exitG s F₀) 0 s.A }
1471	  | [] => s
1472	
1473	/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O7; A7; B4): the exiting frame has a caller; every
1474	anchor of a place still usable after the exit has a surviving authority among itself and its
1475	ancestors along `origin`; every surviving derived authority has a surviving strict ancestor;
1476	B4: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame, transitively owned storage included, is
1477	pinned, dynamically (A8) or statically (`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8); G4: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the arrival
1478	state, after the re-anchoring. Otherwise the exit is rejected. -/

1613	authorities, unrelated by `origin`, covering the same leaf, `SharedMutable` leaves included,
1614	both have the proper mode `Observe`. The pass-1 statement on effective modes is the theorem
1615	`effective_compat`. -/
1616	def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
1617	  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
1618	    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →

1622	on each leaf of the derived footprint, the leaf is in the footprint of the origin and the
1623	derived mode does not exceed the origin's. -/

1695	authority of the root place of that leaf, an authority without origin whose footprint is the

1710	safety invariant `Inv3`. Origins precede their derivations; footprints are made of existing
1711	places; the stack is non-empty and without duplicates, below `nF`; owner frames are below `nF`;

1715	of its place (`RootHeld`). C3: the first clause of B1, `RootsDisjoint`, is not a clause: it holds

/-! ## Static storage (D1) -/

/-- Static storage (D1): each element is a local of `enterFrame` (parent, owning element, kind;
C6) with a flag, the initial state of the element when it is a leaf: `true` for a global with an
initialiser (`Init`), `false` otherwise (`Uninit`). The flag of an element that has parts is not
read: its leaves carry their own (MM-03.3.3: a composite may be partly initialised). -/
abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)

/-- Initial state (MM-03.3.1; D1) with the static storage `statics`: the base frame 0, which never
exits (O7), and the elements of `statics` laid out as the locals of `enterFrame` (`shapeP`), owned
by frame 0 or by an earlier static. One root authority `Modify` per root element, on its
footprint, held by the owner of the element (A4): frame 0 for a static it owns. Leaves `Init` or
`Uninit` as declared; no anchor; alive, not freed, not pinned. -/
def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
  { F := [0]
    nF := 1
    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
    D := fun _ => []
    dead := fun _ => false
    freed := fun _ => false
    pin := fun _ => false
    arenas := []
    callParams := fun _ => [] }

section Init
variable {statics : Statics}

theorem init_len (statics : Statics) : (S3.init statics).P.length = statics.length := by
  simp [S3.init, shapeP_len]

theorem init_P_new {i : Nat} (hi : i < statics.length) : (S3.init statics).P[i]? =
    some ⟨((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i,
      (((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by
  have := shapeP_new (P := []) (hd := .frame 0) (ls := statics.map (·.1)) (i := i) (by simpa using hi)
  rw [List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add] at this; exact this

theorem init_P_get {q : Nat} {pl : Place} (h : (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl) :
    q < statics.length ∧ pl = ⟨((statics.map (·.1))[q]?).bind (·.1),
      shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) q, (((statics.map (·.1))[q]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by
  have hq : q < statics.length := by have := lt_of_getElem? h; rwa [init_len] at this
  rw [init_P_new hq] at h; cases h; exact ⟨hq, rfl⟩

theorem init_parentOf {q : Nat} (hq : q < statics.length) :
    parentOf (S3.init statics).P q = ((statics.map (·.1))[q]?).bind (·.1) := by
  simp [parentOf, init_P_new hq]

theorem init_get {j : Nat} {z : Authority} (h : (S3.init statics).A[j]? = some z) :
    ∃ i, (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i ∧
      z = ⟨.modify, none, footprint (S3.init statics).P i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩ := by
  simp only [S3.init, List.getElem?_map] at h
  cases hi : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? with
  | none => rw [hi] at h; cases h
  | some i => rw [hi] at h; cases h; exact ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem init_fp_lt {i l : Nat} (h : l ∈ footprint (S3.init statics).P i) :
    i < statics.length ∧ l < statics.length := by
  obtain ⟨hl, -, -, hq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 h
  rw [init_len] at hl
  rcases hq with rfl | hq
  · exact ⟨hl, hl⟩
  · exact ⟨Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hq) hl, hl⟩

/-- The static places are usable in the initial state (A5; D1): their owners lead to frame 0. -/
theorem init_usable (hsh : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))) :
    ∀ n i, i < n → i < statics.length → (S3.init statics).Usable i
  | 0, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, i, _, hi => by
    have hpl := init_P_new hi
    have hd : (S3.init statics).dead i = false := rfl
    unfold shapeOwner at hpl
    cases ho : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
    | none =>
      rw [ho] at hpl
      exact .frame hpl hd rfl (List.mem_singleton_self _)
    | some o =>
      rw [ho] at hpl
      have h2 := (hsh i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))).2
      rw [ho] at h2; simp only [OptP] at h2
      exact .place hpl hd rfl (init_usable hsh n o (by omega) (by omega))

end Init

/-- `init_wf` (MM-03.3 §2, §10; A1; D1): for every well-formed static storage, the initial state
satisfies `WF3` and `Inv3`. -/
theorem init_wf (statics : Statics) (hsh : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))) :
    WF3 (S3.init statics) ∧ Inv3 (S3.init statics) := by
/-! ### Root authorities of usable places -/

/-- Auxiliary invariant for G3: every usable root place has an active authority without origin,
held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the place (A4; B1). -/
def RootLive (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place), s.A[i]? = some z ∧
    z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧
    ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- Every place of a well-formed state is a part of a root place (MM-03.3.2). -/
theorem exists_rootPlace {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) : ∀ n q, q < n → q < s.P.length →
    ∃ r, RootPlace s.P r ∧ partOf s.P q r
  | 0, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
      · exact hrq
      · exact chain_trans hlt (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) r hlr q hrq

/-! ## Reachability (MM-03.3 §10) -/

/-- States reached from the initial state with the static storage `statics` (D1) by `ok`
transitions of the kernel operations, of the arena operations `newArena`, `issue` and `reset`
(D3), and of `store` (F4), for fixed contracts `k` (MM-03.3.8). The static storage is well-formed (`ShapeOK`, C6). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) → Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | derive {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} :
      Reachable k statics s → DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
      Reachable k statics s → SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → DependStep q x s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      Reachable k statics s → EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | exit {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → ExitStep k s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → PinStep p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | unpin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : Reachable k statics s → EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} :
      Reachable k statics s → AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | newArena {s s' : S3} {st i : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → NewArenaStep st i s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | issue {s s' : S3} {i via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | reset {s s' : S3} {i via : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → ResetAtStep k i via s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'
  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} :
      Reachable k statics s → StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → Reachable k statics s'

/-- Invariants of the reached states (MM-03.3 §10; B8, C1, C2, D3): `WF3`, `Inv3`, arena entries
naming existing authorities (`ArenasWF`) and `ArenaInv` for every live arena. Under `DDSound k`
(MM-03.3.8), used by `split`. -/
theorem reachable_invariants {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) : WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ArenasWF s ∧ ArenasInv s := by
  have mk : ∀ {s s' : S3}, KStep k s s' → WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ ArenasWF s ∧ ArenasInv s →
      WF3 s' ∧ Inv3base s' → AnchorOrder s' → NoDangling s' →
      WF3 s' ∧ Inv3 s' ∧ ArenasWF s' ∧ ArenasInv s' :=
    fun hk ih h a d => ⟨h.1, ⟨h.2, a, d⟩,
      kstep_preserves_arenas ih.1 ih.2.1.base ih.2.2.1 ih.2.2.2 hk⟩
  induction h with
  | init hsh =>
    exact ⟨(init_wf statics hsh).1, (init_wf statics hsh).2, fun _ h => by simp [S3.init] at h,
      fun _ h => by simp [S3.init] at h⟩
  | derive _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.derive hs) ih (derive_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (derive_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (derive_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | split _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.split hs) ih (split_preserves_underDD hdd ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (split_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (split_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | release _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.release hs) ih (release_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (release_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (release_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | transfer _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.transfer hs) ih (transfer_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (transfer_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (transfer_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | depend _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.depend hs) ih (depend_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (depend_preserves_anchorOrder ih.2.1.ao hs) (depend_preserves_noDangling ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | enter _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.enter hs) ih (enter_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (enter_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (enter_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | exit _ hs ih =>
    exact mk (.exit hs) ih (exit_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs)
      (exit_preserves_anchorOrder ih.1 ih.2.1.ao hs) (exit_preserves_noDangling ih.1 ih.2.1.nd hs)
  | read _ hs ih => rw [read3_preserves hs]; exact ih
  | write _ hs ih =>
    have hk := KStep.write (k := k) hs
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    exact mk hk ih (write3_preserves ih.1 ih.2.1.base hs) (write3_preserves_anchorOrder _ ih.2.1.ao)
      (write3_preserves_noDangling _ ih.2.1.nd)
  | writeShared _ hs ih =>
    have hk := KStep.writeShared hs
