/-- Every pool step keeps the invariants of the pool layer. -/
theorem pstep_inv {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} (hw : WF3 ps.s) (hi1 : I1 ps.s) (hwf : PoolWF ps)
    (hns : NoStale ps) (hce : CompExcl ps) (h : PStep k ps ps') :
    PoolWF ps' ∧ NoStale ps' ∧ CompExcl ps' := by
  cases h with
  | kernel h => exact pinv_kernel hwf hns hce h
  | newPool h => exact pinv_newPool hwf hns hce h
  | allocSlot h => exact pinv_allocSlot hwf hns hce h
  | resolve h => exact pinv_resolve hw hi1 hwf hns hce h
  | resolveMany h => exact pinv_resolveMany hw hi1 hwf hns hce h
  | unresolve h => exact pinv_unresolve (k := k) hwf hns hce h
  | freeSlot h => exact pinv_freeSlot hw hwf hns hce h

    (h : PReach k statics ps) :
    Reachable k statics ps.s ∧ PoolWF ps ∧ NoStale ps ∧ CompExcl ps := by

  | init hsh =>
    refine ⟨.init hsh, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [PS.init, NoStale, CompExcl]
  | step _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hr, hwf, hns, hce⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨hw, hinv, -⟩ := reachable_invariants hdd hr
    exact ⟨reachable_steps hr (pstep_steps hw hinv.1.2.2.1 hs),
      pstep_inv hw hinv.1.1 hwf hns hce hs⟩

theorem index_inj_of_lt : ∀ {l : List Nat} {i j a : Nat}, l.Pairwise (· < ·) → l[i]? = some a →

  | [], _, _, _, _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | _ :: _, 0, 0, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, 0, j + 1, _, hp, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at h₁; subst h₁
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ] at h₂
    exact absurd ((List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).1 _ (List.mem_of_getElem? h₂)) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  | _ :: _, i + 1, 0, _, hp, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at h₂; subst h₂
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ] at h₁
    exact absurd ((List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).1 _ (List.mem_of_getElem? h₁)) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  | _ :: _, i + 1, j + 1, _, hp, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ] at h₁ h₂
    exact congrArg (· + 1) (index_inj_of_lt (List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).2 h₁ h₂)

/-- First clause of `PoolInv` (material §4) for every pool: two distinct entries have disjoint
footprints, and every entry lies within the storage. -/
def EntriesDisjoint (ps : PS) : Prop :=
  ∀ pl ∈ ps.pools, (∀ (i₁ i₂ : Nat) (sl₁ sl₂ : Slot), i₁ ≠ i₂ → pl.slots[i₁]? = some sl₁ →
    pl.slots[i₂]? = some sl₂ → ∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P sl₁.place, l ∉ footprint ps.s.P sl₂.place) ∧
    ∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, ∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P sl.place, l ∈ footprint ps.s.P pl.storage

theorem EntriesDisjoint.transport {ps : PS} {s' : S3} {pools' : List Pool} (h : EntriesDisjoint ps)
    (hwf : PoolWF ps) (hf : FpStable ps.s s') (hp : pools'.map Pool.shape = ps.pools.map Pool.shape) :
    EntriesDisjoint ⟨s', pools', ps.nId, ps.res⟩ := by
  intro pl' hpl'
  obtain ⟨pl, hpl, e⟩ := shape_mem hp.symm hpl'
  obtain ⟨hd, hin⟩ := h pl hpl
  obtain ⟨-, hst, hsl⟩ := hwf.2.2.1 pl hpl
  have e' := e; simp only [Pool.shape, Prod.mk.injEq] at e'
  have fp : ∀ q < ps.s.P.length, ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P q ↔ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P q := hf.2
  refine ⟨fun i₁ i₂ sl₁' sl₂' hne h₁ h₂ l hl₁ hl₂ => ?_, fun sl' hsl' l hl => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨sl₁, h₁', p₁⟩ := shape_slot e.symm h₁
    obtain ⟨sl₂, h₂', p₂⟩ := shape_slot e.symm h₂
    rw [p₁] at hl₁; rw [p₂] at hl₂
    have hm₁ := hsl sl₁ (List.mem_of_getElem? h₁')
    have hm₂ := hsl sl₂ (List.mem_of_getElem? h₂')
    exact hd i₁ i₂ sl₁ sl₂ hne h₁' h₂' l ((fp _ hm₁ l).1 hl₁) ((fp _ hm₂ l).1 hl₂)
  · obtain ⟨sl, hs, p⟩ := shape_place e.symm hsl'
    rw [← p] at hl
    rw [← e'.2.1]
    exact (fp _ hst l).2 (hin sl hs l ((fp _ (hsl sl hs) l).1 hl))

/-- `EntriesDisjoint` holds on every reached state (material §4, `PoolInv` first clause): the
entries of `newPool` are the children of the storage, and footprints do not change. -/
theorem pool_entries_disjoint {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {ps : PS}
    (h : PReach k statics ps) : EntriesDisjoint ps := by
  induction h with
  | init => intro pl hpl; simp [PS.init] at hpl
  | step hr hs ih =>
    rename_i ps ps'
    obtain ⟨hreach, hwf, -⟩ := pReach_inv hdd hr
    obtain ⟨hw, hinv, -⟩ := reachable_invariants hdd hreach
    have hss := pstep_steps hw hinv.1.2.2.1 hs
    cases hs with
    | kernel h => exact ih.transport hwf (step_fp h) rfl
    | newPool h =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
      intro pl hpl
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hpl with hpl | hpl
      · exact ih pl hpl
      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hpl]
        rename_i st i
        have hk : (kids ps.s.P st).Pairwise (· < ·) := (range_pairwise_lt _).filter _
        refine ⟨fun i₁ i₂ sl₁ sl₂ hne h₁ h₂ => ?_, fun sl hsl l hl => ?_⟩
        · simp only [List.getElem?_map] at h₁ h₂
          cases g₁ : (kids ps.s.P st)[i₁]? with
          | none => rw [g₁] at h₁; cases h₁
          | some q₁ =>
            cases g₂ : (kids ps.s.P st)[i₂]? with
            | none => rw [g₂] at h₂; cases h₂
            | some q₂ =>
              rw [g₁] at h₁; rw [g₂] at h₂
              simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h₁ h₂; subst h₁ h₂
              exact kids_disjoint hw (List.mem_of_getElem? g₁) (List.mem_of_getElem? g₂)
                fun e => hne (index_inj_of_lt hk g₁ (e ▸ g₂))
        · obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hsl
          obtain ⟨hql, hpq⟩ := mem_kids.1 hq
          exact footprint_sub hw ⟨hql, .inr (by
            rw [chain_cons hpq (hw.parent_lt hpq).1]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩ hl
    | allocSlot h =>
      cases h with
      | @ok pl i sl hpj _ _ hsl =>
        exact ih.transport hwf (.same rfl)
          (map_set_same Pool.shape hpj (setSlot_shape (x := { sl with live := true }) hsl rfl))
    | resolve h => cases h with | ok => exact ih.transport hwf hss.fp rfl
    | resolveMany h => cases h with | ok => exact ih.transport hwf hss.fp rfl
    | unresolve h => cases h with | ok => exact ih.transport hwf hss.fp rfl
    | freeSlot h =>
      cases h with
      | @ok pl sl hpj _ _ hsl _ _ =>
        exact ih.transport hwf hss.fp
          (map_set_same Pool.shape hpj (setSlot_shape (x := ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) hsl rfl))

/-! ## Theorems of the material (§4) -/

/-- `pool_resolve_stale_fails` (material §4, generation): with the right of the pool value, a handle
whose generation differs from that of its entry fails, state unchanged. -/
theorem pool_resolve_stale_fails {ps : PS} {j : Nat} {pl : Pool} {h : Handle} {m : Mode}
    {sl : Slot} (hp : ps.pools[j]? = some pl) (hR : ResolveRight ps.s pl m)
    (hsl : pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl) (hg : sl.gen ≠ h.gen) :
    ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps) :=
  .fail hp hR fun ⟨_, ho⟩ => by rw [hsl] at ho; exact hg ho.1

/-- `pool_resolve_other_pool_fails` (material §4, identity of the pool): with the right of the pool
value, a handle of another pool fails, state unchanged. -/
theorem pool_resolve_other_pool_fails {ps : PS} {j : Nat} {pl : Pool} {h : Handle} {m : Mode}
    (hp : ps.pools[j]? = some pl) (hR : ResolveRight ps.s pl m) (hid : h.id ≠ pl.id) :
    ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps) :=
  .fail hp hR fun ⟨e, _⟩ => hid e

/-- A failed resolution leaves the state unchanged (material §4, `resolve`: "`fail` (état
inchangé)"). -/
theorem pool_resolve_fail_unchanged {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode}
    (hst : ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps')) : ps' = ps := by
  cases hst; rfl

/-- `pool_no_stale_access` (material §4): on every reached state, an active entry authority carries
the current generation of its entry, and the entry is live. -/
theorem pool_no_stale_access {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {ps : PS}
    (h : PReach k statics ps) : NoStale ps :=
  (pReach_inv hdd h).2.2.1

/-- `pool_resolve_modify_exclusive` (material §4): on every reached state, whatever the sequence of
`resolve`, `resolveMany`, `release`, `store`, `transfer` and `unresolve` (and every other step of
`PReach`), an active `Modify` companion of a pool is the only active companion of that pool: at
most one active `Modify` companion, and then no active `Observe` companion. -/
theorem pool_resolve_modify_exclusive {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {ps : PS}
    (h : PReach k statics ps) : ∀ r₁ ∈ ps.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ ps.res, r₁.pool = r₂.pool →
      ps.s.Active r₁.comp → ps.s.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .modify → r₁.comp = r₂.comp := by
  intro r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp ha₁ ha₂ hm
  refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hne => ?_
  have := (pReach_inv hdd h).2.2.2 r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp hne ha₁ ha₂
  rw [hm] at this; cases this.1

/-- `pool_resolveMany_atomic` (material §4): a failed `resolveMany` creates no authority and
leaves the state unchanged; an accepted one creates the companion and all the entry authorities
in one step. -/
theorem pool_resolveMany_atomic {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :
    (ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.fail ps') → ps' = ps) ∧
    (ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok ps') → ∃ pl, ps.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ BatchOK pl hs ∧
      ps'.s = resolveManyS ps.s pl hs m ∧ ps'.s.A.length = ps.s.A.length + 1 + hs.length) := by
  refine ⟨fun h => by cases h; rfl, fun h => ?_⟩
  cases h with
  | @ok pl hp _ hB _ =>
    exact ⟨pl, hp, hB, rfl, by simp [resolveManyS, splitEff, deriveEff, S3.addAuth, batchRegions,
      Nat.add_assoc]⟩

/-- `pool_resolveMany_distinct` (material §4, dynamic distinctness): with the right of the pool
value, two handles of a batch designating the same entry make `resolveMany` fail; an accepted batch
designates pairwise distinct entries. -/
theorem pool_resolveMany_distinct {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {pl : Pool} {hs : List Handle}
    {m : Mode} :
    (ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → ¬ (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.fail ps)) ∧
    (ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok ps') → (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup) := by
  refine ⟨fun hp hR hd => .fail hp hR fun hB => hd hB.2, fun h => ?_⟩
  cases h with
  | ok _ _ hB _ => exact hB.2

/-- `pool_freeSlot_ends_content` (material §4): after `freeSlot`, the kernel state is the result of
an accepted `endUse` of the entry (MM-03.3 §3, O12), whose leaves are `Uninit`, and the entry is
free with its generation incremented. -/
theorem pool_freeSlot_ends_content {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} {j via : Nat} {h : Handle}
    (hst : FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.ok ps')) :
    ∃ pl sl, ps.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl ∧
      EndUseStep k sl.place ps.s (.ok ps'.s) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P sl.place, ps'.s.I l = .uninit) ∧
      ps'.pools[j]? = some (setSlot pl h.slot ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) := by
  cases hst with
  | @ok pl sl hp _ _ hsl _ hE =>
    refine ⟨pl, sl, hp, hsl, Guarded.ok hE, fun l hl => ?_, getElem?_set_eq' hp⟩
    show (cleanup (endUseS ps.s sl.place)).I l = .uninit
    simp [cleanup, endUseS, hl]

/-! ## `PoolInv` read literally (material §4) -/

/-- `PoolInv` of the material (§4), literally, for every live pool (`internal` active):
(1) entries pairwise disjoint and within the storage; (2) every active authority derived from a
companion of the pool and covering a leaf of an entry "porte la génération courante de l'entrée":
it is, or descends from, an entry authority of that entry tagged with its current generation, and
the entry is live; (3) every active companion has as active descendants only the entry authorities
of its resolution. -/
def PoolInv (ps : PS) : Prop :=
  ∀ pl ∈ ps.pools, ps.s.Active pl.internal →
    (∀ i₁ ∈ List.range pl.slots.length, ∀ i₂ ∈ List.range pl.slots.length, i₁ ≠ i₂ →
      ∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P (slotPlace pl i₁), l ∉ footprint ps.s.P (slotPlace pl i₂)) ∧
    (∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, ∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P sl.place, l ∈ footprint ps.s.P pl.storage) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ ps.res, r.pool = pl.id → ∀ j ∈ List.range ps.s.A.length, ps.s.Active j →
      r.comp ∈ ps.s.ancs j → ∀ i ∈ List.range pl.slots.length,
        (∃ l ∈ ps.s.afp j, l ∈ footprint ps.s.P (slotPlace pl i)) →
        OptP (pl.slots[i]?) (fun sl => sl.live = true ∧ ∃ e ∈ r.entries, e.2.1 = i ∧
          e.2.2 = sl.gen ∧ (e.1 = j ∨ e.1 ∈ ps.s.ancs j)) False) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ ps.res, r.pool = pl.id → ps.s.Active r.comp → ∀ j ∈ List.range ps.s.A.length,
      ps.s.Active j → r.comp ∈ ps.s.ancs j → j ∈ r.entries.map (·.1))

instance (ps : PS) : Decidable (PoolInv ps) := by unfold PoolInv; infer_instance

s=open(p).read()
add=r'''
/-! ## Executable steps

A decidable step function for the extended machine, used by the case files to build reached
states: `prun` runs a list of operations and returns the final state when every step is `ok`
(`prun_reach`). -/

/-- An operation of the extended machine with its arguments: the steps of `Reachable`
(MM-03.3 §3–6) and the pool operations (material §4). -/
inductive Op where
  | derive (src q : Nat) (m : Mode)
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  | release (a : Nat)
  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
  | depend (q x : Nat)
  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
  | exit
  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | pin (p : Nat)
  | unpin (p : Nat)
  | endUse (p : Nat)
  | free (p auth : Nat)
  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
  | store (a p : Nat)
  | newArena (st i : Nat)
  | issue (i via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
  | reset (i via : Nat)
  | newPool (st i : Nat)
  | allocSlot (j via dst : Nat)
  | resolve (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode)
  | resolveMany (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode)
  | unresolve (c : Nat)
  | freeSlot (j via : Nat) (h : Handle)

section Exec
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- `ok` outcome of a step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §3–6), `none` otherwise. -/
def kexec (s : S3) : Op → Option S3
  | .derive src q m => if DerivePre s src q m then some (deriveEff s src q m) else none
  | .split src rs => if SplitPre k s src rs then some (splitEff s src rs) else none
  | .release a => if ReleasePre s a then some (releaseEff s a) else none
  | .transfer src dst => if TransferPre k s src dst then some (transferEff s src dst) else none
  | .depend q x => if DependPre s q x then some (dependEff s q x) else none
  | .enter ps ls => if EnterPre s ps ls then some (enterEff s ps ls) else none
  | .exit => if ExitPre k s then some (exitEff s) else none
  | .read a ls => if canRead3 s a ls then some s else none
  | .write a ls => if canWrite3 s a ls then some (write3Eff s ls) else none
  | .writeShared a ls => if WriteSharedPre k s a ls then some (write3Eff s ls) else none
  | .pin p => if PinPre s p then some (pinEff s p true) else none
  | .unpin p => if UnpinPre k s p then some (pinEff s p false) else none
  | .endUse p => if EndUsePre k s p then some (endUseEff s p) else none
  | .free p auth => if FreePre k s p auth then some (freeEff s p) else none
  | .alloc pr ow ls =>
    if AllocStatic k s pr ow ls ∧ k.Satisfiable pr ls s then some (allocEff s pr ow ls) else none
  | .store a p => if StorePre s a p then some (storeEff s a p) else none
  | .newArena st i => if NewArenaPre s st i then some (newArenaEff s st i) else none
  | .issue i via region dst =>
    match s.arenas[i]? with
    | some ar =>
      if IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧ Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧
          AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 then
        some (arenaSet (issueEff s ar region dst).1 i (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
      else none
    | none => none
  | .reset i via => if ResetAtPre k s i via then some (resetAtEff s i) else none
  | _ => none

/-- `ok` outcome of a step of the extended machine, `none` otherwise. -/
def pexec (ps : PS) : Op → Option PS
  | .newPool st i => if NewPoolPre ps.s st i then some (newPoolEff ps st i) else none
  | .allocSlot j via dst =>
    match ps.pools[j]? with
    | some pl =>
      if AllocSlotStatic k ps.s pl via dst then
        match firstFree pl with
        | some i => (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => allocSlotEff ps j pl i sl dst
        | none => none
      else none
    | none => none
  | .resolve j h m =>
    match ps.pools[j]? with
    | some pl =>
      match pl.slots[h.slot]? with
      | some sl =>
        if ResolveRight ps.s pl m ∧ HandleOK pl h ∧
            DerivePre (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length sl.place m then
          some { ps with
            s := resolveS ps.s pl sl.place m
            res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
              [(ps.s.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] }
        else none
      | none => none
    | none => none
  | .resolveMany j hs m =>
    match ps.pools[j]? with
    | some pl =>
      if ResolveRight ps.s pl m ∧ BatchOK pl hs ∧
          SplitPre k (deriveEff ps.s pl.internal pl.storage m) ps.s.A.length
            (batchRegions ps.s pl hs) then
        some { ps with
          s := resolveManyS ps.s pl hs m
          res := ps.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, ps.s.A.length, m,
            batchEntries ps.s.A.length hs⟩] }
      else none
    | none => none
  | .unresolve c =>
    match findRes ps c with
    | some r => (releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp])).map fun s' => { ps with s := s' }
    | none => none
  | .freeSlot j via h =>
    match ps.pools[j]? with
    | some pl =>
      match pl.slots[h.slot]? with
      | some sl =>
        if PoolRight k ps.s pl via ∧ HandleCur pl h ∧ ¬ EntryBorrowed ps.s pl sl.place ∧
            EndUsePre k ps.s sl.place then
          some (freeSlotEff ps j pl h.slot sl)
        else none
      | none => none
    | none => none
  | o => (kexec k ps.s o).map fun s' => { ps with s := s' }

/-- Runs a list of operations; `some` of the final state when every step is `ok`. -/
def prun (ps : PS) : List Op → Option PS
  | [] => some ps
  | o :: os => (pexec k ps o).bind fun ps' => prun ps' os

end Exec

section ExecSound
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

theorem kexec_step {s s' : S3} {o : Op} (h : kexec k s o = some s') : Step k s s' := by
  cases o <;> simp only [kexec] at h
  all_goals first
    | (split at h
       · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
         first
           | exact .kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.split (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.release (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.transfer (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.depend (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.enter (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.exit (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.read (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.write (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.writeShared (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.pin (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.unpin (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.endUse (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.free (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .kernel (.alloc (.ok hp.1 hp.2))
           | exact .kernel (.store (Guarded.ok hp))
           | exact .newArena (Guarded.ok hp)
           | exact .reset (Guarded.ok hp)
       · cases h)
    | cases h
    | (split at h
       · rename_i ar har
         split at h
         · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
           exact .issue (.ok har (.ok hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2))
         · cases h
       · cases h)

theorem pexec_step {ps ps' : PS} {o : Op} (h : pexec k ps o = some ps') : PStep k ps ps' := by
  cases o
  case newPool st i =>
    simp only [pexec] at h; split at h
    · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h; exact .newPool (Guarded.ok hp)
    · cases h
  case allocSlot j via dst =>
    simp only [pexec] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i pl hpl
      split at h
      · rename_i hst
        split at h
        · rename_i i hi
          cases hsl : pl.slots[i]? with
          | none => rw [hsl] at h; cases h
          | some sl =>
            rw [hsl] at h; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
            exact .allocSlot (.ok hpl hst hi hsl)
        · cases h
      · cases h
    · cases h
  case resolve j hd m =>
    simp only [pexec] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i pl hpl
      split at h
      · rename_i sl hsl
        split at h
        · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
          exact .resolve (.ok hpl hp.1 hp.2.1 hsl hp.2.2)
        · cases h
      · cases h
    · cases h
  case resolveMany j hs m =>
    simp only [pexec] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i pl hpl
      split at h
      · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
        exact .resolveMany (.ok hpl hp.1 hp.2.1 hp.2.2)
      · cases h
    · cases h
  case unresolve c =>
    simp only [pexec] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i r hr
      cases hs : releaseAll ps.s (r.entries.map (·.1) ++ [r.comp]) with
      | none => rw [hs] at h; cases h
      | some s' =>
        rw [hs] at h; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
        exact .unresolve (.ok hr hs)
    · cases h
  case freeSlot j via hd =>
    simp only [pexec] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i pl hpl
      split at h
      · rename_i sl hsl
        split at h
        · rename_i hp; simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
          exact .freeSlot (.ok hpl hp.1 hp.2.1 hsl hp.2.2.1 hp.2.2.2)
        · cases h
      · cases h
    · cases h
  all_goals
    simp only [pexec] at h
    cases hk : kexec k ps.s _ with
    | none => rw [hk] at h; cases h
    | some s' =>
      rw [hk] at h; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h
      exact .kernel (kexec_step hk)

theorem prun_reach {statics : Statics} : ∀ {ps ps' : PS} {os : List Op}, PReach k statics ps →
    prun k ps os = some ps' → PReach k statics ps'
  | _, _, [], hr, h => by simp only [prun, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h; exact hr
  | ps, ps', o :: os, hr, h => by
    simp only [prun] at h
    cases he : pexec k ps o with
    | none => rw [he] at h; cases h
    | some ps₁ => rw [he] at h; exact prun_reach (.step hr (pexec_step he)) h

/-- A run from the initial state that succeeds reaches its final state. -/
theorem prun_init {statics : Statics} {os : List Op} {ps' : PS}
    (hsh : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))) (h : prun k (PS.init statics) os = some ps') :
    PReach k statics ps' :=
  prun_reach (.init hsh) h

end ExecSound

import Ern.HandlePool

/-!
# MM3-H: adversarial corpus of the access discipline (jalon 3, step 2)

The cases of the jalon-3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md` v2), §1 sections A to I, and the usage
scenarios W1 to W3 of §5b. Each case is a run from the initial state `S3.init statics`
(MM-03.3.9) by `ok` steps of the extended machine (`Ern.HandlePool.PReach`), checked by `prun`;
the verdict of the step under test is stated with the relation of its operation (MM-03.3 §3–6,
material §4) and decided on the reached state. The expected verdict comes from the source named in
the material, never from the module (material §0, rule 1). Every rejection has a twin: the same
run without the faulty element, where the same step is accepted (rule 2). The class (rule 5) is in
each docstring; the jalon-3 report, (a), gathers expected and obtained verdicts. Section J is not
encoded (report, (a)); `J_H42_expansion` keeps the one straight-line expansion that the kernel can
run.

Local shapes are lists of (parent, owning local, kind), as for `enterFrame` (MM-03.3 §4, O6);
`lf` is a root leaf.
-/

namespace Ern.MM03.Horrors

open Ern.MM03 Ern.HandlePool

section Run
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- The state reached by the operations `os` from `S3.init statics`, or that initial state when a
step is not `ok` (then `run_reach` cannot be used). -/
def run (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) : PS :=
  (prun k (PS.init statics) os).getD (PS.init statics)

end Run

section RunSound
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A run whose steps are all `ok` reaches its final state (material §0, rule 3). -/
theorem run_reach {statics : Statics} {os : List Op} (hsh : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)))
    (h : (prun k (PS.init statics) os).isSome = true) : PReach k statics (run k statics os) :=
  prun_init hsh (some_getD h)

end RunSound

/-- A read rejected for every authority of the state is rejected for every authority (MM-03.3 §5,
`canRead3`: the reading authority exists). -/
theorem read_rejected {s : S3} {ls : List Nat} (h : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ canRead3 s a ls)
    (a : Nat) : Read3Step a ls s .reject :=
  .reject fun hc => by
    by_cases ha : a < s.A.length
    · exact h a (List.mem_range.2 ha) hc
    · cases hc.1 with
      | base hy => exact ha (lt_of_getElem? hy)
      | held hy => exact ha (lt_of_getElem? hy)

/-- A write rejected for every authority of the state is rejected for every authority (MM-03.3 §5,
`canWrite3`). -/
theorem write_rejected {s : S3} {ls : List Nat} (h : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ canWrite3 s a ls)
    (a : Nat) : Write3Step a ls s .reject :=
  .reject fun hc => by
    by_cases ha : a < s.A.length
    · exact h a (List.mem_range.2 ha) hc
    · cases hc.1 with
      | base hy => exact ha (lt_of_getElem? hy)
      | held hy => exact ha (lt_of_getElem? hy)

/-- A root leaf of a shape. -/
abbrev lf : Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat := (none, none, 0)

/-- A structure 0 with the parts 1 and 2. -/
def S2 : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) := [lf, (some 0, none, 0), (some 0, none, 0)]

/-! ## A. Exclusivity and indirect aliasing -/

/-- H01, structure and first parameter: frame 1, structure 0 with the parts 1 and 2, root 0; the
frame derives 1, `Modify` on 0. -/
def h01 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 0 .modify]
/-- Twin of H01: the same frame without the first parameter. -/
def h01t : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] S2]

/-- **H01** (A; I1, A3, G1; class N3). Two parameters derived from the same local, `Modify` on the
whole then `Observe` on a part: the second `derive` from the root is rejected, the root having no
effective mode on the part (MM-03.3.5; O1.3). Expected: reject; obtained: reject. Twin without the
first parameter: the same `derive` is accepted, and the call with the first parameter alone is
accepted. -/
theorem H01 : PReach K0 [] h01 ∧ DeriveStep 0 1 .observe h01.s .reject ∧ PReach K0 [] h01t ∧
    DeriveStep 0 1 .observe h01t.s (.ok (deriveEff h01t.s 0 1 .observe)) ∧
    EnterStep [1] [] h01.s (.ok (enterEff h01.s [1] [])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide),
    .ok (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H01, reading where the `Observe` parameter is derived from the `Modify` one (report, (b)): the
call with both is accepted. G1 constrains the origin of a `Modify` parameter only, and the two
authorities are related by derivation (I1). -/
theorem H01_reborrow : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 0 .modify,
    .derive 1 1 .observe, .enter [1, 2] []]) :=
  run_reach (by decide) (by decide)

/-- H02, frame 1 with the structure of H01 and an `Observe` authority 1 on the whole. -/
def h02 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 0 .observe]

/-- **H02** (A; I1, effective mode; N3). `Observe` on the whole, then `Modify` on a part: rejected,
the effective mode of the root on the part being `Observe` (MM-03.3.5). Expected: reject; obtained:
reject. Twin without the observation: accepted. -/
theorem H02 : PReach K0 [] h02 ∧ DeriveStep 0 1 .modify h02.s .reject ∧
    DeriveStep 0 1 .modify h01t.s (.ok (deriveEff h01t.s 0 1 .modify)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H03: frame 1, structure X (0) with the parts `p` (1) and 2, leaf Y (3); the frame derives 2,
`Modify` on `p`, and stores it into Y. -/
def h03o : List Op := [.enter [] (S2 ++ [lf]), .derive 0 1 .modify, .store 2 3]
def h03 : PS := run K0 [] h03o
def h03t : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] (S2 ++ [lf])]

/-- **H03** (A; I1, F4; N3). The value of Y holds a `Modify` derived on the part `p` of X; a write
of `p` through the root of X is rejected (no effective mode, MM-03.3.5; O10). Expected: reject;
obtained: reject. Twin without the stored authority: accepted. -/
theorem H03 : PReach K0 [] h03 ∧ Write3Step 0 [1] h03.s .reject ∧
    Write3Step 0 [1] h03t.s (.ok (write3Eff h03t.s [1])) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H04: frame 1, array 0 with the elements 1 and 2, and an authority 1, `Modify` on element 1. -/
def h04 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .derive 0 1 .modify]

/-- **H04** (A; O2, I1; N3). Swap of two elements: by `split` of the array, two writes, all `ok`;
by two `derive Modify` of the same element, the second is rejected. Expected: `ok` / reject;
obtained: `ok` / reject. Twin of the rejection: `derive Modify` of the other element, accepted. -/
theorem H04 : PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] S2, .split 0 [[1], [2]], .write 1 [1],
      .write 2 [2]]) ∧
    PReach K0 [] h04 ∧ DeriveStep 0 1 .modify h04.s .reject ∧
    DeriveStep 0 2 .modify h04.s (.ok (deriveEff h04.s 0 2 .modify)) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide),
    .ok (by decide)⟩

/-- H05: frame 1, structure `x` (0) with the fields `f` (1) and 2, leaf `tmp` (3); `x` written. -/
def h05 : PS := run K0 [] [.enter [] (S2 ++ [lf]), .write 0 [1, 2]]

/-- **H05** (A; F5, J1; N3; covered pass 6). `transfer(x, x.f)` is rejected (destination `Init`,
footprints overlapping). Expected: reject; obtained: reject. Twin: `transfer(x.f, tmp)` then
`transfer(tmp, x.f)`, the destination `Moved` and of the same shape: accepted. -/
theorem H05 : PReach K0 [] h05 ∧ TransferStep K0 0 1 h05.s .reject ∧
    PReach K0 [] (run K0 [] [.enter [] (S2 ++ [lf]), .write 0 [1, 2], .transfer 1 3,
      .transfer 3 1]) :=
  ⟨run_reach (by decide) (by decide), .reject (by decide), run_reach (by decide) (by decide)⟩

pool on it. `split` of the archetype into the columns (10 and 11), the second written, a read view

  .alloc 0 1 [lf, (some 7, none, 0), (some 8, none, 0), (some 8, none, 0), (some 7, none, 0),

`resolveMany` `ok`; the move of a field of the row while the column view is active: rejected; after

/-- L1: the shape of an `enterFrame` has no owning element: its locals are owned by the frame. -/
def NoOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i < ls.length, (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = none

instance (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (NoOwner ls) := by
  unfold NoOwner; infer_instance

/-- An `ok` step of MM-03 labelled by its operation, within the envelope of L1 (an `enterFrame`
whose shape has an owning element is outside the language) and L2 (the shape of `alloc` has exactly
one root). -/
def Step3 (k : K) : Op3 → S3 → S3 → Prop
  | .derive src q m, s, s' => DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')
  | .split src rs, s, s' => SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')
  | .release a, s, s' => ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')
  | .transfer src dst, s, s' => TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')
  | .depend q x, s, s' => DependStep q x s (.ok s')
  | .enter ps ls, s, s' => NoOwner ls ∧ EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')
  | .exit, s, s' => ExitStep k s (.ok s')
  | .read a ls, s, s' => Read3Step a ls s (.ok s')
  | .write a ls _, s, s' => Write3Step a ls s (.ok s')
  | .writeShared a ls _, s, s' => WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s')
  | .pin p, s, s' => PinStep p s (.ok s')
  | .unpin p, s, s' => UnpinStep k p s (.ok s')
  | .endUse p, s, s' => EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')
  | .free p auth, s, s' => FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s')
  | .alloc pr ow ls, s, s' => (∃ i, rootIdx ls = [i]) ∧ AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s')
  | .newArena st i, s, s' => NewArenaStep st i s (.ok s')
  | .issue i via region dst, s, s' => IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok s')
  | .reset i via, s, s' => ResetAtStep k i via s (.ok s')
  | .store a p, s, s' => StoreStep a p s (.ok s')

/-- A labelled step is a step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §10). -/
theorem Step3.step {k : K} {op : Op3} {s s' : S3} (h : Step3 k op s s') : Step k s s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact .kernel (.derive h)
  | split => exact .kernel (.split h)
  | release => exact .kernel (.release h)
  | transfer => exact .kernel (.transfer h)
  | depend => exact .kernel (.depend h)
  | enter => exact .kernel (.enter h.2)
  | exit => exact .kernel (.exit h)
  | read => exact .kernel (.read h)
  | write => exact .kernel (.write h)
  | writeShared => exact .kernel (.writeShared h)
  | pin => exact .kernel (.pin h)
  | unpin => exact .kernel (.unpin h)
  | endUse => exact .kernel (.endUse h)
  | free => exact .kernel (.free h)
  | alloc => exact .kernel (.alloc h.2)
  | newArena => exact .newArena h
  | issue => exact .issue h
  | reset => exact .reset h
  | store => exact .kernel (.store h)

/-- An execution of MM-03 from `S3.init statics` within the envelope of L1 and L2: the operations,
most recent first, and the state reached. -/
inductive Exec3 (k : K) (statics : Statics) : List Op3 → S3 → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) → Exec3 k statics [] (S3.init statics)
  | step {ops : List Op3} {s s' : S3} {op : Op3} : Exec3 k statics ops s → Step3 k op s s' →
      Exec3 k statics (op :: ops) s'

theorem Exec3.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {ops : List Op3} {s : S3}
    (h : Exec3 k statics ops s) : Reachable k statics s := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh => exact .init hsh
  | step _ hs ih => exact Reachable.ofStep ih hs.step

/-- Parameters of the refinement fixed once for a whole execution (step 5): the layout, the frame
and provider tokens (K2, L4), the placement (K2), the geometry of the allocation of each root place,
read on its index, the encoding of pointers (L6), the initial bytes of the statics (K3). -/
structure Params where
  L : Layout
  tok : Nat → Nat
  ptok : Nat → Nat
  pl : Placement
  geom : Nat → Geom
  pe : PtrEnc
  w0 : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat

/-- K4, L6: the MM-02 sequence associated with an MM-03 operation from the states `s3`, `s2`. -/
def assoc (π : Params) : Op3 → S3 → MM02.State → List Op2
  | .read _ ls, _, s2 => readOps s2 π.L ls
  | .write _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L w ls
  | .writeShared _ ls w, _, s2 => writeOps s2 π.L w ls
  | .transfer src dst, s3, s2 => transferOps s2 π.L s3.P src dst
  | .store a p, s3, s2 => storeOps π.pe s2 π.L s3 a p
  | .issue i _ region dst, s3, s2 => issueOps π.pe s2 π.L s3 i region dst
  | .alloc pr _ ls, s3, s2 =>
    allocOps π.pl (fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (some (π.ptok pr)) s2 (rootIdx ls)
  | .enter _ ls, s3, s2 =>
    allocOps π.pl (fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (some (π.tok s3.nF)) s2 (rootIdx ls)
  | .free p auth, s3, _ => deallocOps [rootAlloc π.L s3.P p] auth
  | .exit, s3, _ => exitOps π.L π.tok s3
  | _, _, _ => []

/-- L4: the ghost `provOf` after an operation: `alloc pr _ ls` maps the places it creates to the
provider `pr`; no other operation changes it. -/
def provStep : Op3 → S3 → (Nat → Option Nat) → Nat → Option Nat
  | .alloc pr _ ls, s3, pv => fun r =>
    if s3.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s3.P.length + ls.length then some pr else pv r
  | _, _, pv => pv

/-- K3: the MM-02 operations of the initial state with the parameters `π`. -/
def initOpsOf (π : Params) (statics : Statics) : List Op2 :=
  initOps π.pl π.geom π.tok π.L π.w0 statics

/-- The lock-step translation of an MM-03 execution: the operations (most recent first), the MM-03
state, the ghost `provOf`, the MM-02 operations (in the order of execution) and the MM-02 state.
It starts with the MM-02 run of `repr_init`; each MM-03 step appends its associated sequence. It is
determined by the execution and the parameters. -/
inductive Trans (k : K) (statics : Statics) (π : Params) :
    List Op3 → S3 → (Nat → Option Nat) → List Op2 → MM02.State → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) →
      Trans k statics π [] (S3.init statics) (fun _ => none) (initOpsOf π statics)
        (exec MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf π statics))
  | step {ops : List Op3} {s3 s3' : S3} {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2}
      {s2 : MM02.State} {op : Op3} :
      Trans k statics π ops s3 pv os s2 → Step3 k op s3 s3' →
      Trans k statics π (op :: ops) s3' (provStep op s3 pv) (os ++ assoc π op s3 s2)
        (exec s2 (assoc π op s3 s2))

/-- Every MM-03 execution has a translation. -/
theorem Trans.of_exec {k : K} {statics : Statics} (π : Params) {ops : List Op3} {s3 : S3}
    (h : Exec3 k statics ops s3) : ∃ pv os s2, Trans k statics π ops s3 pv os s2 := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh => exact ⟨_, _, _, .init hsh⟩
  | step _ hs ih => obtain ⟨pv, os, s2, ht⟩ := ih; exact ⟨_, _, _, ht.step hs⟩

/-- K1, K2: the layout obligation of an operation that creates root places: the new roots are laid
out in fresh allocations, within their geometry (`NewLayout`). -/
def LayoutObl (π : Params) : Op3 → S3 → S3 → MM02.State → Prop
  | .enter _ ls, s3, s3', s2 =>
    NewLayout π.L s3'.P s3.P.length s2.next (fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (rootIdx ls)
  | .alloc _ _ ls, s3, s3', s2 =>
    NewLayout π.L s3'.P s3.P.length s2.next (fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (rootIdx ls)
  | _, _, _, _ => True

instance (π : Params) (op : Op3) (s3 s3' : S3) (s2 : MM02.State) :
    Decidable (LayoutObl π op s3 s3' s2) := by
  cases op <;> unfold LayoutObl <;> infer_instance

theorem ReprB.provOf_congr {tok ptok : Nat → Nat} {pv pv' : Nat → Option Nat} {L : Layout}
    {s3 : S3} {s2 : MM02.State} (hR : ReprB tok ptok pv L s3 s2)
    (h : ∀ r < s3.P.length, pv' r = pv r) : ReprB tok ptok pv' L s3 s2 :=
  { hR with provTokens := fun r hr hrt => by rw [h r hr]; exact hR.provTokens r hr hrt }

theorem decAlong_readOps {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec} {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec} {s2 s2' : MM02.State}
    {L : Layout} : ∀ {ls : List Nat}, DecAlong ObR ObW s2 (readOps s2' L ls) →
      ∀ l ∈ ls, ObR.dec s2 (leafAcc s2' L .read l)
  | [], _, _, h => by cases h
  | _ :: _, ⟨h0, h⟩, _, hl => by
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hl with rfl | hl
    · exact h0
    · exact decAlong_readOps h _ hl

/-- L4: the obligation of the contracts at a `free` of the run: `FreeCompat` is instantiated by
the token of the provider recorded by the ghost `provOf` (`FreeCompatInst`). -/
def FreeOblig (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (π : Params) : Op3 → (Nat → Option Nat) → Prop
  | .free p auth, pv => k.FreeCompat p auth → FreeCompatInst C π.ptok pv p auth
  | _, _ => True

/-- The obligations of one step of the run, on the states where it runs: the layout of the new
roots (`LayoutObl`, K1, K2), `dec` along its MM-02 sequence (K5), and `FreeOblig` (L4). -/
def Oblig (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec) (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec)
    (π : Params) (op : Op3) (s3 s3' : S3) (pv : Nat → Option Nat) (s2 : MM02.State) : Prop :=
  LayoutObl π op s3 s3' s2 ∧ DecAlong ObR ObW s2 (assoc π op s3 s2) ∧ FreeOblig k C π op pv

/-- An execution of MM-03 with its translation (`Trans`) whose every step meets its obligations
(`Oblig`), and whose initial run meets the layout of the statics and `dec`. The obligations bear on
the states of this execution and its run only. -/
inductive SimRun (k : K) (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec)
    (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec) (statics : Statics) (π : Params) :
    List Op3 → S3 → (Nat → Option Nat) → List Op2 → MM02.State → Prop where
  | init : ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1)) →
      NewLayout π.L (S3.init statics).P 0 0 π.geom (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))) →
      DecAlong ObR ObW MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf π statics) →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π [] (S3.init statics) (fun _ => none) (initOpsOf π statics)
        (exec MM02.State.empty (initOpsOf π statics))
  | step {ops : List Op3} {s3 s3' : S3} {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2}
      {s2 : MM02.State} {op : Op3} :
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2 → Step3 k op s3 s3' →
      Oblig k C ObR ObW π op s3 s3' pv s2 →
      SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π (op :: ops) s3' (provStep op s3 pv) (os ++ assoc π op s3 s2)
        (exec s2 (assoc π op s3 s2))

/-- A `SimRun` is the canonical translation of its execution. -/
theorem SimRun.trans {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec}
    {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec} {statics : Statics} {π : Params} {ops : List Op3} {s3 : S3}
    {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2} {s2 : MM02.State}
    (h : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2) : Trans k statics π ops s3 pv os s2 := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh _ _ => exact .init hsh
  | step _ hs _ ih => exact ih.step hs

/-- A `SimRun` is an execution of MM-03. -/
theorem SimRun.exec3 {k : K} {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec}
    {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec} {statics : Statics} {π : Params} {ops : List Op3} {s3 : S3}
    {pv : Nat → Option Nat} {os : List Op2} {s2 : MM02.State}
    (h : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2) : Exec3 k statics ops s3 := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh _ _ => exact .init hsh
  | step _ hs _ ih => exact ih.step hs

/-- `simulation` (step 5): along every execution of MM-03 from `S3.init statics` within the
envelope of L1 and L2, translated with parameters `π` fixed once for the whole execution, whose
steps meet their obligations (`SimRun`), the MM-02 run starts with the run of `repr_init`, appends
at each step the sequence associated by K4 and L6, has only `ok` outcomes, reaches the state `s2`,
and is in `Repr` with the MM-03 state; the MM-03 state is reached, and the ghost `provOf` is empty
beyond the places. Since every prefix of a `SimRun` is a `SimRun`, this holds at each step. The
remaining hypotheses: `DDSound k` (L7: `ddSound_of_layout`); `stat` (K5); the obligation of the
placement and valid alignments (K2); the compatibility of the frame tokens (K2). `SameSizeAlong`
(L6) is not one: the outcomes and `Repr` hold without it; the copy of the bytes of a `transfer`
holds under it (`transfer_copies`). -/
theorem simulation {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec} {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec}
    {k : K} {statics : Statics} {π : Params} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hstatR : ∀ s ac, ObR.stat s ac) (hstatW : ∀ s ac w, ObW.stat s ac w)
    (hpl : PlacementOK π.pl) (hg : ∀ r, 0 < (π.geom r).align ∧ MM02.Pow2 (π.geom r).align)
    (htc : TokCompat C π.tok) :
    ∀ {ops s3 pv os s2}, SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2 →
      AllOk C ObR ObW MM02.State.empty os ∧ exec MM02.State.empty os = s2 ∧
      Repr π.tok π.ptok pv π.L s3 s2 ∧ Reachable k statics s3 ∧
      ∀ r, s3.P.length ≤ r → pv r = none := by
  intro ops s3 pv os s2 ht
  induction ht with
  | init hsh hlay0 hdec0 =>
    have := repr_init (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) (tok := π.tok) (ptok := π.ptok)
      (provOf := fun _ => none) hsh hpl (fun i _ => hg i) hlay0 (fun _ _ => rfl) hstatW hdec0
    exact ⟨this.1, rfl, this.2, .init hsh, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  | @step ops s3 s3' pv os s2 op _ hs hob ih =>
    obtain ⟨hok, hex, hR, hr, hpv⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨hly, hdc, hfc⟩ := hob
    have hwf := (reachable_invariants hdd hr).1
    have hnd := (reachable_invariants hdd hr).2.1.nd
    have hfl := (reachable_fpLeaves_frameOwnedLive hdd hr).1
    have hfo := (reachable_fpLeaves_frameOwnedLive hdd hr).2
    have hr' : Reachable k statics s3' := Reachable.ofStep hr hs.step
    -- the MM-02 side of the step
    have key : AllOk C ObR ObW s2 (assoc π op s3 s2) ∧
        Repr π.tok π.ptok (provStep op s3 pv) π.L s3' (exec s2 (assoc π op s3 s2)) := by
      cases op with
      | derive => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.derive hs)
      | split => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.split hs)
      | release => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.release hs)
      | transfer => exact r6_transfer hwf hR hs hstatR hstatW hdc
      | depend => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.depend hs)
      | enter ps ls =>
        exact r6_enter hwf hR hpl (fun i _ => hg _) hs.2 (fun i _ => hpv _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
          hly
      | exit => exact r6_exit hwf hfo hR htc hs
      | read => exact r6_read3 hwf hnd hfl hR hs hstatR (decAlong_readOps hdc)
      | write => exact r2_write3 hwf hnd hfl hR hs hstatW hdc
      | writeShared => exact r2_writeShared hwf hnd hfl hR hs hstatW hdc
      | pin => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.pin hs)
      | unpin => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.unpin hs)
      | endUse => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.endUse hs)
      | free p auth => exact r6_free hwf hR hfc hs
      | alloc pr ow ls =>
        obtain ⟨⟨i, hone⟩, hs'⟩ := hs
        have hi : i < ls.length := (rootIdx_mem (k := 0) (by rw [hone]; rfl)).1
        have hR₁ : Repr π.tok π.ptok (provStep (.alloc pr ow ls) s3 pv) π.L s3 s2 :=
          ⟨hR.toReprB.provOf_congr fun r hr => by
            simp only [provStep, show ¬ (s3.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s3.P.length + ls.length) from
              fun h => absurd h.1 (Nat.not_le.2 hr), ↓reduceIte], hR.wf2⟩
        have := r6_alloc (C := C) (ObR := ObR) (ObW := ObW) (pl := π.pl)
          (g := fun i => π.geom (s3.P.length + i)) (i := i) hwf hR₁ hpl (hg _) hs' hone
          (by simp only [provStep, show s3.P.length ≤ s3.P.length + i ∧
              s3.P.length + i < s3.P.length + ls.length from ⟨Nat.le_add_right _ _, by omega⟩,
              and_self, ↓reduceIte])
          (by simp only [LayoutObl] at hly; rw [hone] at hly; exact hly)
        simp only [assoc, hone]
        exact this
      | newArena => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.newArena hs)
      | issue => exact (r6_issue hwf hR hs hstatW hdc.1).imp id fun h => h.1
      | reset => exact r6_noStep (k := k) hR (.reset hs)
      | store => exact (r6_store hwf hR hs hstatW hdc.1).imp id fun h => h.1
    refine ⟨along_append.2 ⟨hok, hex ▸ key.1⟩, by rw [exec_append, hex], key.2, hr', fun r hr => ?_⟩
    have hlen := (step_extends hwf hs.step).1
    cases op with
    | alloc pr ow ls =>
      have hP : s3'.P.length = s3.P.length + ls.length := by
        obtain ⟨-, hs'⟩ := hs
        cases hs' with
        | ok _ _ => exact allocP_len s3 ow ls
      simp only [provStep, show ¬ (s3.P.length ≤ r ∧ r < s3.P.length + ls.length) from
        fun h => by omega, ↓reduceIte]
      exact hpv r (by omega)
    | _ => exact hpv r (by omega)

/-- L8 along the simulation: at every step of a `SimRun`, a leaf pinned before the step has a live
allocation before and after it, and the same address. -/
theorem simulation_pinned {C : Nat → Nat → Prop} {ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec}
    {ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec} {k : K} {statics : Statics} {π : Params} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hstatR : ∀ s ac, ObR.stat s ac) (hstatW : ∀ s ac w, ObW.stat s ac w)
    (hpl : PlacementOK π.pl) (hg : ∀ r, 0 < (π.geom r).align ∧ MM02.Pow2 (π.geom r).align)
    (htc : TokCompat C π.tok) {ops : List Op3} {s3 s3' : S3} {pv : Nat → Option Nat}
    {os : List Op2} {s2 : MM02.State} {op : Op3}
    (ht : SimRun k C ObR ObW statics π ops s3 pv os s2) (hs : Step3 k op s3 s3')
    (hob : Oblig k C ObR ObW π op s3 s3' pv s2) {l : Nat} (hl : l < s3.P.length)
    (hlf : isLeaf s3.P l) (hpin : s3.pin l = true ∨ k.Pinned l) :
    LiveAlloc s2 (π.L l).alloc ∧ LiveAlloc (exec s2 (assoc π op s3 s2)) (π.L l).alloc ∧
      leafAddr (exec s2 (assoc π op s3 s2)) π.L l = leafAddr s2 π.L l := by
  have h₁ := simulation hdd hstatR hstatW hpl hg htc ht
  have h₂ := simulation hdd hstatR hstatW hpl hg htc (ht.step hs hob)
  exact pinned_address_stable hdd h₁.2.2.2.1 hs.step h₁.2.2.1 h₂.2.2.1 hl hlf hpin

(`MM02.WF`, MM-02.A). Not decidable (`WF` quantifies over every identity); `ReprB` is. -/
structure Repr (tok ptok : Nat → Nat) (provOf : Nat → Option Nat) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3)
    (s2 : MM02.State) : Prop extends ReprB tok ptok provOf L s3 s2 where
  wf2 : MM02.WF s2

/-! ## Sequences of MM-02 operations (MM-02.H, K4, K5) -/

/-- An MM-02 operation with its arguments (MM-02.H): read, write, deallocation, allocation. -/
inductive Op2 where
  | read (ac : MM02.Access)
  | write (ac : MM02.Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
  | dealloc (id auth : Nat)
  | alloc (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat)

/-- Effect of an operation of outcome `ok` (MM-02.H.2): a read leaves the state unchanged. -/
def Op2.eff : Op2 → MM02.State → MM02.State
  | .read _, s => s
  | .write ac w, s => s.write ac w
  | .dealloc id _, s => s.dealloc id
  | .alloc sp b sz al fa, s => s.alloc sp b sz al fa

/-- State reached by a sequence of operations of outcome `ok`. -/
def exec : MM02.State → List Op2 → MM02.State
  | s, [] => s
  | s, o :: os => exec (o.eff s) os

/-- `p s o` holds for each operation `o` of the sequence, in the state `s` where it runs. -/
def Along (p : MM02.State → Op2 → Prop) : MM02.State → List Op2 → Prop
  | _, [] => True
  | s, o :: os => p s o ∧ Along p (o.eff s) os

instance decAlong (p : MM02.State → Op2 → Prop) [h : ∀ s o, Decidable (p s o)] :
    (s : MM02.State) → (os : List Op2) → Decidable (Along p s os)
  | _, [] => isTrue trivial
  | s, o :: os => @instDecidableAnd _ _ (h s o) (decAlong p (o.eff s) os)

/-- The operation `o` has the outcome `ok` in `s` for its relation (MM-02.H.1): `ReadStep`,
`WriteStep`, `DeallocStep` or `AllocStep`. -/
def OpOk (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec) (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec)
    (s : MM02.State) : Op2 → Prop
  | .read ac => ∃ v, MM02.ReadStep ObR ac s (.ok v)
  | .write ac w => MM02.WriteStep ObW ac w s (.ok (s.write ac w))
  | .dealloc id au => MM02.DeallocStep C id au s (.ok (s.dealloc id))
  | .alloc sp b sz al fa => MM02.AllocStep sp b sz al fa s (.ok (s.alloc sp b sz al fa))

/-- R6 (MM-03.3 §9.2): every operation of the sequence has the outcome `ok` in the state where it
runs, the compatibility `C` and the obligations `ObR`, `ObW` fixed for the execution. -/
abbrev AllOk (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec) (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec) :
    MM02.State → List Op2 → Prop :=
  Along (OpOk C ObR ObW)

/-- K5: the decidable part `dec` of the obligation of a read or a write (alignment of the access,
validity of the representation; MM-02.B.4, B.6, C.4, C.5), in the state `s` where it runs. -/
def Op2.Dec (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec) (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec) (s : MM02.State) : Op2 → Prop
  | .read ac => ObR.dec s ac
  | .write ac w => ObW.dec s ac w
  | _ => True

/-- K5: `dec` holds for each read and write of the sequence, in the state where it runs. An
explicit parametric hypothesis, never instantiated by `True` in a theorem. -/
abbrev DecAlong (ObR : MM02.ReadOblSpec) (ObW : MM02.WriteOblSpec) :
    MM02.State → List Op2 → Prop :=
  Along (Op2.Dec ObR ObW)

/-! ## Placement of new allocations (K2) -/

/-- K2: geometry of a new allocation: address space, size, alignment. -/
structure Geom where
  space : Nat
  size : Nat
  align : Nat

/-- K2: `Placement`, the choice of the base address of a new allocation of geometry `g` in the
MM-02 state `s`. -/
abbrev Placement := MM02.State → Geom → Nat

/-- K2: obligation of a placement, `AllocPre` (MM-02.2, création brute: freshness, alignment,
no overlap with a live allocation), in every state with fresh identities (`WF`, MM-02.A), for every
valid alignment. -/
def PlacementOK (pl : Placement) : Prop :=
  ∀ s g, MM02.WF s → 0 < g.align → MM02.Pow2 g.align →
    MM02.AllocPre s g.space (pl s g) g.size g.align

/-- End of the allocation `i` of `s`, `0` if absent. -/
def allocEnd (s : MM02.State) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((s.allocs i).map fun a => a.base + a.size).getD 0

/-- Largest end of the allocations of identity below `n`. -/
def maxEnd (s : MM02.State) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => max (maxEnd s n) (allocEnd s n)

theorem le_maxEnd (s : MM02.State) : ∀ n i, i < n → allocEnd s i ≤ maxEnd s n
  | 0, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, i, h => by
    simp only [maxEnd]
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 h with h | rfl
    · exact Nat.le_trans (le_maxEnd s n i h) (Nat.le_max_left _ _)
    · exact Nat.le_max_right _ _

/-- K2: a placement that satisfies its obligation (`topPlacement_ok`): the first multiple of the
alignment above the end of every registered allocation. -/
def topPlacement : Placement := fun s g => g.align * (maxEnd s s.next / g.align + 1)

theorem topPlacement_ok : PlacementOK topPlacement := by
  intro s g hwf h0 h2
  refine ⟨hwf _ (Nat.le_refl _), h0, h2, Nat.mul_mod_right _ _, fun i a ha _ _ => ?_⟩
  have hi : i < s.next := Nat.lt_of_not_le fun hle => by rw [hwf i hle] at ha; cases ha
  have he : a.base + a.size ≤ maxEnd s s.next := by
    have := le_maxEnd s s.next i hi; simpa [allocEnd, ha] using this
  have hb := Nat.lt_mul_div_succ (maxEnd s s.next) h0
  exact MM02.rangeDisjoint_iff.2 (.inl (by simp only [topPlacement]; omega))

/-- K2 ("`K.Satisfiable` implique l'existence d'un placement valide"): in MM-02, whose addresses
are unbounded naturals (MM-02.2), every allocation of valid alignment has a valid placement in a
state with fresh identities, whatever `K.Satisfiable` says. -/
theorem placement_exists {s : MM02.State} (hwf : MM02.WF s) (g : Geom) (h0 : 0 < g.align)
    (h2 : MM02.Pow2 g.align) : ∃ base, MM02.AllocPre s g.space base g.size g.align :=
  ⟨_, topPlacement_ok s g hwf h0 h2⟩

/-! ## Accesses and operations attached to MM-03 steps (K4) -/

/-- K4: the access to the range of leaf `l` in `s2`: address = base of its allocation + offset,
provenance = its allocation (the allocation of its root), length = its size, authority `au`. -/
def leafAcc (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (au : MM02.Auth) (l : Nat) : MM02.Access :=
  ⟨(((s2.allocs (L l).alloc).map (·.base)).getD 0) + (L l).off, (L l).alloc, (L l).len, au⟩

/-- K4 (`read3`): one read of authority `read` per range read. -/
def readOps (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (ls : List Nat) : List Op2 :=
  ls.map fun l => .read (leafAcc s2 L .read l)

/-- K4 (`write3`, `writeShared`): one write of authority `write` per range written, of the bytes
`w l` for leaf `l`. -/
def writeOps (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (ls : List Nat) :
    List Op2 :=
  ls.map fun l => .write (leafAcc s2 L .write l) (w l)

/-- K2, K4 (`enterFrame`, `alloc`, static storage): one allocation per root `i` of `roots`, in
order, of geometry `g i`, at the base chosen by `pl` in the current state, with the token `fa`. -/
def allocOps (pl : Placement) (g : Nat → Geom) (fa : Option Nat) :
    MM02.State → List Nat → List Op2
  | _, [] => []

end Shape

/-- K1, K2: layout of the new roots `roots` of the places `P'` appended after `n` old places, in
fresh allocations: the leaves of the `j`-th new root `n + i` are in the allocation `next + j`,
within the size of `g i`; two distinct new leaves of one allocation have disjoint ranges. -/
structure NewLayout (L : Layout) (P' : List Place) (n next : Nat) (g : Nat → Geom)
    (roots : List Nat) : Prop where
  place : ∀ j < roots.length, OptP (roots[j]?) (fun i => ∀ l ∈ footprint P' (n + i),
    (L l).alloc = next + j ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ (g i).size) True
  disjoint : ∀ l < P'.length, ∀ l' < P'.length, n ≤ l → n ≤ l' → isLeaf P' l → isLeaf P' l' →
    l ≠ l' → (L l).alloc = (L l').alloc →
    MM02.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len

set_option synthInstance.maxSize 4096 in
instance (L : Layout) (P' : List Place) (n next : Nat) (g : Nat → Geom) (roots : List Nat) :
    Decidable (NewLayout L P' n next g roots) :=
  decidable_of_iff
    ((∀ j < roots.length, OptP (roots[j]?) (fun i => ∀ l ∈ footprint P' (n + i),
      (L l).alloc = next + j ∧ (L l).off + (L l).len ≤ (g i).size) True) ∧
     (∀ l < P'.length, ∀ l' < P'.length, n ≤ l → n ≤ l' → isLeaf P' l → isLeaf P' l' →
  obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := alloc_fail_unchanged h; exact ⟨trivial, hR⟩

/-- L4: `FreeCompat p auth` instantiated by `Compatible auth (ptok (provOf p))`: `p` is a root
allocated from a provider `pr`, and `auth` is compatible with the token of `pr`. -/
def FreeCompatInst (C : Nat → Nat → Prop) (ptok : Nat → Nat) (provOf : Nat → Option Nat)
    (p auth : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ pr, provOf p = some pr ∧ C auth (ptok pr)

/-- `freeSound_derived` (L4, replaces the hypothesis `FreeSound` of pass 1): under `ReprB`, when
the contracts instantiate `FreeCompat` by `Compatible auth (ptok (provOf p))`, the obligation
`FreeSound` of `free p auth` holds for the root `p`. The content is the clause `provTokens` of
    hlw l m' (.inl (hpair l l' hm).1) (.inr (hpair m m' hm').2)
      (hsrcdst l m' (hpair l l' hm).1 (hpair m m' hm').2)⟩

/-- L6: parametric encoding of pointers into bytes (spec 11): `enc addr prov i` is the `i`-th byte
of a pointer to the address `addr` with provenance `prov`; `decode` reads an address back. -/
structure PtrEnc where
  enc : Nat → Option Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat
  decode : (Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → Nat

/-- L6, obligation of the encoding for a pointer to the address `addr` with provenance `prov`:
`decode (enc addr prov)` is `addr`, and every byte carries the provenance `prov`. Stated per
pointer: a `decode` that reads finitely many bytes cannot invert every natural address (finite
addresses, spec 11). -/
def PtrEncAt (pe : PtrEnc) (addr : Nat) (prov : Option Nat) : Prop :=
  pe.decode (pe.enc addr prov) = addr ∧ ∀ i, (pe.enc addr prov i).2 = prov

/-- L6 ("base + off of first leaf"): address of the pointer to the region `rg`: base of the
allocation of the first leaf of the list plus the offset of that leaf. It need not be the first
byte of the region: K1 fixes no order of fields, and a leaf may have size zero (pass-2 report,
(e) 3). -/
def regionAddr (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (rg : List Nat) : Nat :=
  match rg.head? with
  | some l => (((s2.allocs (L l).alloc).map (·.base)).getD 0) + (L l).off
  | none => 0

/-- L6: provenance of the region `rg`: the allocation of its first leaf (none for an empty
region). -/
def regionProv (L : Layout) (rg : List Nat) : Option Nat := rg.head?.map fun l => (L l).alloc

/-- L6, `ptrBytes`: the bytes of a pointer to the region `rg`. -/
def ptrBytes (pe : PtrEnc) (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (rg : List Nat) :
    Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat :=
  pe.enc (regionAddr s2 L rg) (regionProv L rg)

/-- L6 (`store a p`): one write of the range of the leaf `p` with the bytes of a pointer to the
region covered by `a`. -/
def storeOps (pe : PtrEnc) (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Op2 :=
  [.write (leafAcc s2 L .write p) (ptrBytes pe s2 L (s3.afp a))]

/-- L6 (`issue`, "prov: allocation of arena storage"): the provenance of a block of the arena entry
`i` of `s3`: the allocation of the storage of the arena, read on its first leaf (as `rootAlloc`
reads a root); none for a missing entry. -/
def arenaProv (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (s3.arenas[i]?).map fun ar => (L ((footprint s3.P ar.storage).headD ar.storage)).alloc

/-- L6, the bytes of the pointer to the block `region` of the arena entry `i`: the address of the
region (`regionAddr`) and the provenance of the storage of the arena (`arenaProv`). -/
def issueBytes (pe : PtrEnc) (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (i : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat :=
  pe.enc (regionAddr s2 L region) (arenaProv L s3 i)

/-- L6 (`issue` on the arena entry `i`): one write of the range of the destination with the bytes of
the pointer to the block; `available` and `issued` are abstract state of the arena entry (library
obligation). -/
def issueOps (pe : PtrEnc) (s2 : MM02.State) (L : Layout) (s3 : S3) (i : Nat) (region : List Nat)
    (dst : Nat) : List Op2 :=
  [.write (leafAcc s2 L .write dst) (issueBytes pe s2 L s3 i region)]

/-- L6: the pointer to a region whose first leaf `l` is covered by an active authority is neither
lost nor fabricated: its provenance is the allocation of `l`, which is live, and its address is
the address of `l`, within that allocation. -/

/-- L7: instantiation of `K.DeclaredDisjoint` by the disjointness of the byte ranges of the leaves
of the two regions: every leaf of `r` and every leaf of `r'` are in different allocations or in
disjoint ranges (MM-02.2, `RangeDisjoint`). -/
def ByteDisjoint (L : Layout) (r r' : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ r, ∀ l' ∈ r', (L l).alloc ≠ (L l').alloc ∨
    MM02.RangeDisjoint (L l).off (L l).len (L l').off (L l').len

/-- `ddSound_of_layout` (L7; MM-03.3.8, `DDSound`): when every declaration of disjointness of `K`
implies the byte disjointness of the leaves of the two regions (an obligation of the library that
declares it), and the leaves of a declared region have non-empty ranges, `DDSound` holds. The
non-empty ranges are needed: a leaf of size zero (K1 (d)) is byte-disjoint from itself
(`ddSound_of_layout_needs_size`). -/
theorem ddSound_of_layout {k : K} {L : Layout}
    (h : ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ByteDisjoint L r r')
    (hpos : ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, 0 < (L l).len) : DDSound k := by
  intro r r' hd l hl hl'
  rcases h r r' hd l hl l hl' with e | e
  · exact e rfl
  · exact e (L l).off (Nat.le_refl _) (by have := hpos r r' hd l hl; omega) (Nat.le_refl _)
      (by have := hpos r r' hd l hl; omega)

/-- L7: the instantiation itself, `K.DeclaredDisjoint := ByteDisjoint L`, satisfies `DDSound` when
every range is non-empty. -/
theorem ddSound_instance (k : K) {L : Layout} (hpos : ∀ l, 0 < (L l).len) :
    DDSound { k with DeclaredDisjoint := ByteDisjoint L } :=
  ddSound_of_layout (fun _ _ h => h) fun _ _ _ l _ => hpos l

/-- Counterexample kept (pass-2 report, (e) 1): with a leaf of size zero, allowed by K1 (d), the
instantiation of L7 declares a region disjoint from itself, and `DDSound` fails. -/
theorem ddSound_of_layout_needs_size (k : K) :
    ¬ DDSound { k with DeclaredDisjoint := ByteDisjoint fun _ => ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ } := fun h =>
  h [0] [0] (fun _ _ _ _ => .inr fun _ h1 h2 _ _ => by simp only at h1 h2; omega) 0

inductive Auth where
  | read
  | write
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- MM-02.5 : ordre des autorités, `read ≤ write` (réflexif). -/
instance : LE Auth := ⟨fun a b => a = .read ∨ b = .write⟩

/-- MM-02.5 : l'ordre des autorités est décidable. -/
instance (a b : Auth) : Decidable (a ≤ b) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (a = .read ∨ b = .write))

/-- MM-02.3 : octet abstrait, non initialisé ou initialisé avec une valeur
d'octet sur 8 bits (`val`) et une provenance optionnelle (`prov`, identité
d'allocation). -/
inductive AByte where
  | uninit
  | init (val : UInt8) (prov : Option Nat)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- MM-02.2 : allocation abstraite. Son identité est sa clé dans `State.allocs`.
`space` espace d'adressage, `base` adresse de base, `size` étendue, `align` alignement, `live` état
d'existence, `bytes` stockage indexé par décalage depuis `base`,
`freeAuth` jeton de désallocation : si `freeAuth = some d`, les autorités
capables de la désallouer (MM-02.2) sont les `auth` telles que
`Compatible auth d` (MM-02.D) ; `none` si la désallocation n'est pas applicable. -/
structure Alloc where
  space : Nat
  base : Nat
  size : Nat
  align : Nat
  live : Bool
  bytes : Nat → AByte
  freeAuth : Option Nat

/-- MM-02.4 : emplacement, allocation (`alloc`, identité) et portion de son
stockage (`off` décalage, `len` longueur). Interprétation typée et conditions
d'accès non modélisées. -/
structure Place where
  alloc : Nat
  off : Nat
  len : Nat

/-- MM-02.5 : moyen d'accès. `addr` adresse, `prov` provenance (identité
d'allocation, sans étiquette : lecture fixée par la tâche), `len` plage,
`auth` autorité. -/
structure Access where
  addr : Nat
  prov : Nat
  len : Nat
  auth : Auth

/-- État de la machine abstraite : allocations par identité (MM-02.2) et
prochaine identité fraîche `next` (MM-02.A). -/
structure State where
  allocs : Nat → Option Alloc
  next : Nat

/-- MM-02.A : invariant de fraîcheur, toute identité utilisée est `< next`. -/
def WF (s : State) : Prop := ∀ i, s.next ≤ i → s.allocs i = none

/-- MM-02.B.2 et MM-02.C.2 : validité spatiale, la plage de l'accès est incluse
dans l'étendue de l'allocation. -/
def Spatial (a : Alloc) (ac : Access) : Prop :=
  a.base ≤ ac.addr ∧ ac.addr + ac.len ≤ a.base + a.size

/-- MM-02.B.3 : les `len` octets à partir du décalage `off` sont initialisés. -/
def Alloc.InitRange (a : Alloc) (off len : Nat) : Prop :=
def RangeDisjoint (b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, b1 ≤ x → x < b1 + n1 → b2 ≤ x → x < b2 + n2 → False

/-- MM-02.2 (LiveDisjoint) : forme arithmétique de la disjonction de deux plages
semi-ouvertes. -/
theorem rangeDisjoint_iff {b1 n1 b2 n2 : Nat} :
    RangeDisjoint b1 n1 b2 n2 ↔ b1 + n1 ≤ b2 ∨ b2 + n2 ≤ b1 ∨ n1 = 0 ∨ n2 = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases Nat.le_total b1 b2 with h12 | h12
    · by_cases hlt : b2 < b1 + n1
      · by_cases hn : 0 < n2
        · exact (h b2 h12 hlt (Nat.le_refl _) (by omega)).elim
structure ReadOblSpec where
  dec : State → Access → Prop
  stat : State → Access → Prop

/-- MM-02.B.4, B.6, B.7 et MM-01.3 : obligations de lecture munies d'une décision
de `dec` (`decInst`), testée par les fonctions ; `stat` est reçue en hypothèse
par les fonctions. -/
structure ReadObl extends toSpec : ReadOblSpec where
  decInst : ∀ s, DecidablePred (dec s)

attribute [instance] ReadObl.decInst

/-- MM-02.C.4, C.5, C.6 : obligations d'écriture typée non décidées par le noyau,
sans procédure de décision. `dec` : part décidable ; `stat` : part statique.
`WriteStep` exige les deux pour l'issue `ok`. -/
structure WriteOblSpec where
  dec : State → Access → (Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → Prop
  stat : State → Access → (Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) → Prop

/-- MM-02.C.4, C.5, C.6 et MM-01.3 : obligations d'écriture munies d'une décision
de `dec` (`decInst`), testée par les fonctions ; `stat` est reçue en hypothèse
par les fonctions. -/
structure WriteObl extends toSpec : WriteOblSpec where
  decInst : ∀ s ac, DecidablePred (dec s ac)

attribute [instance] WriteObl.decInst

/-- MM-02.H : issue d'une opération brute : effet défini `ok` (nouvel état) ou
comportement indéfini `ub` (MM-01.5). Issue des interpréteurs et des relations
`WriteStep`, `DeallocStep`, `AllocStep` ; `ReadStep` rend une `ReadOutcome`. -/
inductive Outcome where
/-- MM-02.B, MM-02.H et MM-01.5 : sémantique d'une lecture brute par `ac` dans
l'état `s`. Issue `ok v`, où `v` est la suite des octets de la plage désignée
dans l'allocation `a` de la provenance, si les conditions 1, 2, 3, 5 (`Read`),
la part décidable `ObR.dec` et la part statique `ObR.stat` (conditions 4, 6, 7)
sont satisfaites ; issue `ub` sinon, violation de la part statique comprise. La
lecture n'a pas d'effet sur l'état. La part statique est la frontière avec la
sémantique concurrente (Spec 2, MM-02.F) et n'est pas modélisée ici ; la
répartition des conditions entre `dec` et `stat` n'est pas fixée. -/
inductive ReadStep (ObR : ReadOblSpec) (ac : Access) (s : State) : ReadOutcome → Prop where
  | ok {a : Alloc} : s.allocs ac.prov = some a → Read s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac ∧ ObR.stat s ac →
      ReadStep ObR ac s (.ok (a.bytesAt (ac.addr - a.base) ac.len))
  | ub : ¬ (Read s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac ∧ ObR.stat s ac) → ReadStep ObR ac s .ub

/-- MM-02.C, MM-02.H et MM-01.5 : sémantique d'une écriture brute de `w` par `ac`
dans l'état `s`. Issue `ok` avec l'effet `State.write` si les conditions 1, 2, 3
(`CanWrite`), la part décidable `ObW.dec` et la part statique `ObW.stat`
(conditions 4, 5, 6) sont satisfaites ; issue `ub` sinon, violation de la part
statique comprise. La part statique est la frontière avec la sémantique
concurrente (Spec 2, MM-02.F) et n'est pas modélisée ici ; la répartition des
conditions entre `dec` et `stat` n'est pas fixée. -/
inductive WriteStep (ObW : WriteOblSpec) (ac : Access) (w : Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat) (s : State) :
    Outcome → Prop where
  | ok : CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac w ∧ ObW.stat s ac w →
      WriteStep ObW ac w s (.ok (s.write ac w))
  | ub : ¬ (CanWrite s ac ∧ ObW.dec s ac w ∧ ObW.stat s ac w) → WriteStep ObW ac w s .ub

/-- MM-02.D, MM-02.H et MM-01.5 : sémantique d'une désallocation brute de `id`
avec l'autorité `auth` dans l'état `s`. Issue `ok` avec l'effet `State.dealloc`
si `CanDealloc` ; issue `ub` sinon. `Compatible` n'est pas supposée décidable. -/
inductive DeallocStep (Compatible : Nat → Nat → Prop) (id auth : Nat) (s : State) :
    Outcome → Prop where
  | ok : CanDealloc Compatible s id auth → DeallocStep Compatible id auth s (.ok (s.dealloc id))
  | ub : ¬ CanDealloc Compatible s id auth → DeallocStep Compatible id auth s .ub

/-- MM-02.2 (création brute), MM-02.H et MM-01.5 : sémantique d'une allocation
brute dans l'état `s`. Issue `ok` avec l'effet `State.alloc` si `AllocPre`
(non-chevauchement vérifié sur toute identité) ; issue `ub` sinon. -/
inductive AllocStep (space base size align : Nat) (freeAuth : Option Nat) (s : State) :
    Outcome → Prop where
  | ok : AllocPre s space base size align →
      AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s (.ok (s.alloc space base size align freeAuth))
  | ub : ¬ AllocPre s space base size align → AllocStep space base size align freeAuth s .ub

/-- MM-02.B et MM-02.H : lecture brute par `ac`, sous la part statique `ObR.stat`
reçue en hypothèse. `ok` (état inchangé) si les conditions 1, 2, 3, 5 (`Read`)
et la part décidable `ObR.dec` (conditions 4, 6, 7) sont satisfaites ; `ub`
sinon. -/
def read (ObR : ReadObl) (ac : Access) (s : State) (_hs : ObR.stat s ac) : Outcome :=
  if Read s ac ∧ ObR.dec s ac then .ok s else .ub

/-- MM-02.C et MM-02.H : écriture brute de `w` par `ac`, sous la part statique

    simp only [srun, Option.some.injEq] at he; subst he; exact ⟨os, h⟩
